   508                                  ; NOTES:
   509                                  ;
   510                                  ;   Relocates the loader code to top-of-memory.

   512                                  ; INPUT:     none

   520                                  ; Determine the number of paragraphs (16 byte blocks) of memory.

   523                                  ; converting this to the number of paragraphs.

   525                                  ; available amount of memory in AX

   780                                  ; NOTES: read the start of the clusters that covers at least IbmLoadSize
   781                                  ;	 fully.  for example, if sector/cluster = 2, and IbmLoadSize=3
   782                                  ;	 then we are going to re-read the second cluster to fully cover
   783                                  ;	 msload program in the cluster boundary.
   784                                  ;

   787                                  ;		  msboot program when you build the new version!!!!!

   791                                  ;   FirstSectorL

  1240                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
  1241                                  
  1242                                  ; ReadSectors
  1243                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1244                                  ; notES:
  1245                                  ;
  1246                                  ;  read in the CS:SectorCount number of sectors at ES:di
  1247                                  ;
  1248                                  ;
  1249                                  ; INPUT:
  1250                                  ;
  1251                                  ;   DI = OFFSET of start of read
  1252                                  ;   ES = segment of read
  1253                                  ;   CS:SectorCount = number of sectors to read
  1254                                  ;   CS:StartSecL = starting sector (low)
  1255                                  ;   CS:StartSecH = starting sector (high)
  1256                                  ;   following is bpb info that must be setup prior to call
  1257                                  ;   CS:NumHeads
  1258                                  ;   CS:number_of_sectors
  1259                                  ;   CS:BootDrive
  1260                                  ;   CS:SecPerTrack
  1261                                  ;
  1262                                  ; OUTPUT:
  1263                                  ;
  1264                                  ;   AX,BX,CX,DX,SI,DI destroyed
  1265                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1266                                  ; divide start sector by sectors per track
  1267                                  ; the remainder is the actual sector number, 0 based
  1268                                  ;
  1269                                  ; increment actual sector number to get 1 based
  1270                                  ;
  1271                                  ; the quotient is the number of tracks - divide by heads to get the cyl
  1272                                  ;
  1273                                  ; the remainder is actual head, the quotient is cylinder
  1274                                  ;
  1275                                  ; figure the number of sectors in that track, set al to this
  1276                                  ;
  1277                                  ; do the read
  1278                                  ;
  1279                                  ; if error, do reset, then redo the int 13h
  1280                                  ;
  1281                                  ; if successful read, subtract # sectors read from SectorCount, add to logical
  1282                                  ; sector, add #sectors read * BytesPerSec to bx;
  1283                                  ;
  1284                                  ; if SectorCount <> 0 do next read

  1286                                  
  1287                                  		; 15/09/2023

  1615                                  ; GetNextFatEntry
  1616                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1617                                  ;
  1618                                  ; NOTES:
  1619                                  ;
  1620                                  ;   given the last cluster found, this will return the next cluster of
  1621                                  ;   iosys. if the last cluster is (f)ff8 - (f)fff, then the final cluster
  1622                                  ;   of iosys has been loaded, and control is passed to goto_iosys
  1623                                  ;   msload can handle maximum fat area size of 128 kb.
  1624                                  ;
  1625                                  ; INPUT:
  1626                                  ;
  1627                                  ;    CS:CurrentCluster
  1628                                  ;    CS:FatSize
  1629                                  ;
  1630                                  ; OUTPUT:
  1631                                  ;
  1632                                  ;   CS:CurrentCluster (updated)
  1633                                  ;
  1634                                  ; calls:  GetFatSector
  1635                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1636                                  ; get CurrentCluster
  1637                                  ;
  1638                                  ; if (16 bit fat)
  1639                                  ;    {if (CurrentCluster = fff8 - ffff)
  1640                                  ;	 {jmp goto_iosys}
  1641                                  ;     else
  1642                                  ;	{get OFFSET by multiply cluster by 2}
  1643                                  ;
  1644                                  ; else
  1645                                  ;    {if (CurrentCluster = ff8 - fff)
  1646                                  ;	 {jmp goto_iosys}
  1647                                  ;     else
  1648                                  ;	{get OFFSET by	- multiply cluster by 3
  1649                                  ;
  1650                                  ;	 rotate right to divide by 2
  1651                                  ;
  1652                                  ;	 if (cy set - means odd number)
  1653                                  ;	    {shr 4 times to keep high twelve bits}
  1654                                  ;
  1655                                  ;	 else
  1656                                  ;	    {and with 0fffh to keep low 12 bits}
  1657                                  ;	}
  1658                                  ;    }
  1659                                  ;
  1660                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1661                                  
  1662                                  ; 09/12/2022
  1663                                  ; FAT_12_BIT equ 1
  1664                                  ; NOT_END_OF_FILE equ 0  ; ~END_OF_FILE ; END_OF_FILE equ 0FFh
  1665                                  
  1666                                  GetNextFatEntry:
  1667 00000298 06                      		push	es
  1668                                  		; 24/12/2022
  1669                                  		; ds = cs
  1670                                  		;mov	ax, [cs:FatSegment]
  1671 00000299 A1[3200]                		mov	ax, [FatSegment]
  1672 0000029C 8EC0                    		mov	es, ax		; ES-> FAT area segment
  1673                                  		; 09/12/2022
  1674                                  		;;mov	byte [cs:EndOfFile], END_OF_FILE
  1675                                  		;mov	byte [cs:EndOfFile], 0FFh ; Assume last cluster
  1676                                  		;mov	ax, [cs:CurrentCluster] ; Get last cluster
  1677                                  		; 24/12/2022
  1678                                  		; ds = cs
  1679 0000029E C606[2900]FF            		mov	byte [EndOfFile], 0FFh ; Assume last cluster
  1680 000002A3 A1[0E00]                		mov	ax, [CurrentCluster] ; Get last cluster
  1681                                  		; 06/10/2023
  1682 000002A6 29D2                    		sub	dx, dx
  1683                                  		; dx = 0
  1684 000002A8 803E[2700]01            		cmp	byte [Fatsize], 1
  1685                                  		;;cmp	byte [cs:FatSize], FAT_12_BIT
  1686                                  		;cmp	byte [cs:Fatsize], 1
  1687 000002AD 7539                    		jne	short Got16Bit	; 23/12/2022

  1690 000002B1 D1E8                    		shr	ax, 1

  1692                                  		; 06/10/2023

  1694                                  		; 23/12/2022

  1708                                  		; 06/10/2023

  1717                                  		; 22/12/2022

  1719                                  		;mov	[cs:TempCluster+1], al
  1720                                  		;mov	ax, [cs:TempCluster]
  1721                                  		; 06/10/2023
  1722                                  		; 22/12/2022
  1723 000002C6 58                      		pop	ax ; (*) 
  1724 000002C7 268A260000              		mov	ah, [es:0]
  1725 000002CC EB03                    		jmp	short EvenOdd
  1726                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1727                                  
  1728                                  ClusterOk:				
  1729 000002CE 268B07                  		mov	ax, [es:bx]
  1730                                  EvenOdd:	
  1731                                  		; 24/12/2022
  1732                                  		; ds = cs
  1733 000002D1 F606[0E00]01            		test	byte [CurrentCluster], 1
  1734                                  		; 10/12/2022		
  1735                                  		;test	byte [cs:CurrentCluster], 1 ; 09/12/2022
  1736                                  		;;test	word [cs:CurrentCluster], 1 ; Was last cluster odd?
  1737 000002D6 7505                    		jnz	short OddResult		; If not zero it was odd
  1738 000002D8 25FF0F                  		and	ax, 0FFFh		; Keep low 12 bits
  1739 000002DB EB04                    		jmp	short TestEOF
  1740                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1741                                  
  1742                                  OddResult:				
  1743 000002DD B104                    		mov	cl, 4			; Keep high 12 bits for odd
  1744 000002DF D3E8                    		shr	ax, cl
  1745                                  TestEOF:				
  1746 000002E1 3DF80F                  		cmp	ax, 0FF8h		; Is it last cluster?
  1747 000002E4 7318                    		jnb	short GotClusterDone	; Yep, all done here
  1748 000002E6 EB11                    		jmp	short NotLastCluster
  1749                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1750                                  
  1751                                  Got16Bit:
  1752                                  		; 23/12/2022
  1753                                  		;push	dx
  1754                                  		;xor	dx, dx
  1755                                  		; 06/10/2023
  1756                                  		; ax = cluster number
  1757                                  		; dx = 0
  1758                                  		;sub	dx, dx ; 23/12/2022
  1759 000002E8 D1E0                    		shl	ax, 1			; Multiply cluster by 2
  1760                                  		;adc	dx, 0
  1761                                  		; 07/10/2023

  1763 000002EC 89C6                    		mov	si, ax			; Get the final buffer OFFSET
  1764 000002EE E80F00                  		call	GetFatSector
  1765                                  		; 23/12/2022
  1766                                  		;pop	dx
  1767 000002F1 268B07                  		mov	ax, [es:bx]
  1768 000002F4 83F8F8                  		cmp	ax, 0FFF8h
  1769 000002F7 7305                    		jnb	short GotClusterDone
  1770                                  NotLastCluster:	
  1771                                  		; 24/12/2022
  1772                                  		; ds = cs			
  1773                                  		;;mov	byte [cs:EndOfFile], NOT_END_OF_FILE ; ~END_OF_FILE
  1774                                  		;mov	byte [cs:EndOfFile], 0	; Assume not last cluster
  1775 000002F9 C606[2900]00            		mov	byte [EndOfFile], 0	; Assume not last cluster
  1776                                  GotClusterDone:				
  1777 000002FE 07                      		pop	es
  1778                                  		; 07/10/2023

  1781 000002FF C3                      		retn

  1783                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
  1784                                  
  1785                                  ; GetFatSector
  1786                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1787                                  ;function: find and read the corresponding fat sector into ES:0
  1788                                  ;
  1789                                  ;in). SI = offset value (starting from fat entry 0) of fat entry to find.
  1790                                  ;     ES = fat sector segment
  1791                                  ;     CS:BytesPerSec
  1792                                  ;
  1793                                  ;out). corresponding fat sector read in.
  1794                                  ;      BX = offset value of the corresponding fat entry in the fat sector.
  1795                                  ;      CX destroyed.
  1796                                  ;      zero flag set if the fat entry is splitted, i.e. when 12 bit fat entry
  1797                                  ;      starts at the last byte of the fat sector. in this case, the caller
  1798                                  ;      should save this byte, and read the next fat sector to get the rest
  1799                                  ;      of the fat entry value. (this will only happen with the 12 bit fat).
  1800                                  ;
  1801                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1802                                  
  1803                                  		; 24/12/2022
  1804                                  		; 22/12/2022
  1805                                  GetFatSector:
  1806                                  		; 06/10/2023
  1807                                  		;push	ax
  1808                                  		;push	si
  1809 00000300 57                      		push	di
  1810 00000301 89F0                    		mov	ax, si
  1811                                  		; 24/12/2022
  1812                                  		; ds = cs
  1813                                  		;mov	cx, [cs:BytesPerSec]
  1814                                  		;div	cx			; AX = Sector number, DX = Offset
  1815 00000303 F736[1000]              		div	word [BytesPerSec]
  1816 00000307 3B06[0A00]              		cmp	ax, [LastFatSector]
  1817                                  		;cmp	ax, [cs:LastFatSector]	; The same fat sector?
  1818 0000030B 7421                    		je	short SplitChk		; Don't need to read it again.
  1819 0000030D A3[0A00]                		mov	[LastFatSector], ax
  1820                                  		;mov	[cs:LastFatSector], ax
  1821 00000310 52                      		push	dx
  1822                                  		; 24/12/2022
  1823 00000311 31D2                    		xor	dx, dx
  1824                                  		;add	ax, [cs:HiddenSectorsL]
  1825                                  		;adc	dx, [cs:HiddenSectorsH]
  1826                                  		;add	ax, [cs:ReservSectors]
  1827                                  		;adc	dx, 0
  1828                                  		; 24/12/2022
  1829                                  		; ds = cs
  1830 00000313 0306[2E00]              		add	ax, [FatStartSecL]
  1831 00000317 1316[3000]              		adc	dx, [FatStartSecH]
  1832 0000031B A3[0600]                		mov	[StartSecL], ax
  1833 0000031E 8916[0800]              		mov	[StartSecH], dx		; Set up for ReadSectors
  1834                                  		;mov	[cs:StartSecL], ax
  1835                                  		;mov	[cs:StartSecH], dx	; Set up for ReadSectors
  1836                                  		
  1837 00000322 C706[0C00]0100          		mov	word [SectorCount], 1	; 1 sector
  1838                                  		;mov	word [cs:SectorCount], 1 ; 1 sector
  1839 00000328 31FF                    		xor	di, di ; 0
  1840                                  		; es:di = FATSEGMENT:0000h
  1841 0000032A E8D2FE                  		call	ReadSectors
  1842 0000032D 5A                      		pop	dx
  1843                                  		; 24/12/2022
  1844                                  		;mov	cx, [cs:BytesPerSec]
  1845                                  SplitChk:
  1846                                  		; 24/12/2022
  1847 0000032E 8B0E[1000]              		mov	cx, [BytesPerSec]
  1848 00000332 49                      		dec	cx			; CX = SECTOR SIZE - 1
  1849 00000333 39CA                    		cmp	dx, cx			; If last byte of sector, splitted entry.
  1850 00000335 89D3                    		mov	bx, dx			; set bx to dx
  1851 00000337 5F                      		pop	di
  1852                                  		; 06/10/2023
  1853                                  		;pop	si
  1854                                  		;pop	ax
  1855                                  		; 07/10/2023
  1856                                  ;EndWrite:		; 10/12/2022
  1857 00000338 C3                      		retn
  1858

  2080 0000011B 7000                    		dw 70h			; KERNEL_SEGMENT
  2081                                  
  2082                                  ; (MSDOS 3.3) NOTE:
  2083                                  ; Some floppy drives do not have changeline support. The result is a
  2084                                  ; large amount of inefficiency in the code. A media-check always returns
  2085                                  ; "I don`t know". This cause DOS to reread the FAT on every access and
  2086                                  ; always discard any cached data.
  2087                                  ;    We get around this inefficiency by implementing a "Logical Door Latch".
  2088                                  ; The following three items are used to do this. The logical door latch is
  2089                                  ; based on the premise that it is not physically possible to change floppy
  2090                                  ; disks in a drive in under two seconds (most people take about 10). The
  2091                                  ; logical door latch is implemented by saving the time of the last successful
  2092                                  ; disk operation (in the value TIM_DRV). When a new request is made the
  2093                                  ; current time is compared to the saved time. If less than two seconds have
  2094                                  ; passed then the value "No Change" is returned. If more than two seconds
  2095                                  ; have passed the value "Don't Know" is returned.
  2096                                  ;    There is one complecation to this algorithm. Some programs change the
  2097                                  ; value of the timer. In this unfortunate case we have an invalid timer.
  2098                                  ; This possibility is detected by counting the number of disk operations
  2099                                  ; which occur without any time passing. If this count exceeds the value of
  2100                                  ; "AccessMax" we assume the counter is invalid and always return "Don't
  2101                                  ; Know". The variable "AccessCount" is used to keep track of the number
  2102                                  ; of disk operation which occur without the time changing.
  2103                                  
  2104 0000011D 00                      accesscount:	db 0			
  2105 0000011E FF                      tim_drv:	db 0FFh			
  2106 0000011F 00                      medbyt:		db 0
  2107                                  wrtverify:	; 15/10/2022			
  2108 00000120 02                      rflag:		db 2			; 2 for	read, 3	for write
  2109 00000121 00                      verify:		db 0			; 1 if verify after write
  2110 00000122 0000                    seccnt:		dw 0			
  2111 00000124 00                      		db 0			; -- pad where hardnum was
  2112 00000125 01                      dsktnum:	db 1			; number of diskette drives			
  2113                                  
  2114                                  ; (MSDOS 3.3) NOTE:
  2115                                  ; Some of the older versions of the IBM rom-bios always assumed a seek would
  2116                                  ; have to be made to read the diskette. Consequently a large head settle
  2117                                  ; time was always used in the I/O operations. To get around this problem
  2118                                  ; we need to continually adjust the head settle time. The following
  2119                                  ; algorithm is used:
  2120                                  ;
  2121                                  ;   Get the current head settle value.
  2122                                  ;   If it is 1, then
  2123                                  ;	set slow = 15
  2124                                  ;   else
  2125                                  ;	set slow = value
  2126                                  ;   ...
  2127                                  ;   if we are seeking and writing then
  2128                                  ;	use slow
  2129                                  ;   else
  2130                                  ;	use fast
  2131                                  ;   ...
  2132                                  ;   restore current head settle value
  2133                                  
  2134 00000126 00                      motorstartup:	db 0			; value from table
  2135 00000127 00                      settlecurrent:	db 0			; value	from table
  2136 00000128 00                      settleslow:	db 0			; slow settle value
  2137 00000129 00                      nextspeed:	db 0			; value	of speed to be used
  2138 0000012A 00                      save_head_sttl:	db 0			; used by read_sector routine
  2139 0000012B 00                      save_eot:	db 0			; saved	eot from the default DPT
  2140 0000012C 09                      eot:		db 9			
  2141 0000012D 00000000                dpt:		dd 0			; pointer to Disk Parameter Table			
  2142 00000131 00                      cursec:		db 0			; current sector
  2143 00000132 00                      curhd:		db 0			; current head
  2144 00000133 0000                    curtrk:		dw 0			; current track
  2145 00000135 0000                    spsav:		dw 0			; save the stack pointer
  2146 00000137 08                      formt_eot:	db 8			; eot used for format
  2147 00000138 00                      hdnum:		db 0			; head number
  2148 00000139 0000                    trknum:		dw 0			; track	being manipulated
  2149 0000013B 50                      gap_patch:	db 50h			; format gap patched into dpt

  3146                                  ;SR; WIN386 support
  3147                                  
  3148                                  ; WIN386 instance data structure
  3149                                  ;
  3150                                  ; Here is a Win386 startup info structure which we set up and to which
  3151                                  ; we return a pointer when Win386 initializes.
  3152                                  
  3153 00000832 0300                    Win386_SI:	db 3, 0			; SI_Version
  3154                                  					; Startup Info for Win386
  3155 00000834 00000000                SI_Next:	dd 0			; pointer to next info structure
  3156 00000838 00000000                		dd 0			; a field we don't need
  3157 0000083C 00000000                		dd 0			; another field	we don't need
  3158 00000840 [4408]                  SI_Instance:	dw Instance_Table
  3159 00000842 7000                    		dw 70h	; Bios_Data	; far pointer to instance table
  3160                                  
  3161                                  ; This table gives Win386 the instance data in the BIOS and ROM-BIOS data
  3162                                  ; areas. Note that the address and size of the hardware stacks must
  3163                                  ; be calculated and inserted at boot time.
  3164                                  
  3165 00000844 00005000                Instance_Table:	dw 0, 50h		; print	screen status...
  3166 00000848 0200                    		dw 2			; ... 2	bytes
  3167 0000084A 0E005000                		dw 0Eh,	50h		; ROM Basic data...
  3168 0000084E 1400                    		dw 14h			; ... 14H bytes
  3169 00000850 [0C00]                  		dw altah		; a con	device buffer...
  3170 00000852 7000                    		dw 70h			; Bios_Data segment
  3171 00000854 0100                    		dw 1			; ... 1 byte
  3172                                  
  3173                                  NextStack:
  3174                                  
  3175                                  ; NOTE:  If stacks are disabled by STACKS=0,0, the following
  3176                                  ;	instance items WILL NOT be filled in by SYSINIT.
  3177                                  ;	That's just fine as long as these are the last items
  3178                                  ;	in the instance list since the first item is initialized
  3179                                  ;	to 0000 at load time.
  3180                                  
  3181 00000856 00000000                		dw 0, 0			; pointer to next stack	to be used...
  3182 0000085A 0200                    		dw 2			; ... 2 bytes

  3507                                  ;***************************************************************************
  3508                                  
  3509                                  ; Possibly disposable data, goes at end of data group
  3510                                  
  3511                                  ;***	ibm_disk_io - main routine, fixes at rom bug
  3512                                  ;
  3513                                  ;	entry:	(ah) = function, 02 or 0a for read.
  3514                                  ;		(dl) = drive number (80h or 81h).
  3515                                  ;		(dh) = head number.
  3516                                  ;		(ch) = cylinder number.
  3517                                  ;		(cl) = sector number (high 2 bits has cylinder number).
  3518                                  ;		(al) = number of sectors.
  3519                                  ;		(es:bx) = address of read buffer.
  3520                                  ;		for more on register contents see rom bios listing.
  3521                                  ;		stack set up for return by an iret.
  3522                                  ;
  3523                                  ;	exit:	(ah) = status of current operation.
  3524                                  ;		(cy) = 1 if failed, 0 if successful.
  3525                                  ;		for other register contents see rom bios listing.
  3526                                  ;
  3527                                  ;	uses:	
  3528                                  ;
  3529                                  ;
  3530                                  ;	warning: uses old13 vector for non-read calls.
  3531                                  ;		does direct calls to the at rom.
  3532                                  ;		does segment arithmatic.
  3533                                  ;
  3534                                  ;	effects: performs disk i/o operation.
  3535                                  
  3536                                  ; 16/10/2022
  3537                                  ; 28/05/2019
  3538                                  cmd_block equ 42h ; ROMBIOS DATA segment (40h) offset 42h ; 13/12/2022
  3539                                  
  3540                                  ;* offsets into cmd_block for registers
  3541                                  
  3542                                  pre_comp equ 0	;write pre-compensation
  3543                                  sec_cnt	 equ 1	;sector count
  3544                                  sec_num	 equ 2	;sector number
  3545                                  cyl_low	 equ 3	;cylinder number, low part
  3546                                  cyl_high equ 4	;cylinder number, high part
  3547                                  drv_head equ 5	;drive/head (bit 7 = ecc mode, bit 5 = 512 byte sectors, 
  3548                                  		;            bit 4 = drive number, bits 3-0 have head number)
  3549                                  cmd_reg  equ 6	;command register
  3550                                  
  3551                                  ; 01/10/2022
  3552                                  disk_status1	equ 74h
  3553                                  hf_num		equ 75h
  3554                                  control_byte	equ 76h
  3555                                  
  3556                                  ; 30/12/2022
  3557                                  ; (MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS, BIOSDATA:12DEh)
  3558                                  
  3559                                  ibm_disk_io:				
  3560 00001273 80FA80                  		cmp	dl, 80h		; main routine,	fixes at rom bug
  3561 00001276 720A                    		jb	short atd1	; pass through floppy disk calls. 
  3562 00001278 80FC02                  		cmp	ah, 2
  3563 0000127B 740A                    		jz	short atd2	; intercept call 02 (read sectors).
  3564 0000127D 80FC0A                  		cmp	ah, 0Ah
  3565 00001280 7405                    		jz	short atd2	; and call 0Ah (read long).
  3566                                  atd1:
  3567 00001282 2EFF2E[0601]            		jmp	far [cs:Old13]					
  3568                                  		;jmp	cs:Old13	; use rom int 13h handler
  3569                                  ;-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  3570                                  
  3571                                  atd2:					
  3572 00001287 53                      		push	bx
  3573 00001288 51                      		push	cx
  3574 00001289 52                      		push	dx
  3575 0000128A 57                      		push	di
  3576 0000128B 1E                      		push	ds
  3577 0000128C 06                      		push	es
  3578 0000128D 50                      		push	ax
  3579 0000128E B84000                  		mov	ax, 40h		; bioseg (rombios data segment)
  3580                                  					; establish bios segment addressing
  3581 00001291 8ED8                    		mov	ds, ax
  3582                                  		; 16/10/2022
  3583 00001293 C606740000              		mov	byte [disk_status1], 0
  3584                                  		;mov	byte ptr ds:74h, 0 ; [disk_status1]
  3585                                  					; initially no error code.
  3586 00001298 80E27F                  		and	dl, 7Fh		; mask to hard disk number
  3587 0000129B 3A167500                		cmp	dl, [hf_num]
  3588                                  		;cmp	dl, ds:75h	; [hf_num] ; 40h:75h
  3589 0000129F 7207                    		jb	short atd3	; disk number in range
  3590                                  		;mov	byte ptr ds:74h, 1 ; bad_disk
  3591 000012A1 C606740001              		mov	byte [disk_status1], 1
  3592 000012A6 EB20                    		jmp	short atd4	; disk number out of range error,
  3593                                  					; return
  3594                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  3595                                  
  3596                                  atd3:					
  3597 000012A8 53                      		push	bx
  3598 000012A9 8CC0                    		mov	ax, es
  3599 000012AB C1EB04                  		shr	bx, 4		; make es:bx to seg:000x form.
  3600 000012AE 01D8                    		add	ax, bx
  3601 000012B0 8EC0                    		mov	es, ax
  3602 000012B2 5B                      		pop	bx
  3603 000012B3 83E30F                  		and	bx, 0Fh
  3604 000012B6 0E                      		push	cs
  3605 000012B7 E8DF00                  		call	check_dma
  3606 000012BA 720C                    		jb	short atd4	; abort if dma across segment boundary
  3607 000012BC 58                      		pop	ax
  3608 000012BD 50                      		push	ax
  3609 000012BE E81A00                  		call	setcmd		; set up command block for disk op
  3610 000012C1 BAF603                  		mov	dx, 3F6h	; hf_reg_port 
  3611 000012C4 EE                      		out	dx, al		; write out command modifier
  3612 000012C5 E86B00                  		call	docmd		; carry out command
  3613                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  3614                                  
  3615                                  atd4:	
  3616                                  
  3617                                  ;  new code - let logical or clear carry and then set carry if ah!=0
  3618                                  ;	      and save a couple bytes while were at it.
  3619                                  				
  3620 000012C8 58                      		pop	ax
  3621                                  		;mov	ah, ds:74h	; [disk_status1]
  3622 000012C9 8A267400                		mov	ah, [disk_status1]
  3623 000012CD 08E4                    		or	ah, ah
  3624 000012CF 7401                    		jz	short atd5
  3625 000012D1 F9                      		stc
  3626                                  atd5:					
  3627 000012D2 07                      		pop	es
  3628 000012D3 1F                      		pop	ds
  3629 000012D4 5F                      		pop	di
  3630 000012D5 5A                      		pop	dx
  3631 000012D6 59                      		pop	cx
  3632 000012D7 5B                      		pop	bx
  3633 000012D8 CA0200                  		retf	2		; far return, dropping flags
  3634                                  
  3635                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E ========================================
  3636                                  
  3637                                  ;***	setcmd - set up cmd_block for the disk operation
  3638                                  ;
  3639                                  ;	entry:	(ds) = bios data segment.
  3640                                  ;		(es:bx) in seg:000x form.
  3641                                  ;		other registers as in int 13h call
  3642                                  ;	
  3643                                  ;	exit:	cmd_block set up for disk read call.
  3644                                  ;		control_byte set up for disk operation.
  3645                                  ;		(al) = control byte modifier
  3646                                  ;
  3647                                  ;	sets the fields of cmd_block using the register contents
  3648                                  ;	and the contents of the disk parameter block for the given drive.
  3649                                  ;
  3650                                  ;	warning: (ax) destroyed.
  3651                                  ;		does direct calls to the at rom.
  3652                                  
  3653                                  setcmd:		; proc near		
  3654                                  		;mov	ds:43h,	al	; [cmd_block+sec_cnt]

  3706                                  ;***	docmd - carry out read operation to at hard disk
  3707                                  ;
  3708                                  ;	entry:	(es:bx) = address for read in data.
  3709                                  ;		cmd_block set up for disk read.
  3710                                  ;
  3711                                  ;	exit:	buffer at (es:bx) contains data read.
  3712                                  ;		disk_status1 set to error code (0 if success).
  3713                                  ;
  3714                                  ;	
  3715                                  ;
  3716                                  ;	warning: (ax), (bl), (cx), (dx), (di) destroyed.
  3717                                  ;		no check is made for dma boundary overrun.
  3718                                  ;
  3719                                  ;	effects: programs disk controller.
  3720                                  ;		performs disk input.
  3721                                  
  3722                                  docmd:		; proc near		
  3723 00001333 89DF                    		mov	di, bx
  3724 00001335 0E                      		push	cs
  3725 00001336 E84000                  		call	command
  3726 00001339 7535                    		jnz	short doc3
  3727                                  doc1:					
  3728 0000133B 0E                      		push	cs
  3729 0000133C E84200                  		call	waitt		; wait for controller to complete read
  3730 0000133F 752F                    		jnz	short doc3
  3731 00001341 B90001                  		mov	cx, 256		; 256 words per sector
  3732 00001344 BAF001                  		mov	dx, 1F0h	; hf_port
  3733 00001347 FC                      		cld			; string op goes up
  3734 00001348 FA                      		cli			; disable interrupts
  3735                                  					; (bug was forgetting this)
  3736                                  
  3737                                  ;	M062 -- some of these old machines have intermittent failures
  3738                                  ;		when the read is done at full speed. Instead of using
  3739                                  ;		a string rep instruction, we'll use a loop. There is
  3740                                  ;		a slight performance hit, but it only affects these
  3741                                  ;		very old machines with an exact date code match, and
  3742                                  ;		it makes said machines more reliable
  3743                                  ;
  3744                                  ;M062	repz	insw		;read in sector
  3745                                  
  3746                                  rsct_loop:				
  3747 00001349 6D                      		insw
  3748 0000134A E2FD                    		loop	rsct_loop
  3749 0000134C FB                      		sti
  3750                                  		; 16/10/2022
  3751 0000134D F606480002              		test	byte [cmd_block+cmd_reg], 02h
  3752                                  		;test	byte ptr ds:48h, 2 ; [cmd_block+cmd_reg]
  3753                                  					; (ds =	40h)
  3754 00001352 7410                    		jz	short doc2	; no ecc bytes to read.
  3755 00001354 0E                      		push	cs
  3756 00001355 E83100                  		call	wait_drq	; wait for controller to complete read
  3757 00001358 7216                    		jb	short doc3
  3758 0000135A B90400                  		mov	cx, 4		; 4 bytes of ecc
  3759 0000135D BAF001                  		mov	dx, 1F0h	; hf_port
  3760 00001360 FA                      		cli
  3761 00001361 F36C                    		rep insb		; read in ecc
  3762 00001363 FB                      		sti
  3763                                  doc2:					
  3764 00001364 0E                      		push	cs
  3765 00001365 E82900                  		call	check_status
  3766 00001368 7506                    		jnz	short doc3	; operation failed
  3767                                  		;dec	byte ptr ds:43h	; [cmd_block+sec_cnt]
  3768 0000136A FE0E4300                		dec	byte [cmd_block+sec_cnt]
  3769 0000136E 75CB                    		jnz	short doc1	; loop while more sectors to read
  3770                                  doc3:					
  3771 00001370 C3                      		retn

  3790                                  ;***	get_vec - get pointer to hard disk parameters.
  3791                                  ;

  3793                                  ;

  3795                                  ;

  3799                                  ;	or 70h (disk 1).

  3921                                  ;; Certain old COMPAQ '286 machines have a bug in their ROM BIOS.
  3922                                  ;; When Int13 is done with AH > 15h and DL >= 80h, they trash
  3923                                  ;; the byte at DS:74h, assuming that DS points to ROM_DATA.
  3924                                  ;; If our init code detects this error, it will install this
  3925                                  ;; special Int13 hook through the same mechanism that was set
  3926                                  ;; up for the IBM patch above. This code is also dynamically
  3927                                  ;; relocated by MSINIT.

  3929                                  compaq_disk_io:
  3930 000013A1 80FC15                  		cmp	ah, 15h		; compaq_disk_io proc far

  3933                                  					; this is used at configuration	time.
  3934                                  					;
  3935                                  					; warning!!!
  3936                                  					; this code will be dynamically	relocated by msinit
  3937 000013A4 7705                    		ja	short mebbe_hookit ; only deal with functions > 15h
  3938                                  no_hookit:				
  3939                                  		;jmp	cs:Old13
  3940                                  		; 16/10/2022
  3941 000013A6 2EFF2E[0601]            		jmp	far [cs:Old13]
  3942

  3946 000013AB 80FA80                  		cmp	dl, 80h
  3947 000013AE 72F6                    		jb	short no_hookit
  3948 000013B0 1E                      		push	ds
  3949

  3953                                  		;mov	ax, 40h

  3974                                  
  3975                                  ; CMOS Clock setting support routines used by MSCLOCK.		
  3976                                  ; Warning!!! This code will be dynamically relocated by MSINIT.
  3977                                  
  3978                                  daycnt_to_day:	; proc far
  3979                                  
  3980                                  ; entry: [daycnt] = number of days since 1-1-80
  3981                                  ;
  3982                                  ; return: ch - century in bcd
  3983                                  ;	  cl - year in bcd
  3984                                  ;	  dh - month in bcd
  3985                                  ;	  dl - day in bcd
  3986                                  
  3987                                  		; 16/10/2022		
  3988                                  		push	word [cs:daycnt] ; save daycnt
  3989                                  		cmp	word [cs:daycnt], 7305	; (365*20+(20/4))
  3990                                  					; # days from 1-1-1980 to 1-1-2000
  3991                                  		jnb	short century20
  3992                                  		mov	byte [cs:base_century], 19
  3993                                  		mov	byte [cs:base_year], 80
  3994                                  		jmp	short years
  3995                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  3996                                  		
  3997                                  century20:				
  3998                                  		mov	byte [cs:base_century], 20
  3999                                  		mov	byte [cs:base_year], 0
  4000                                  		sub	word [cs:daycnt], 7305	; (365*20+(20/4))
  4001                                  					; adjust daycnt
  4002                                  years:					
  4003                                  		xor	dx, dx
  4004                                  		mov	ax, [cs:daycnt]
  4005                                  		mov	bx, 1461	; (366+365*3)
  4006                                  					; # of days in a Leap year block
  4007                                  		div	bx		; AX = # of leap block,	DX = daycnt
  4008                                  		mov	[cs:daycnt], dx	; save daycnt left
  4009                                  		mov	bl, 4
  4010                                  		mul	bl		; AX = # of years. Less	than 100
  4011                                  		add	[cs:base_year], al ; So, ah = 0. Adjust year
  4012                                  		inc	word [cs:daycnt]	; set daycnt to	1 base
  4013                                  		cmp	word [cs:daycnt], 366	; daycnt=remainder of leap year	bk
  4014                                  		jbe	short leapyear	; within 366+355+355+355 days.
  4015                                  		inc	byte [cs:base_year]	; if daycnt <= 366, then leap year
  4016                                  		sub	word [cs:daycnt], 366	; else daycnt--, base_year++ ;
  4017                                  		mov	cx, 3		; And next three years are normal
  4018                                  regularyear:				
  4019                                  		cmp	word [cs:daycnt], 365	; for(i=1; i>3 or daycnt <=365;	i++)
  4020                                  		jbe	short yeardone	; {if (daycnt >	365)
  4021                                  		inc	byte [cs:base_year]	;   { daycnt -=	365
  4022                                  		sub	word [cs:daycnt], 365	;   }
  4023                                  		loop	regularyear	; }
  4024                                  					;
  4025                                  					; should never fall through loop
  4026                                  leapyear:				
  4027                                  		mov	byte [cs:month_tab+1], 29 ; leap year.
  4028                                  					; change month table.
  4029                                  yeardone:				
  4030                                  		xor	bx, bx
  4031                                  		xor	dx, dx
  4032                                  		mov	ax, [cs:daycnt]
  4033                                  		;mov	si, offset month_tab
  4034                                  		mov	si, month_tab	; 19/10/2022
  4035                                  		mov	cx, 12
  4036                                  months:					
  4037                                  		inc	bl
  4038                                  
  4039                                  		; !!! -- 16/10/2022 -- (if DS=CS, what for CS: prefixes are used !?)
  4040                                  		;mov	dl, [cs:si]
  4041                                  		; !!! -- 16/10/2022 -- (may be to keep code addrs as unchanged/fix!?)
  4042                                  		; ds = cs !? ((ofcourse ds must be same with cs here))
  4043                                  		;mov	dl, [si] ; 20/03/2019 (MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS, BIOSDATA:14C0h)
  4044                                  		;mov	dl, [si] ; 16/10/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS, BIOSDATA:14C0h)
  4045                                  		
  4046                                  		mov	dl, [si] ; ?	; mov dl, [cs:si]
  4047                                  		cmp	ax, dx		; cmp daycnt for each month till fit
  4048                                  					; dh=0
  4049                                  		jbe	short month_done
  4050                                  		inc	si		; next month
  4051                                  		sub	ax, dx		; adjust daycnt
  4052                                  		loop	months		;
  4053                                  					; should never fall through loop
  4054                                  month_done:				
  4055                                  		mov	byte [cs:month_tab+1], 28
  4056                                  					; restore month table value
  4057                                  		mov	dl, bl
  4058                                  		mov	dh, [cs:base_year]
  4059                                  		mov	cl, [cs:base_century] ; al=day,dl=month,dh=year,cl=cntry
  4060                                  		call	far [cs:bintobcd]
  4061                                  		;call	cs:bintobcd	; convert "day"	to bcd
  4062                                  					; dl = bcd day,	al = month
  4063                                  		xchg	dl, al
  4064                                  		call	far [cs:bintobcd]
  4065                                  		;call	cs:bintobcd	; dh = bcd month, al = year
  4066                                  		xchg	dh, al
  4067                                  		call	far [cs:bintobcd]
  4068                                  		;call	cs:bintobcd	; cl = bcd year, al = century
  4069                                  		xchg	cl, al
  4070                                  		call	far [cs:bintobcd]
  4071                                  		;call	cs:bintobcd	; ch = bcd century
  4072                                  		mov	ch, al
  4073                                  		pop	word [cs:daycnt] ; restore original value
  4074                                  		retf
  4075                                  
  4076                                  enddaycnttoday:	
  4077                                  
  4078                                  %endif
  4079

  4083                                  %if 0  
  4084                                  
  4085                                  bin_to_bcd:	; proc far		; real time clock support
  4086                                  
  4087                                  ;convert a binary input in al (less than 63h or 99 decimal)
  4088                                  ;into a bcd value in al. ah destroyed.	
  4089                                  		
  4090                                  		push	cx		
  4091                                  		aam			; al=high digit	bcd, ah=low digit bcd
  4092                                  		mov	cl, 4
  4093                                  		shl	ah, cl		; mov the high digit to	high nibble
  4094                                  		or	al, ah
  4095                                  		pop	cx
  4096                                  		retf
  4097                                  %endif
  4098                                  
  4099                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  4100                                  
  4101                                  ; the k09 requires the routines for reading the clock because of the suspend/
  4102                                  ; resume facility. the system clock needs to be reset after resume.
  4103                                  
  4104                                  ; the following routine is executed at resume time when the system
  4105                                  ; powered on after suspension. it reads the real time clock and
  4106                                  ; resets the system time and date, and then irets.
  4107                                  
  4108                                  ; warning!!! this code will be dynamically relocated by msinit.
  4109                                  
  4110                                  	; 08/08/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 IO.SYS (optimization)
  4111                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMBIO.COM - BIOSDATA:183Eh
  4112                                  int_6Ch:

  4114 000013C0 1F                      		pop	ds

  4121                                  		;push	cs
  4122                                  		;pop	ds
  4123 000013CD 8F06[AA06]              		pop	word [int6c_ret_addr]	; pop off return address
  4124 000013D1 8F06[AC06]              		pop	word [int6c_ret_addr+2]
  4125 000013D5 9D                      		popf
  4126 000013D6 E81300                  		call	read_real_date	; get the date from the clock
  4127 000013D9 FA                      		cli

  4129 000013DE FB                      		sti

  4131 000013E2 FA                      		cli

  4133 000013E5 CD1A                    		int	1Ah		; CLOCK	- SET TIME OF DAY
  4134                                  					; CX:DX	= clock	count
  4135                                  					; Return: time of day set
  4136 000013E7 FB                      		sti
  4137                                  		;jmp	int6c_ret_addr	; long jump
  4138                                  		; 16/10/2022
  4139 000013E8 FF2E[AA06]              		jmp	far [int6c_ret_addr] ; long jump

  4143                                  ;   read_real_date reads real-time clock for date and returns the number

  4148 000013ED 51                      		push	cx

  4154                                  					; midnight

  4344                                  ;   bcd_to_bin converts two bcd nibbles in al (value <= 99.) to

  4353 00001503 D50A                    		aad
  4354 00001505 C3                      		retn

  4447 00001572 80FC0A                  		cmp	ah, 10		; is 10's place in range
  4448 00001575 77DD                    		ja	short bv_error	; jmp out of range

  4467                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------
  4468                                  ;									:
  4469                                  ;	System initialization						:
  4470                                  ;									:
  4471                                  ;	The entry conditions are established by the bootstrap		:
  4472                                  ;	loader and are considered unknown. The following jobs		:
  4473                                  ;	will be performed by this module:				:
  4474                                  ;									:
  4475                                  ;	1.	All device initialization is performed			:
  4476                                  ;	2.	A local stack is set up and DS:SI are set		:
  4477                                  ;		to point to an initialization table. Then		:
  4478                                  ;		an inter-segment call is made to the first		:
  4479                                  ;		byte of the dos 					:
  4480                                  ;	3.	Once the dos returns from this call the ds		:
  4481                                  ;		register has been set up to point to the start		:
  4482                                  ;		of free memory. The initialization will then		:
  4483                                  ;		load the command program into this area 		:
  4484                                  ;		beginning at 100 hex and transfer control to		:
  4485                                  ;		this program.						:
  4486                                  ;									:
  4487                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------

  4748                                  ;	entry point to call utility functions in Bios_Code. At this time,
  4749                                  ;	  we aren't doing any A20 switching. During MSINIT time Bios_Code
  4750                                  ;	  will not yet be moved to its final resting place, so we know
  4751                                  ;	  it'll be low.
  4752                                  ;
  4753                                  ;	to use this function, do a "push cs" and load bp with the offset of
  4754                                  ;	  the function you want to call in Bios_Code. This routine will
  4755                                  ;	  push the address of a retf in Bios_Code onto the stack which
  4756                                  ;	  will get executed when the utility function finishes. It will
  4757                                  ;	  then transfer control to Bios_Code:bp using a couple of pushes
  4758                                  ;	  and a retf

  4791                                  		; MSDOS 6.0 (MSINIT.ASM)
  4792                                  		;=============================================================
  4793                                  		;
  4794                                  		; entry from boot sector. the register contents are:
  4795                                  		;
  4796                                  		;   dl = int 13 drive number we booted from
  4797                                  		;   ch = media byte
  4798                                  		;   bx = first data sector on disk.
  4799                                  		;   ax = first data sector (high)
  4800                                  		;   di = sectors/fat for the boot media.
  4801

  4804                                  		; Retro DOS v2.0 - registers from FD Boot Sector 
  4805                                                  ; DL = [bsDriveNumber]
  4806                                  		; DH = [bsMedia]
  4807                                  		; AX = [bsSectors] ; Total sectors
  4808                                  		; DS = 0, SS = 0
  4809                                  		; BP = 7C00h

  4827                                  ; Note: Retro DOS v4.0 Kernel does not use/contain MSLOAD part of IO.SYS (5.0)
  4828                                  ; 	Because, Retro DOS v2 boot sector loads complete/entire MSDOS.SYS
  4829                                  ;	(RETRODOS.SYS) Kernel file (IO.SYS & MSDOS.SYS together).
  4830                                  ;	As result of boot sector ve init differences, Retro DOS init code (here)
  4831                                  ;	moves kernel to segment 070h at first, then sets diskette parameters
  4832                                  ;	at segment 50h (while MSDOS 5.0 boot sector sets this).
  4833                                  ; ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  4836                                  
  4837                                  ;	msload passes a 32 bit sector number hi word in ax and low in bx
  4838                                  ;	save this in cs:bios_h and cs:bios_l. this is for the start of
  4839                                  ;	data sector of the bios.

  4939                                  ; we have to support a system that does not have any diskette
  4940                                  ; drives but only hardfiles. this system will ipl from the hardfile.
  4941                                  ; if the equipment flag bit 0 is 1, then the system has diskette drive(s).
  4942                                  ; otherwise, the system has only hardfiles.
  4943                                  ;
  4944                                  ; important thing is that still, for compatibility reason, the drive letter
  4945                                  ; for the hardfiles start from "c". so, we still need to allocate dummy bds
  4946                                  ; drive a and drive b. at sysinit time, we are going to set cds table entry
  4947                                  ; of dpb pointer for these drives to 0, so any user attempt to access this
  4948                                  ; drives will get "invalid drive letter ..." message. we are going to
  4949                                  ; establish "fakefloppydrv" flag. ***sysinit module should call int 11h to
  4950                                  ; determine whether there are any diskette drivers in the system or not.!!!***
  4951                                  
  4952                                  ; check the register returned by the equipment determination interrupt
  4953                                  ; we have to handle the case of no diskettes in the system by faking
  4954                                  ; two dummy drives.
  4955                                  ;
  4956                                  ; if the register indicates that we do have floppy drives we don't need
  4957                                  ; to do anything special.
  4958                                  ;
  4959                                  ; if the register indicates that we don't have any floppy drives then
  4960                                  ; what we need to do is set the fakefloppydrv variable, change the
  4961                                  ; register to say that we do have floppy drives and then go to execute
  4962                                  ; the code which starts at notsingle. this is because we can skip the
  4963                                  ; code given below which tries to find if there are one or two drives
  4964                                  ; since we already know about this.
  4965

  6381                                  ;******************************************************************************
  6382                                  ; module name: remap
  6383                                  ;
  6384                                  ; descriptive name: all the code for himem that could be separated from msbio
  6385                                  ;
  6386                                  ; function:  remap the bds chain to adjusted logical drive numbers (drive
  6387                                  ;	     letters) if more than two diskette drives on the system.
  6388                                  ;
  6389                                  ;     scheme:  if more than 2 diskette drives, first map the bds structure
  6390                                  ;	       as usual and then rescan the bds chain to adjust the drive
  6391                                  ;	       letters. to do this, scan for disk drives and assign logical
  6392                                  ;	       drive number starting from 2 and then rescan diskette drives
  6393                                  ;	       and assign next to the last logical drive number of last disk
  6394                                  ;	       drive to the 3rd and 4th diskette drives.
  6395                                  
  6396                                  ; input:       none
  6397                                  ; exit:	drive letters have been remapped in bds chain
  6398                                  ; exit error:  none
  6399                                  ; called from: msinit
  6400                                  ;
  6401                                  ; notes:  this function  will be called only if more than 2 diskettes are
  6402                                  ;	  found in the system
  6403                                  ;	  this function assumes that there are no more than 26 drives assigned
  6404                                  ;	    this is guaranteed by the code that creates bdss for partitions
  6405                                  ;	  this function assumes that the first entries in the chain are
  6406                                  ;	   floppy drives, and all the rest are hard drives
  6407                                  ;	  will alter the boot drive if necessary to reflect remapping
  6408                                  ;
  6409                                  ;******************************************************************************
  6410                                  
  6411                                  ; 17/10/2022
  6412                                  ; 02/10/2022
  6413                                  		; 15/12/2023 - Retro DOS v5.0 (PCDOS 7.1) IBMBIO.COM
  6414                                  		; (PCDOS 7.1 IBMBIO.COM - BIOSDATA:2464h)
  6415                                  		; (MSDOS 6.22 IO.SYS - BIOSDATA:1D9Eh)
  6416                                  
  6417                                  remap:		; proc near
  6418                                  
  6419                                  		; 15/12/2023
  6420                                  		; ds = cs
  6421                                  		;mov	di, [cs:start_bds] ; get first bds
  6422 00001B13 8B3E[1901]              		mov	di, [start_bds]
  6423                                  
  6424                                  ; search for 1st fixed disk physical drive num
  6425                                  
  6426                                  drive_loop:
  6427 00001B17 807D0480                		cmp	byte [di+4], 80h ; [di+BDS.drivenum]
  6428                                  					; first	hard disk??
  6429 00001B1B 7409                    		jz	short fdrv_found ; yes,	continue
  6430 00001B1D 8B3D                    		mov	di, [di]	; [di+BDS.link]
  6431                                  					; get next bds,	assume segment
  6432 00001B1F 83FFFF                  		cmp	di, -1 ; 0FFFFh	; last bds?
  6433 00001B22 75F3                    		jnz	short drive_loop ; loop	if not
  6434 00001B24 EB49                    		jmp	short rmap_exit	; yes, no hard drive on	system
  6435                                  
  6436                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  6437                                  ;first disk drive bds, now change the logical drive num to 2 and the subsequent
  6438                                  ;logical drive nums to 3, 4, 5 etc.
  6439                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  6440                                  
  6441                                  fdrv_found:
  6442 00001B26 B002                    		mov	al, 2		; start	with logical drv num=2
  6443                                  fdrv_loop:
  6444 00001B28 884505                  		mov	[di+5],	al	; [di+BDS.drivelet]
  6445 00001B2B 8B3D                    		mov	di, [di]	; [di+BDS.link]
  6446                                  					; ds:di--> next	bds
  6447                                  		;inc	al		; set num for next drive
  6448                                  		; 18/12/2022
  6449 00001B2D 40                      		inc	ax
  6450 00001B2E 83FFFF                  		cmp	di, 0FFFFh	; last hard drive ?
  6451 00001B31 75F5                    		jnz	short fdrv_loop	; no - assign more disk drives
  6452                                  
  6453                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  6454                                  ; now, rescan and find bds of 3rd floppy drive and assign next drive letter
  6455                                  ; in al to 3rd. if the current drive letter is past z, then do not allocate
  6456                                  ; any more.
  6457                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  6458                                  
  6459                                  		;mov	di, [cs:start_bds] ; [start_bds]
  6460                                  		; 15/12/2023
  6461 00001B33 8B3E[1901]              		mov	di, [start_bds]	; get first bds
  6462 00001B37 8B3D                    		mov	di, [di]	; [di+BDS.link]
  6463                                  					; ds:di-->bds2
  6464                                  		;mov	ah, [cs:dsktnum] ; get number of floppies to remap
  6465 00001B39 8A26[2501]              		mov	ah, [dsktnum]
  6466 00001B3D 80EC02                  		sub	ah, 2		; adjust for a:	& b:
  6467                                  remap_loop1:
  6468 00001B40 8B3D                    		mov	di, [di]	; [di+BDS.link]
  6469                                  					; set new num to next floppy
  6470 00001B42 884505                  		mov	[di+5],	al	; [di+BDS.drivelet]
  6471 00001B45 FEC0                    		inc	al		; new number for next floppy
  6472 00001B47 FECC                    		dec	ah		; count down extra floppies
  6473 00001B49 75F5                    		jnz	short remap_loop1
  6474                                  
  6475                                  ; now we've got to adjust the boot drive if we reassigned it
  6476                                  
  6477                                  		; 15/12/2023
  6478                                  		;mov	al, [cs:drvfat]
  6479 00001B4B A0[7E15]                		mov	al, [drvfat]

  6481 00001B50 721D                    		jb	short rmap_exit

  6484 00001B56 7204                    		jb	short remap_boot_flop ;	brif so
  6485

  6491                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  6492

  6494                                  ; add the number of hard drive partitions to it
  6495                                  
  6496                                  remap_boot_flop:

  6498                                  		; 15/12/2023
  6499 00001B5C 0206[7500]              		add	al, [drvmax]
  6500                                  remap_change_boot_drv:			
  6501                                  		;mov	[cs:drvfat], al ; alter msdos.sys load drive
  6502 00001B60 A2[7E15]                		mov	[drvfat], al
  6503 00001B63 FEC0                    		inc	al
  6504 00001B65 1E                      		push	ds
  6505 00001B66 BF3A04                  		mov	di, SYSINITSEG	; 46Dh
  6506                                  		;mov	di, 544h	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMBIO.COM

  6513                                  rmap_exit:

  6541                                  		; 08/04/2018

  6543                                  		; 28/03/2018 - MSDOS 6.0 - MSINIT.ASM, 1991
  6544                                  		; 02/10/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0

  6561                                  					; DH = head, DL	= drive, ES:BX -> buffer to fill

  6563 00001B82 7209                    		jb	short erret

  6587 00001B9A 3C06                    		cmp	al, 6		; FAT16 BIG CHS (> 32MB)
  6588                                  chk_ptype_retn:
  6589                                  		; zf = 1 -> primary DOS partition
  6590                                  		; zf = 0 -> not a primary DOS partition
  6591 00001B9C C3                      		retn
  6592                                  
  6593                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
  6594                                  
  6595                                  ; 28/12/2018 - Retro DOS v4.0 
  6596                                  
  6597                                  ;***************************************************************************
  6598                                  ;   sethard - generate bpb for a variable sized hard file. ibm has a
  6599                                  ;   partitioned hard file; we must read physical sector 0 to determine where
  6600                                  ;   our own logical sectors start. we also read in our boot sector to
  6601                                  ;   determine version number
  6602                                  ;
  6603                                  ;   inputs:	dl is rom drive number (80...)
  6604                                  ;		bh is partition number (0....) 
  6605                                  ;		ds:di points to bds
  6606                                  ;   outputs:	carry clear -> bpb is filled in
  6607                                  ;		carry set   -> bpb is left uninitialized due to error
  6608                                  ;	trashes (at least) si, cx
  6609                                  ;	MUST PRESERVE ES:!!!!
  6610                                  ;***************************************************************************
  6611                                  
  6612                                  sethard:	; proc near
  6613                                  		; 16/12/2023
  6614                                  		; 12/08/2023
  6615                                  		; ds = cs = BIOSDATA
  6616 00001B9D 57                      		push	di
  6617 00001B9E 53                      		push	bx
  6618                                  		;push	ds  ; ds = cs = BIOSDATA ; 14/08/2023
  6619 00001B9F 06                      		push	es
  6620 00001BA0 885D05                  		mov	[di+5],	bl	; [di+BDS.drivelet]
  6621 00001BA3 885504                  		mov	[di+4],	dl	; [di+BDS.drivenum]
  6622 00001BA6 804D2301                		or	byte [di+23h], 1 ; [di+BDS.flags]
  6623                                  					; fnon_removable

  6625                                  					; ffHardFile

  6631                                  					; DL = drive number
  6632                                  					; Return: CF set on error, AH =	status code, BL	= drive	type
  6633                                  					; DL = number of consecutive drives

  6635 00001BBA FEC6                    		inc	dh

  6644 00001BCD 723C                    		jb	short setret

  6646                                  
  6647                                  ; The first 'active' partition is 00, the second is 01....
  6648                                  ;   then the remainder of the 'primary' but non-active partitions
  6649                                  
  6650                                  act_part:

  6652 00001BD7 740B                    		jz	short no_act	; no
  6653                                  ; 16/12/2023
  6654                                  %if 0
  6655                                  		cmp	byte [es:bx], 1 ; reject if partitiontype != 1, 4 or 6
  6656                                  		jz	short got_good_act
  6657                                  		cmp	byte [es:bx], 4
  6658                                  		jz	short got_good_act
  6659                                  		cmp	byte [es:bx], 6
  6660                                  		jnz	short no_act
  6661                                  %endif

  6663                                  		; check if it is a primary dos partition

  6666 00001BDC 7506                    		jne	short no_act

  6670 00001BE0 742D                    		jz	short set2	; WE GOT THE ONE WANTED!!

  6681

  6689                                  		jz	short got_prim
  6690                                  		cmp	byte [es:bx], 4
  6691                                  		jz	short got_prim
  6692                                  		cmp	byte [es:bx], 6
  6693                                  		jnz	short not_prim
  6694                                  %endif

  6696                                  		; check if it is a primary dos partition

  6700                                  
  6701                                  got_prim:

  6703 00001BFE 740F                    		jz	short set2

  6710 00001C0B F9                      		stc			; error	return

  6713                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  6714                                  
  6715                                  ;  until we get the real logical boot record and get the bpb,
  6716                                  ;  BDS_BPB.BPB_BIGTOTALSECTORS will be used instead of BDS_BPB.BPB_TOTALSECTORS
  6717                                  ;  for the convenience of the computation.
  6718                                  ;
  6719                                  ;  at the end of this procedure, if a bpb information is gotten from
  6720                                  ;  the valid boot record, then we are going to use those bpb information
  6721                                  ;  without change.
  6722                                  ;
  6723                                  ;  otherwise, if (hidden sectors + total sectors) <= a word, then we will move
  6724                                  ;  BDS_BPB.BPB_BIGTOTALSECTORS (low) to BDS_BPB.BPB_TOTALSECTORS and zero out

  6737                                  ; sectors should be allowed

  6745                                  okdrive:

  6851                                  ; for convenience, we are going to read the logical boot sector
