  7904                                  
  7905                                  ; domini **********************************************************************
  7906                                  ;
  7907                                  ;mini disk initialization routine. called right after dohard
  7908                                  ;modified for >2 hardfile support
  7909                                  ;
  7910                                  ; **cs=ds=es=datagrp
  7911                                  ;
  7912                                  ; **domini will search for every extended partition in the system, and
  7913                                  ;   initialize it.
  7914                                  ;
  7915                                  ; **bdsm stands for bds table for mini disk and located right after the label
  7916                                  ;   end96tpi. end_of_bdsm will have the offset value of the ending
  7917                                  ;   address of bdsm table.
  7918                                  ;
  7919                                  ; **bdsm is the same as usual bds structure except that tim_lo, tim_hi entries
  7920                                  ;   are overlapped and used to identify mini disk and the number of hidden_trks.
  7921                                  ;   right now, they are called as ismini, hidden_trks respectively.
  7922                                  ;
  7923                                  ; **domini will use the same routine in sethard routine after label set2 to
  7924                                  ;   save coding.
  7925                                  ;
  7926                                  ; **drvmax determined in dohard routine will be used for the next
  7927                                  ;   available logical mini disk drive number.
  7928                                  ;
  7929                                  ; input: drvmax, dskdrvs
  7930                                  ;
  7931                                  ; output: minidisk installed. bdsm table established and installed to bds.
  7932                                  ;	  end_of_bdsm - ending offset address of bdsm.
  7933                                  ;
  7934                                  ; called modules:
  7935                                  ;		  getboot
  7936                                  ;		  find_mini_partition (new), xinstall_bds (new), M038
  7937                                  ;
  7938                                  ;		  setmini (new, it will use set2 routine)
  7939                                  ;
  7940                                  ; variables used: end_of_bdsm
  7941                                  ;		  rom_minidisk_num
  7942                                  ;		  mini_hdlim, mini_seclim
  7943                                  ;		  BDS_STRUC, start_bds
  7944                                  ;
  7945                                  ;******************************************************************************
  7946                                  
  7947                                  		; 18/12/2023
  7948                                  		; 19/10/2022
  7949                                  domini:
  7950 00001F95 8A36[0316]              		mov	dh, [hnum]	; get number of hardfiles
  7951                                  		; 10/12/2022
  7952 00001F99 20F6                    		and	dh, dh
  7953                                  		;cmp	dh, 0
  7954 00001F9B 742E                    		jz	short dominiret	; no hard file?	then exit.
  7955 00001F9D B280                    		mov	dl, 80h		; start	with hardfile 80h
  7956                                  domini_loop:				
  7957 00001F9F 52                      		push	dx
  7958 00001FA0 8816[0216]              		mov	[rom_minidisk_num], dl
  7959 00001FA4 B408                    		mov	ah, 8
  7960 00001FA6 CD13                    		int	13h		; DISK - DISK -	GET CURRENT DRIVE PARAMETERS (XT,AT,XT286,CONV,PS)
  7961                                  					; DL = drive number
  7962                                  					; Return: CF set on error, AH =	status code, BL	= drive	type
  7963                                  					; DL = number of consecutive drives
  7964                                  					; DH = maximum value for head number, ES:DI -> drive parameter
  7965                                  		
  7966                                  		; 08/08/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 IO.SYS (optimization)
  7967                                  		; PCDOS 7.1 IBMBIO.COM - BIOSDATA:2B36h
  7968                                  		;inc	dh
  7969                                  		;xor	ax, ax
  7970                                  		;mov	al, dh
  7971 00001FA8 31C0                    		xor	ax, ax
  7972 00001FAA 88F0                    		mov	al, dh	; <= 255
  7973 00001FAC 40                      		inc	ax	; (0FFh -> 100h)
  7974 00001FAD A3[0816]                		mov	[mini_hdlim], ax ; # of heads
  7975                                  		;and	cl, 3Fh
  7976                                  		;mov	al, cl
  7977                                  		; 08/08/2023
  7978 00001FB0 88C8                    		mov	al, cl
  7979 00001FB2 83E03F                  		and	ax, 3Fh
  7980 00001FB5 A3[0A16]                		mov	[mini_seclim], ax ; # of sectors/track
  7981                                  
  7982                                  		; 18/12/2023
  7983                                  		;push	es ; * ; not necessary
  7984 00001FB8 8A16[0216]              		mov	dl, [rom_minidisk_num]
  7985 00001FBC E8B1FB                  		call	getboot		; read master boot record into
  7986                                  					; initbootsegment:bootbias
  7987 00001FBF 7203                    		jc	short domininext
  7988 00001FC1 E80800                  		call	find_mini_partition
  7989                                  domininext:
  7990                                  		;pop	es ; *
  7991 00001FC4 5A                      		pop	dx
  7992 00001FC5 FEC2                    		inc	dl		; next hard file
  7993 00001FC7 FECE                    		dec	dh
  7994 00001FC9 75D4                    		jnz	short domini_loop
  7995                                  dominiret:
  7996 00001FCB C3                      		retn

  7999                                  
  8000                                  ; 15/10/2022 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)
  8001                                  ; 30/12/2018 - Retro DOS v4.0
  8002                                  
  8003                                  ;find_mini_partition tries to find every extended partition on a disk.
  8004                                  ;at entry:	di -> bdsm entry
  8005                                  ;		es:bx -> 07c0:bootbias - master boot record
  8006                                  ;		rom_minidisk_num - rom drive number
  8007                                  ;		drvmax - logical drive number
  8008                                  ;		mini_hdlim, mini_seclim

  8016                                  fmpnext:

  8018 00001FD4 740A                    		jz	short fmpgot

  8020 00001FD9 81FB0204                		cmp	bx, 402h	; 202h+bootbias
  8021 00001FDD 75F1                    		jnz	short fmpnext

  8025 00001FDF C3                      		retn

  8027                                  ;		; 30/07/2019 - Retro DOS v3.2

  8030                                  ;		retn	; 29/05/2019
  8031                                  
  8032                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  8033                                  
  8034                                  		; 19/10/2022

  8060                                  					; only lower word is meaningful.

  8233 000020D2 50                      		push	ax
  8234 000020D3 51                      		push	cx
  8235 000020D4 52                      		push	dx

  8243                                  					; Return: CH = hours in	BCD
  8244                                  					; CL = minutes in BCD
  8245                                  					; DH = seconds in BCD

  8253 000020F0 B90040                  		mov	cx, 4000h	; 16384

  8267                                  					; post routine did not restore that.

  8280                                  cmosck9:	; 19/12/2023
  8281 0000210E C3                      		retn
  8282                                  
  8283                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  8284                                  
  8285                                  ; the following code is written by jack gulley in engineering group.
  8286                                  ; cp dos (CP/DOS, OS/2) is changing cmos clock rate for its own purposes
  8287                                  ; and if the use cold boot the system to use pc dos while running cp dos,
  8288                                  ; the cmos clock rate are still slow which slow down disk operations
  8289                                  ; of pc dos which uses cmos clock. pc dos is put this code in msinit
  8290                                  ; to fix this problem at the request of cp dos.
  8291                                  ;
  8292                                  ; the program is modified to be run on msinit. equates are defined
  8293                                  ; in cmosequ.inc. this program will be called by cmos_clock_read procedure.
  8294                                  ;
  8295                                  ;  the following code cmosck is used to insure that the cmos has not
  8296                                  ;	had its rate controls left in an invalid state on older at's.
  8297                                  ;
  8298                                  ;	it checks for an at model byte "fc" with a submodel type of
  8299                                  ;	00, 01, 02, 03 or 06 and resets the periodic interrupt rate
  8300                                  ;	bits in case post has not done it. this initialization routine
  8301                                  ;	is only needed once when dos loads. it should be run as soon
  8302                                  ;	as possible to prevent slow diskette access.
  8303                                  ;
  8304                                  ;	this code exposes one to dos clearing cmos setup done by a
  8305                                  ;	resident program that hides and re-boots the system.
  8306                                  
  8307                                  cmosck:					; check and reset rtc rate bits
  8308                                  
  8309                                  ;model byte and submodel byte were already determined in msinit.
  8310                                  
  8311                                  	; 16/06/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
  8312                                  	; 19/03/2018 (Model: 0FCh, Sub Model: 01h, REF: AMIBIOS Prog. Guide)
  8313                                  
  8314                                  		; 19/12/2023
  8315                                  		; ds = cs
  8316                                  		;push	ax ; not necessary ; 19/12/2023
  8317                                  		;
  8318 0000210F 803E[2D06]FC            		cmp	byte [model_byte], 0FCh
  8319                                  		;cmp	byte [cs:model_byte], 0FCh
  8320 00002114 75F8                    		jnz	short cmosck9	; Exit if not an AT model
  8321 00002116 803E[2E06]06            		cmp	byte [secondary_model_byte], 6 ; 21/04/2024
  8322                                  		;cmp	byte [cs:secondary_model_byte], 6
  8323                                  					; Is it 06 for the industral AT ?
  8324 0000211B 7407                    		jz	short cmosck4	; Go reset CMOS periodic rate if 06
  8325 0000211D 803E[2E06]04            		cmp	byte [secondary_model_byte], 4
  8326                                  		;cmp	byte [cs:secondary_model_byte], 4
  8327                                  					; Is it 00, 01, 02, or 03 ?
  8328 00002122 73EA                    		jnb	short cmosck9	; EXIT if problem fixed by POST
  8329                                  					; Also,Secondary_model_byte = 0
  8330                                  					;   when AH=0C0h, int 15h failed.
  8331                                  					;	RESET THE CMOS PERIODIC RATE
  8332                                  					;  Model=FC submodel=00,01,02,03 or 06
  8333                                  cmosck4:
  8334 00002124 B08A                    		mov	al, 8Ah		; cmos_reg_a|nmi
  8335                                  					; NMI disabled on return
  8336 00002126 B426                    		mov	ah, 26h		; 00100110b
  8337                                  					; Set divider & rate selection
  8338 00002128 E80B00                  		call	cmos_write
  8339 0000212B B08B                    		mov	al, 8Bh		; cmos_reg_b|nmi
  8340                                  					; NMI disabled on return
  8341 0000212D E82000                  		call	cmos_read
  8342 00002130 2407                    		and	al, 7		; 00000111b
  8343                                  					; clear SET,PIE,AIE,UIE,SQWE
  8344 00002132 88C4                    		mov	ah, al
  8345 00002134 B00B                    		mov	al, 0Bh		; cmos_reg_b
  8346                                  					; NMI enabled on return
  8347                                  		; 19/12/2023
  8348                                  		;call	cmos_write
  8349                                  ;cmosck9:
  8350                                  		;pop	ax ; 19/12/2023
  8351                                  		;retn
  8352                                  
  8353                                  		; 19/12/2023
  8354                                  		;jmp	short cmos_write
  8355                                  
  8356                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
  8357                                  
  8358                                  ;--- cmos_write ----------------------------------------------------------------
  8359                                  ;		write byte to cmos system clock configuration table	       :
  8360                                  ;									       :
  8361                                  ; input: (al)=	cmos table address to be written to			       :
  8362                                  ;		bit    7 = 0 for nmi enabled and 1 for nmi disabled on exit    :
  8363                                  ;		bits 6-0 = address of table location to write		       :
  8364                                  ;	 (ah)=	new value to be placed in the addressed table location	       :
  8365                                  ;									       :
  8366                                  ; output:	value in (ah) placed in location (al) with nmi left disabled   :
  8367                                  ;		if bit 7 of (al) is on. during the cmos update both nmi and    :
  8368                                  ;		normal interrupts are disabled to protect cmos data integrity. :
  8369                                  ;		the cmos address register is pointed to a default value and    :
  8370                                  ;		the interrupt flag restored to the entry state on return.      :
  8371                                  ;		only the cmos location and the nmi state is changed.	       :
  8372                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  8373                                  
  8374                                  cmos_write:				; write (ah) to location (al)
  8375 00002136 9C                      		pushf			;
  8376 00002137 50                      		push	ax		; save work register values
  8377 00002138 FA                      		cli
  8378 00002139 50                      		push	ax		; save user nmi	state
  8379 0000213A 0C80                    		or	al, 80h		; disable nmi for us
  8380 0000213C E670                    		out	70h, al		; CMOS Memory/RTC Index	Register:
  8381                                  					; RTC Seconds
  8382 0000213E 90                      		nop
  8383 0000213F 88E0                    		mov	al, ah
  8384 00002141 E671                    		out	71h, al		; CMOS Memory/RTC Data Register
  8385 00002143 58                      		pop	ax		; get user nmi
  8386 00002144 2480                    		and	al, 80h
  8387 00002146 0C0F                    		or	al, 0Fh
  8388 00002148 E670                    		out	70h, al		; CMOS Memory/RTC Index	Register:
  8389                                  					; RTC Seconds
  8390 0000214A 90                      		nop
  8391 0000214B E471                    		in	al, 71h		; CMOS Memory/RTC Data Register
  8392 0000214D 58                      		pop	ax		; restore work registers
  8393                                  
  8394                                  		; 19/12/2023
  8395                                  		;push	cs		; *place code segment in stack and
  8396                                  		;call	cmos_popf	; *handle popf for b- level 80286
  8397                                  		;retn
  8398 0000214E EB18                    		jmp	short cmos_rw_popf
  8399                                  
  8400                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
  8401                                  
  8402                                  ;--- CMOS_READ -----------------------------------------------------------------
  8403                                  ;		read byte from cmos system clock configuration table	       :
  8404                                  ;									       :
  8405                                  ; input: (al)=	cmos table address to be read				       :
  8406                                  ;		bit    7 = 0 for nmi enabled and 1 for nmi disabled on exit    :
  8407                                  ;		bits 6-0 = address of table location to read		       :
  8408                                  ;									       :
  8409                                  ; output: (al)	value at location (al) moved into (al). if bit 7 of (al) was   :
  8410                                  ;		on then nmi left disabled. during the cmos read both nmi and  :
  8411                                  ;		normal interrupts are disabled to protect cmos data integrity. :
  8412                                  ;		the cmos address register is pointed to a default value and    :
  8413                                  ;		the interrupt flag restored to the entry state on return.      :
  8414                                  ;		only the (al) register and the nmi state is changed.	       :
  8415                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  8416                                  
  8417                                  cmos_read:				; read location (al) into (al)
  8418 00002150 9C                      		pushf
  8419 00002151 FA                      		cli
  8420 00002152 53                      		push	bx

  8424 00002155 0C80                    		or	al, 80h
  8425 00002157 E670                    		out	70h, al		; CMOS Memory/RTC Index	Register:
  8426                                  					; RTC Seconds
  8427 00002159 90                      		nop			; (undocumented delay needed)
  8428 0000215A E471                    		in	al, 71h		; CMOS Memory/RTC Data Register
  8429                                  		
  8430                                  		;mov	bx, ax ; output
  8431                                  		;pop	ax ; * ; input
  8432                                  
  8433                                  		; 19/12/2023
  8434                                  		; al = output, bl = input

  8436                                  		; bl = output, al = input
  8437                                  	
  8438 0000215D 2480                    		and	al, 80h
  8439 0000215F 0C0F                    		or	al, 0Fh
  8440 00002161 E670                    		out	70h, al		; CMOS Memory/RTC Index	Register:
  8441                                  					; RTC Seconds
  8442 00002163 90                      		nop
  8443 00002164 E471                    		in	al, 71h		; CMOS Memory/RTC Data Register
  8444                                  		;mov	ax, bx ; * ; output

  8470                                  ;  at once -as single kernel file- by the Retro DOS boot sector code.
  8471                                  ;  So, following disk reads -MSDOS.SYS loading- is not needed!
  8472                                  ;  Only needing is to move MSDOS Kernel to it's final memory location.)

  8476                                  ; GetClus, read in a cluster at a specified address
  8477                                  ;
  8478                                  ;  bx = cluster to read
  8479                                  ;  cx = sectors per cluster
  8480                                  ;  es:di = load location
  8481                                  
  8482                                  ; 17/10/2022
  8483                                  ;DISKRD equ diskrd - DOSBIOSEG_2C7h	; (8E5h for MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)
  8484                                  ; 09/12/2022
  8485                                  DISKRD equ diskrd

  8487                                  		; 17/10/2022
  8488                                  getclus:
  8489                                  		; 13/12/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.22 IO.SYS)
  8490                                  		; ds = cs
  8491

  8493 0000216F 57                      		push	di

  8498 00002177 48                      		dec	ax

  8500                                  					; dx:ax	= matching logical sector number
  8501                                  					;	  starting from the data sector
  8502                                  		;add	ax, [cs:bios_l]
  8503                                  		;adc	dx, [cs:bios_h]	; dx:ax	= first	logical	sector to read
  8504                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8505 0000217A 0306[8015]              		add	ax, [bios_l]
  8506 0000217E 1316[8215]              		adc	dx, [bios_h]	; dx:ax	= first	logical	sector to read
  8507                                  unpack:					
  8508 00002182 1E                      		push	ds ; ds = cs ; 13/12/2023
  8509 00002183 52                      		push	dx ; * ; 13/12/2023
  8510 00002184 50                      		push	ax
  8511 00002185 53                      		push	bx
  8512                                  		;mov	si, [cs:fatloc]
  8513 00002186 8B36[8715]              		mov	si, [fatloc] ; 13/12/2023

  8515 0000218C 89DE                    		mov	si, bx		; next cluster
  8516 0000218E 2EF606[8615]40          		test	byte [cs:fbigfat], 40h	; fbig
  8517                                  					; 16 bit fat?
  8518 00002194 752F                    		jnz	short unpack16	; yes

  8520                                  					; si = clus + clus/2

  8555 000021AB 8A260000                		mov	ah, [0] ; high 4 bits (bits 7 to 11) of 12 bits cluster num
  8556                                  even_odd:

  8558 000021B0 53                      		push	bx		; save it right	away.
  8559 000021B1 D1EB                    		shr	bx, 1		; was it even or odd?
  8560 000021B3 7308                    		jnb	short havclus	; it was even.
  8561 000021B5 D1E8                    		shr	ax, 1		; odd. massage fat value and keep
  8562                                  					; the highest 12 bits.
  8563 000021B7 D1E8                    		shr	ax, 1
  8564 000021B9 D1E8                    		shr	ax, 1
  8565 000021BB D1E8                    		shr	ax, 1

  8568 000021BF 81E3FF0F                		and	bx, 0FFFh	; keep low 12 bits.

  8571

  8576                                  		;adc	dx, 0

  8585                                  					; bx = new fat entry.
  8586                                  unpackx:

  8588 000021D1 58                      		pop	ax		; restore logical sector (low)
  8589 000021D2 5A                      		pop	dx ; * ; 13/12/2023
  8590 000021D3 1F                      		pop	ds
  8591                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8592                                  		; (this is a fast kernel loading method by the MSDOS programmer)
  8593                                  		; ((consequtive clusters --> consequtive sectors))
  8594                                  		; ds = cs

  8649                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
  8650                                  
  8651                                  ;function: find and read the corresponding fat sector into ds:0
  8652                                  ;
  8653                                  ;in). dx:si - offset value (starting from fat entry 0) of fat entry to find. M054
  8654                                  ;     ds - fatloc segment
  8655                                  ;     cs:drvfat - logical drive number, fat id
  8656                                  ;     cs:md_sectorsize
  8657                                  ;     cs:last_fat_secnum - last fat sector number read in.
  8658                                  ;
  8659                                  ;out). corresponding fat sector read in.
  8660                                  ;      bx = offset value from fatlog segment.
  8661                                  ;      other registera saved.
  8662                                  ;      zero flag set if the fat entry is splitted, i.e., when 12 bit fat entry
  8663                                  ;      starts at the last byte of the fat sector. in this case, the caller
  8664                                  ;      should save this byte, and read the next fat sector to get the rest
  8665                                  ;      of the fat entry value. (this will only happen with the 12 bit fat.)
  8666                                  
  8667                                  		; 17/10/2022
  8668                                  get_fat_sector:	
  8669                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8670                                  		; ds = fat buffer segment
  8671                                  
  8672                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8673                                  		;push	ax ; (not necessary)
  8674 00002204 51                      		push	cx ; read count (sectors per cluster)
  8675 00002205 57                      		push	di ; IBMDOS.COM/MSDOS.SYS load offset
  8676 00002206 56                      		push	si ; FAT offset value (from fat entry 0)
  8677 00002207 06                      		push	es ; IBMDOS.COM/MSDOS.SYS load segment
  8678 00002208 1E                      		push	ds ; FAT buffer segment
  8679                                  
  8680                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8681 00002209 0E                      		push	cs
  8682 0000220A 1F                      		pop	ds
  8683                                  
  8684 0000220B 89F0                    		mov	ax, si
  8685                                  		;;mov	cx, [cs:md_sectorsize] ; 512
  8686                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8687                                  		;mov	cx, [md_sectorsize] ; 512
  8688                                  		;div	cx		; ax = sector number, dx = offset
  8689                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8690                                  		;nop
  8691                                  
  8692                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8693 0000220D F736[8C15]              		div	word [md_sectorsize] ; 512
  8694                                  
  8695                                  		; ax = FAT sector (sequence/index) number
  8696                                  		; dx = cluster number offset
  8697                                  
  8698                                  		; Get rid of the assumption that
  8699                                  		; there	is only	one reserved sector
  8700                                  
  8701                                  		; 13/12/2023 ; *
  8702                                  		;push	es ; *
  8703                                  		;push	ds ; *
  8704                                  		;push	di ; *

  8706                                  		;push	cs ; *
  8707                                  		;pop	ds ; *
  8708

  8710                                  		; 13/12/2023

  8712 00002215 BD[6A05]                		mov	bp, SETDRIVE
  8713                                  		;;mov	bp, 4D7h	; setdrive
  8714                                  					; at 2C7h:4D7h = 70h:2A47h
  8715 00002218 0E                      		push	cs		; simulate far call
  8716 00002219 E8FBF3                  		call	call_bios_code	; get bds for drive
  8717 0000221C 58                      		pop	ax		; (sector number -without reserved and hidden sectors-)
  8718 0000221D 26034509                		add	ax, [es:di+9]	; [es:di+BDS.resectors]
  8719                                  					; add #reserved_sectors
  8720                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8721                                  		;pop	di ; *
  8722                                  		;pop	ds ; *
  8723                                  		;pop	es ; *
  8724                                  
  8725                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8726                                  		; ds = cs
  8727 00002221 3B06[8E15]              		cmp	ax, [last_fat_sec_num]
  8728                                  		;cmp	ax, [cs:last_fat_sec_num]
  8729 00002225 741C                    		jz	short gfs_split_chk ; don't need to read it again.
  8730 00002227 A3[8E15]                		mov	[last_fat_sec_num], ax
  8731                                  		;mov	[cs:last_fat_sec_num], ax
  8732                                  					; sector number
  8733                                  					; (in the partition, without hidden sectors)
  8734                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8735 0000222A 07                      		pop	es ; FAT buffer segment (DS on top of the stack)
  8736 0000222B 06                      		push	es ; (put it on top of the stack again)
  8737                                  
  8738 0000222C 52                      		push	dx ; cluster number offset
  8739                                  
  8740                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8741 0000222D 31C9                    		xor	cx, cx
  8742 0000222F 890E[1C05]              		mov	[start_sec_h], cx ;0 
  8743                                  		;mov	word [cs:start_sec_h], 0 
  8744                                  					; prepare to read the fat sector
  8745                                  					; start_sec_h is always	0 for fat sector.
  8746 00002233 89C2                    		mov	dx, ax
  8747                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8748 00002235 41                      		inc	cx ; cx = 1
  8749                                  		;mov	cx, 1		; 1 sector read
  8750                                  		;mov	ax, [cs:drvfat]
  8751 00002236 A1[7E15]                		mov	ax, [drvfat]
  8752                                  		;push	ds
  8753                                  		;pop	es
  8754                                  
  8755 00002239 31FF                    		xor	di, di	; 0	; es:di	-> fatloc segment:0
  8756

  8758                                  		;push	ds
  8759                                  		;push	cs
  8760                                  		;pop	ds
  8761

  8763 0000223C BD[4E09]                		mov	bp, DISKRD	; 8E5h
  8764                                  		;mov	bp, 8E5h	; offset diskrd
  8765                                  					; 2C7h:8E5h = 70h:2E55h
  8766 0000223F E8D5F3                  		call	call_bios_code
  8767                                  
  8768                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8769                                  		;pop	ds
  8770                                  		; ds = cs = biosdata segment
  8771                                  
  8772 00002242 5A                      		pop	dx ; cluster number offset 
  8773                                  
  8774                                  gfs_split_chk:
  8775                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8776                                  		;mov	cx, [cs:md_sectorsize] ; 512
  8777 00002243 8B0E[8C15]              		mov	cx, [md_sectorsize]
  8778                                  ;gfs_split_chk:				
  8779 00002247 49                      		dec	cx		; 511
  8780 00002248 39CA                    		cmp	dx, cx		; if offset points to the
  8781                                  					; last byte of this sector,
  8782                                  					; then splitted	entry.
  8783 0000224A 89D3                    		mov	bx, dx		; set bx to dx
  8784                                  		
  8785                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8786                                  		; bx = dx = cluster number offset in the FAT buffer
  8787 0000224C 1F                      		pop	ds ; FAT buffer segment
  8788 0000224D 07                      		pop	es ; IBMDOS.COM/MSDOS.SYS load segment
  8789 0000224E 5E                      		pop	si ; FAT offset value (from fat entry 0)
  8790 0000224F 5F                      		pop	di ; IBMDOS.COM/MSDOS.SYS load offset
  8791 00002250 59                      		pop	cx ; read count (sectors per cluster)
  8792                                  		;pop	ax
  8793                                  
  8794 00002251 C3                      		retn

  8856                                  ;************************************************************************
  8857                                  ;*									*
  8858                                  ;*	seg_reinit is called with ax = our new code segment value,	*
  8859                                  ;*	  trashes di, cx, es						*
  8860                                  ;*									*
  8861                                  ;*	cas -- should be made disposable!				*

  8866                                  	; 10/08/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 IO.SYS (optimization)
  8867                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMBIO.COM - BIOSCODE:0032h 
  8868                                  
  8869                                  _seg_reinit:
  8870 00000032 2E8E06[3000]            		mov	es, [cs:BIOSDATAWORD]
  8871                                  					; at 2C7h:30h or 70h:25A0h
  8872                                  		;mov	di, (offset cdev+2)
  8873 00000037 BF[B606]                		mov	di, cdev+2	; 19/10/2022
  8874                                  		; 20/09/2023
  8875                                  		;mov	cx, 4		; (end_BC_entries - cdev)/4
  8876                                  		; 10/08/2023
  8877 0000003A B90300                  		mov	cx, 3 ; (PCDOS 7.1)
  8878                                  _seg_reinit_1:
  8879 0000003D AB                      		stosw			; modify Bios_Code entry points
  8880 0000003E 47                      		inc	di
  8881 0000003F 47                      		inc	di
  8882 00000040 E2FB                    		loop	_seg_reinit_1
  8883                                  
  8884                                  		; 10/08/2023 (PCDOS 7.1)
  8885                                  		; (direct jump to i2f_handler from BIOSDATA:bios_i2f)
  8886                                  		; (instead of 'bcode_i2f: dw i2f_handler, IOSYSCODESEG')
  8887                                  		
  8888                                  		; 20/09/2023
  8889 00000042 26A3[0800]              		mov	[es:bios_i2f_seg], ax ; actual BIOSCODE segment
  8890                                  		
  8891 00000046 CB                      		retf

  8897                                  ;************************************************************************
  8898                                  ;*									*
  8899                                  ;*	chardev_entry - main device driver dispatch routine		*
  8900                                  ;*	   called with a dummy parameter block on the stack		*
  8901                                  ;*	   dw dispatch_table, dw prn/aux numbers (optional)		*
  8902                                  ;*									*
  8903                                  ;*	will eventually take care of doing the transitions in		*
  8904                                  ;*	   out of Bios_Code						*
  8905                                  ;*									*
  8906                                  ;************************************************************************
  8907                                  
  8908                                  chardev_entry:				; 0070h:25B3h =	02C7h:0043h
  8909 00000047 56                      		push	si
  8910 00000048 50                      		push	ax
  8911 00000049 51                      		push	cx
  8912 0000004A 52                      		push	dx
  8913 0000004B 57                      		push	di
  8914 0000004C 55                      		push	bp
  8915 0000004D 1E                      		push	ds
  8916 0000004E 06                      		push	es
  8917 0000004F 53                      		push	bx
  8918 00000050 89E5                    		mov	bp, sp
  8919 00000052 8B7612                  		mov	si, [bp+18]	; get return address (dispatch table)
  8920                                  		;;mov	ds, word [cs:0030h]
  8921                                  		;mov	ds, word ptr cs:BIOSDATAWORD ; [cs:0030h]
  8922 00000055 2E8E1E[3000]            		mov	ds, [cs:BIOSDATAWORD] ; 17/10/2022
  8923                                  		; 20/09/2023 (PCDOS 7.1 - IBMBIO.COM - BIOSCODE:005Ah)
  8924 0000005A C434                    		les	si, [si]
  8925                                  		;mov	ax, [si+2]	; get the device number	if present
  8926 0000005C 8CC0                    		mov	ax, es
  8927 0000005E A2[2100]                		mov	[auxnum], al
  8928 00000061 8826[E004]              		mov	[printdev], ah
  8929                                  		;mov	si, [si]	; point	to the device dispatch table
  8930 00000065 C41E[1200]              		les	bx, [ptrsav]	; get pointer to i/o packet
  8931 00000069 268A4701                		mov	al, [es:bx+1]	; [es:bx+unit]	; al = unit code
  8932 0000006D 268A670D                		mov	ah, [es:bx+13]	; [es:bx+media]	; ah = media descrip
  8933 00000071 268B4F12                		mov	cx, [es:bx+18]	; [es:bx+count]	; cx = count
  8934 00000075 268B5714                		mov	dx, [es:bx+20]	; [es:bx+start]	; dx = start sector
  8935                                  		; 17/10/2022
  8936 00000079 81FE[3505]              		cmp	si, DSKTBL
  8937                                  		;;cmp	si, 579h	; (PCDOS 7.1 IBMBIO.COM)
  8938                                  		;cmp	si, 4A2h	; dsktbl
  8939                                  					; at 2C7h:4A2h = 70h:2A12h
  8940 0000007D 7517                    		jnz	short no_sector32_mapping
  8941                                  
  8942                                  ; Special case for 32-bit start sector number:
  8943                                  ;   if (si==dsktbl) /* if this is a disk device call */
  8944                                  ;      set high 16 bits of secnum to 0
  8945                                  ;      if (secnum == 0xffff) fetch 32 bit sector number
  8946                                  ;
  8947                                  ; pass high word of sector number in start_sec_h, low word in dx
  8948                                  ;
  8949                                  ; note: start_l and start_h are the offsets within the io_request packet
  8950                                  ;	  which contain the low and hi words of the 32 bit start sector if
  8951                                  ;	  it has been used.
  8952                                  ;
  8953                                  ; note: remember not to destroy the registers which have been set up before
  8954                                  
  8955                                  		; 20/09/2023
  8956                                  		;mov	ds:start_sec_h,	0 ; initialize to 0
  8957 0000007F C706[1C05]0000          		mov	word [start_sec_h], 0
  8958 00000085 83FAFF                  		cmp	dx, 0FFFFh
  8959 00000088 750C                    		jnz	short no_sector32_mapping
  8960 0000008A 268B571C                		mov	dx, [es:bx+28]	; [es:bx+start_h]
  8961                                  					; 32 bits dsk req
  8962                                  		;mov	ds:start_sec_h,	dx ; start_sec_h = packet.start_h
  8963 0000008E 8916[1C05]              		mov	[start_sec_h], dx
  8964 00000092 268B571A                		mov	dx, [es:bx+26]	; [es:bx+start_l]
  8965                                  					; dx = packet.start_l
  8966                                  no_sector32_mapping:			
  8967 00000096 97                      		xchg	ax, di
  8968 00000097 268A4702                		mov	al, [es:bx+2]	; [es:bx+cmd]
  8969 0000009B 2E3A04                  		cmp	al, [cs:si]
  8970 0000009E 732B                    		jnb	short command_error
  8971 000000A0 98                      		cbw			; note that al <= 15 means ok
  8972 000000A1 D1E0                    		shl	ax, 1
  8973 000000A3 01C6                    		add	si, ax
  8974 000000A5 97                      		xchg	ax, di
  8975 000000A6 26C47F0E                		les	di, [es:bx+14]	; [es:bx+trans]
  8976 000000AA FC                      		cld
  8977                                  		; 17/10/2022
  8978 000000AB 2EFF5401                		call	near [cs:si+1]
  8979                                  		;call	word ptr cs:si+1
  8980 000000AF 7202                    		jb	short already_got_ah_status
  8981 000000B1 B401                    		mov	ah, 1
  8982                                  already_got_ah_status:
  8983                                  		;;mov	ds, [cs:0030h]	; 15/10/2022
  8984                                  		;mov	ds, word ptr cs:BIOSDATAWORD ; [cs:0030h]
  8985                                  					; cas note: shouldn't be needed!
  8986 000000B3 2E8E1E[3000]            		mov	ds, [cs:BIOSDATAWORD] ; 17/10/2022
  8987                                  		;lds	bx, ds:ptrsav
  8988 000000B8 C51E[1200]              		lds	bx, [ptrsav]
  8989 000000BC 894703                  		mov	[bx+3],	ax	; [bx+status]
  8990                                  					; mark operation complete
  8991 000000BF 5B                      		pop	bx
  8992 000000C0 07                      		pop	es
  8993 000000C1 1F                      		pop	ds
  8994 000000C2 5D                      		pop	bp
  8995 000000C3 5F                      		pop	di
  8996 000000C4 5A                      		pop	dx
  8997 000000C5 59                      		pop	cx
  8998 000000C6 58                      		pop	ax
  8999 000000C7 5E                      		pop	si
  9000                                  		;add	sp, 2		; get rid of fake return address
  9001                                  		; 20/09/2023 (PCDOS 7.1	- IBMBIO.COM - BIOSCODE:00C8h)
  9002 000000C8 44                      		inc	sp
  9003 000000C9 44                      		inc	sp	
  9004                                  
  9005                                  		; fall through into bc_retf
  9006                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------	
  9007                                  bc_retf:
  9008 000000CA CB                      		retf
  9009                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9010                                  
  9011                                  command_error:				
  9012 000000CB E80700                  		call	bc_cmderr
  9013 000000CE EBE3                    		jmp	short already_got_ah_status
  9014                                  ; 15/10/2022
  9015                                  ; 01/05/2019
  9016                                  
  9017                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9018                                  ; The following piece of hack is for supporting CP/M compatibility
  9019                                  ; Basically at offset 5 we have a far call into 0:c0. But this does not call
  9020                                  ; 0:c0 directly instead it call f01d:fef0, because it needs to support 'lhld 6'
  9021                                  ; The following hack has to reside at ffff:d0 (= f01d:fef0) if BIOS is loaded
  9022                                  ; high.
  9023                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9024                                  
  9025                                  		;db 7 dup(0)
  9026                                  
  9027                                  		; 20/09/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 IO.SYS (Optimization)
  9028                                  		; (PCDOS 7.1 - IBMBIO.COM - BIOSCODE:0D0h)
  9029                                  		; 15/10/2022
  9030                                  		;dw 0		; pad to bring offset to 0D0h
  9031                                  
  9032 000000D0 00<rep 5h>              off_d0: 	times 5 db 0	; 5 bytes from 0:c0 will be copied onto here
  9033                                  				;  which is the CP/M call 5 entry point
  9034                                  		
  9035                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9036                                  
  9037                                  ;	exit - all routines return through this path
  9038                                  
  9039                                  bc_cmderr:				
  9040 000000D5 B003                    		mov	al, 3		; 2C7h:D5h = 70h:2645h
  9041                                  					; unknown command error
  9042                                  
  9043                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
  9044                                  
  9045                                  ;	now zero the count field by subtracting its current value,
  9046                                  ;	  which is still in cx, from itself.
  9047                                  
  9048                                  ;	subtract the number of i/o's NOT YET COMPLETED from total
  9049                                  ;	  in order to return the number actually complete
  9050                                  
  9051                                  bc_err_cnt:	
  9052                                  		;les	bx, ds:ptrsav
  9053                                  		; 19/10/2022
  9054 000000D7 C41E[1200]              		les	bx, [ptrsav]
  9055 000000DB 26294F12                		sub	[es:bx+18], cx	; [es:bx+count]
  9056                                  					; # of successful i/o's
  9057 000000DF B481                    		mov	ah, 81h		; mark error return
  9058 000000E1 F9                      		stc			; indicate abnormal end
  9059 000000E2 C3                      		retn
  9060                                  
  9061                                  ; 15/10/2022
  9062                                  
  9063                                  ;Bios_Code ends
  9064

  9066                                  ; MSCHAR.ASM - MSDOS 6.0 - 1991

  9072                                  
  9073                                  ;title	mschar - character and clock devices
  9074                                  
  9075                                  ;MODE_CTRLBRK	equ	0FFh
  9076                                  
  9077                                  ; BIOSCODE:00E4h (MSDOS 6.21, IO.SYS)
  9078                                  
  9079                                  ;************************************************************************
  9080                                  ;*									*
  9081                                  ;*	device driver dispatch tables					*
  9082                                  ;*									*
  9083                                  ;*	each table starts with a byte which lists the number of		*
  9084                                  ;*	legal functions, followed by that number of words. Each		*
  9085                                  ;*	word represents an offset of a routine in Bios_Code which	*
  9086                                  ;*	handles the function. The functions are terminated with		*
  9087                                  ;*	a near return. If carry is reset, a 'done' code is returned	*
  9088                                  ;*	to the caller. If carry is set, the ah/al registers are		*
  9089                                  ;*	returned as abnormal completion status. Notice that ds		*
  9090                                  ;*	is assumed to point to the Bios_Data segment throughout.	*
  9091                                  ;*									*
  9092                                  ;************************************************************************
  9093                                  
  9094                                  		; 20/09/2023
  9095                                  		; (PCDOS 7.1 - IBMBIO.COM - BIOSCODE:00E3h)
  9096                                  		; 13/12/2022
  9097 000000E3 00                      		db 0
  9098                                  
  9099                                  		; 13/12/2022
  9100 000000E4 0B                      con_table:	db ((con_table_end - con_table)-1)/2 ; 11
  9101                                  					; 2C7h:0E4h = 70h:2654h
  9102 000000E5 [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec  ; 1FBh	; bc_exvec at 2C7h:1FBh	= 70h:276Bh
  9103                                  					; 00 init
  9104 000000E7 [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec  ; 1FBh	; 01
  9105 000000E9 [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec  ; 1FBh	; 02
  9106 000000EB [D500]                  		dw bc_cmderr ; 0D5h	; bc_exvec at 2C7h:D5h = 70h:2645h
  9107                                  					; 03
  9108 000000ED [5C01]                  		dw con_read  ; 15Ch	; con_read at 2C7h:15Ch	= 70h:26CCh
  9109                                  					; 04
  9110 000000EF [9F01]                  		dw con_rdnd  ; 19Fh	; con_rdnd at 2C7h:19Fh	= 70h:270Fh
  9111                                  					; 05
  9112 000000F1 [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec  ; 1FBh	; 06
  9113 000000F3 [0802]                  		dw con_flush ; 209h	; con_flush at 2C7h:209h = 70h:2779h
  9114                                  					; 07
  9115 000000F5 [FC01]                  		dw con_writ  ; 1FDh	; con_writ at 2C7h:1FDh	= 70h:276Dh
  9116                                  					; 08
  9117 000000F7 [FC01]                  		dw con_writ  ; 1FDh	; 09
  9118 000000F9 [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec  ; 1FBh	; 0A
  9119                                  con_table_end:
  9120 000000FB 1A                      prn_table:	db ((prn_table_end - prn_table)-1)/2 ; 26			
  9121                                  					; 2C7h:0FBh = 70h:266Bh
  9122 000000FC [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; bc_exvec
  9123 000000FE [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 01
  9124 00000100 [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 02
  9125 00000102 [D500]                  		dw bc_cmderr  ;	0D5h	; bc_cmderr
  9126 00000104 [1902]                  		dw prn_input  ;	21Ah	; prn_input
  9127                                  					; 04 indicate zero chars read
  9128 00000106 [C701]                  		dw z_bus_exit ; 1C8h	; z_bus_exit
  9129                                  					; 05 read non-destructive
  9130 00000108 [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 06
  9131 0000010A [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 07
  9132 0000010C [1E02]                  		dw prn_writ   ;	21Fh	; prn_writ
  9133 0000010E [1E02]                  		dw prn_writ   ; 21Fh	; 09
  9134 00000110 [4F02]                  		dw prn_stat   ; 251h	; prn_stat
  9135 00000112 [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 0B
  9136 00000114 [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 0C
  9137 00000116 [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 0D
  9138 00000118 [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 0E
  9139 0000011A [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 0F
  9140 0000011C [8902]                  		dw prn_tilbusy ; 28Bh	; prn_tilbusy
  9141 0000011E [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 11
  9142 00000120 [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 12
  9143 00000122 [B702]                  		dw prn_genioctl ; 2BAh	; prn_genioctl
  9144 00000124 [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 14
  9145 00000126 [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 15
  9146 00000128 [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 16
  9147 0000012A [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 17
  9148 0000012C [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 18
  9149 0000012E [EC02]                  		dw prn_ioctl_query ; 2F0h ; prn_ioctl_query
  9150                                  prn_table_end:
  9151 00000130 0B                      aux_table:	db ((aux_table_end - aux_table)-1)/2 ; 11			
  9152                                  					; 2C7h:130h = 70h:26A0h
  9153 00000131 [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 00 - init
  9154 00000133 [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 01
  9155 00000135 [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 02
  9156 00000137 [D500]                  		dw bc_cmderr  ;	0D5h	; 03
  9157 00000139 [0703]                  		dw aux_read   ; 30Dh	; aux_read ; 04	- read
  9158 0000013B [2C03]                  		dw aux_rdnd   ; 335h	; aux_rdnd - 05	- read non-destructive
  9159 0000013D [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 06
  9160 0000013F [6203]                  		dw aux_flsh   ;	36Ch	; aux_flsh
  9161 00000141 [6903]                  		dw aux_writ   ;	374h	; aux_writ
  9162 00000143 [6903]                  		dw aux_writ   ;	374h	; 09
  9163 00000145 [4C03]                  		dw aux_wrst   ;	355h	; aux_wrst
  9164                                  aux_table_end:
  9165 00000147 0A                      tim_table	db ((tim_table_end - tim_table)-1)/2 ; 10
  9166                                  					; 2C7h:147h = 70h:26B7h
  9167 00000148 [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 00
  9168 0000014A [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 01
  9169 0000014C [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 02
  9170 0000014E [D500]                  		dw bc_cmderr  ;	0D5h	; 03
  9171 00000150 [CE04]                  		dw tim_read   ;	435h	; tim_read
  9172 00000152 [C701]                  		dw z_bus_exit ; 1C8h	; z_bus_exit
  9173 00000154 [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 06
  9174 00000156 [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec   ; 1FBh	; 07
  9175 00000158 [CF03]                  		dw tim_writ   ; 3DBh	; tim_writ
  9176 0000015A [CF03]                  		dw tim_writ   ; 3DBh	; 09
  9177                                  tim_table_end:
  9178                                  
  9179                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9180                                  
  9181                                  ;************************************************************************
  9182                                  ;*									*
  9183                                  ;*	con_read - read cx bytes from keyboard into buffer at es:di	*
  9184                                  ;*									*
  9185                                  ;************************************************************************
  9186                                  
  9187                                  con_read:				; 2C7h:15Ch = 70h:26CCh
  9188                                  		;jcxz	short con_exit	; read cx bytes	from keyboard into buffer
  9189 0000015C E306                    		jcxz	con_exit	; 19/10/2022
  9190                                  con_loop:				
  9191 0000015E E80500                  		call	chrin		; get char in al
  9192 00000161 AA                      		stosb			; store	char at	es:di
  9193 00000162 E2FA                    		loop	con_loop
  9194                                  con_exit:				
  9195 00000164 F8                      		clc
  9196 00000165 C3                      		retn
  9197                                  
  9198                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
  9199                                  
  9200                                  ;************************************************************************
  9201                                  ;*									*
  9202                                  ;*	chrin - input single char from keyboard into al			*
  9203                                  ;*									*
  9204                                  ;*	  we are going to issue extended keyboard function, if		*
  9205                                  ;*	  supported. the returning value of the extended keystroke	*
  9206                                  ;*	  of the extended keyboard function uses 0E0h in al		*
  9207                                  ;*	  instead of 00h as in the conventional keyboard function.	*
  9208                                  ;*	  this creates a conflict when the user entered real		*
  9209                                  ;*	  greek alpha charater (= 0E0h) to  distinguish the extended	*
  9210                                  ;*	  keystroke and the greek alpha. this case will be handled	*
  9211                                  ;*	  in the following manner:					*
  9212                                  ;*									*
  9213                                  ;*	      ah = 16h							*
  9214                                  ;*	      int 16h							*
  9215                                  ;*	      if al == 0, then extended code (in ah)			*
  9216                                  ;*	      else if al == 0E0h, then					*
  9217                                  ;*	      if ah <> 0, then extended code (in ah)			*
  9218                                  ;*		else greek_alpha character.				*
  9219                                  ;*									*
  9220                                  ;*	also, for compatibility reason, if an extended code is		*
  9221                                  ;*	  detected, then we are going to change the value in al		*
  9222                                  ;*	  from 0E0h to 00h.						*
  9223                                  ;*									*
  9224                                  ;************************************************************************
  9225                                  
  9226                                  		; 19/10/2022
  9227                                  chrin:		
  9228 00000166 8A26[DE04]              		mov	ah, [keyrd_func] ; set by msinit. 0 or 10h
  9229 0000016A 30C0                    		xor	al, al
  9230 0000016C 8606[0C00]              		xchg	al, [altah]	; get character	& zero altah
  9231 00000170 08C0                    		or	al, al
  9232 00000172 752A                    		jnz	short keyret
  9233 00000174 CD16                    		int	16h		; KEYBOARD -
  9234 00000176 09C0                    		or	ax, ax
  9235 00000178 74EC                    		jz	short chrin
  9236 0000017A 3D0072                  		cmp	ax, 7200h	; check	for ctrl-prtsc
  9237 0000017D 7504                    		jnz	short alt_ext_chk
  9238 0000017F B010                    		mov	al, 10h
  9239 00000181 EB1B                    		jmp	short keyret
  9240                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9241                                  
  9242                                  ;  if operation was extended function (i.e. keyrd_func != 0) then
  9243                                  ;    if character read was 0E0h then
  9244                                  ;      if extended byte was zero (i.e. ah == 0) then
  9245                                  ;	 goto keyret
  9246                                  ;      else
  9247                                  ;	 set al to zero
  9248                                  ;	 goto alt_save
  9249                                  ;      endif
  9250                                  ;    endif
  9251                                  ;  endif
  9252                                  
  9253                                  alt_ext_chk:
  9254 00000183 803E[DE04]00            		cmp	byte [keyrd_func], 0
  9255 00000188 740C                    		jz	short not_ext
  9256 0000018A 3CE0                    		cmp	al, 0E0h
  9257 0000018C 7508                    		jnz	short not_ext
  9258 0000018E 08E4                    		or	ah, ah
  9259 00000190 740C                    		jz	short keyret
  9260 00000192 30C0                    		xor	al, al
  9261 00000194 EB04                    		jmp	short alt_save
  9262                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9263                                  
  9264                                  not_ext:				
  9265 00000196 08C0                    		or	al, al		; special case?
  9266 00000198 7504                    		jnz	short keyret
  9267                                  alt_save:				
  9268 0000019A 8826[0C00]              		mov	[altah], ah	; store	special	key
  9269                                  keyret:					
  9270 0000019E C3                      		retn
  9271                                  
  9272                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9273                                  
  9274                                  ;************************************************************************
  9275                                  ;*									*
  9276                                  ;*	con_rdnd - keyboard non destructive read, no wait		*
  9277                                  ;*									*
  9278                                  ;*	pc-convertible-type machine: if bit 10 is set by the dos	*
  9279                                  ;*	in the status word of the request packet, and there is no	*
  9280                                  ;*	character in the input buffer, the driver issues a system	*
  9281                                  ;*	wait request to the rom. on return from the rom, it returns	*
  9282                                  ;*	a 'char-not-found' to the dos.					*
  9283                                  ;*									*
  9284                                  ;************************************************************************
  9285                                  
  9286                                  		; 19/10/2022
  9287                                  con_rdnd:				
  9288 0000019F A0[0C00]                		mov	al, [altah]
  9289 000001A2 08C0                    		or	al, al
  9290 000001A4 754C                    		jnz	short rdexit
  9291 000001A6 8A26[DF04]              		mov	ah, [keysts_func]
  9292 000001AA CD16                    		int	16h		; KEYBOARD -
  9293 000001AC 751D                    		jnz	short gotchr
  9294 000001AE 803E[7900]00            		cmp	byte [fhavek09], 0
  9295 000001B3 7412                    		jz	short z_bus_exit
  9296 000001B5 C41E[1200]              		les	bx, [ptrsav]
  9297                                  		; 12/12/2022
  9298 000001B9 26F6470404              		test	byte [es:bx+4], 04h
  9299                                  		;test	word [es:bx+3], 400h ; [es:bx+status]
  9300 000001BE 7407                    		jz	short z_bus_exit
  9301 000001C0 B80041                  		mov	ax, 4100h
  9302 000001C3 30DB                    		xor	bl, bl
  9303 000001C5 CD15                    		int	15h		; SYSTEM - WAIT	ON EXTERNAL EVENT (CONVERTIBLE)
  9304                                  					; AL = condition type, BH = condition compare or mask value
  9305                                  					; BL = timeout value times 55 milliseconds, 00h	means no timeout
  9306                                  					; DX = I/O port	address	if AL bit 4 set
  9307                                  z_bus_exit:				
  9308 000001C7 F9                      		stc			; 2C7h:1C8h = 70h:2738h
  9309 000001C8 B403                    		mov	ah, 3		; indicate busy	status
  9310 000001CA C3                      		retn
  9311                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9312                                  
  9313                                  gotchr:					
  9314 000001CB 09C0                    		or	ax, ax
  9315 000001CD 7508                    		jnz	short notbrk	; check	for null after break
  9316 000001CF 8A26[DE04]              		mov	ah, [keyrd_func] ; issue keyboard read function
  9317 000001D3 CD16                    		int	16h		; KEYBOARD -
  9318 000001D5 EBC8                    		jmp	short con_rdnd	; get a	real status
  9319                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9320                                  
  9321                                  notbrk:					
  9322 000001D7 3D0072                  		cmp	ax, 7200h	; check	for ctrl-prtsc
  9323 000001DA 7504                    		jnz	short rd_ext_chk
  9324 000001DC B010                    		mov	al, 10h		; ('P' & 1Fh) ; return control p
  9325 000001DE EB12                    		jmp	short rdexit
  9326                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9327                                  
  9328                                  rd_ext_chk:				
  9329 000001E0 803E[DE04]00            		cmp	byte [keyrd_func], 0 ; extended keyboard function?
  9330 000001E5 740B                    		jz	short rdexit
  9331 000001E7 3CE0                    		cmp	al, 0E0h	; extended key value or	greek alpha?
  9332 000001E9 7507                    		jnz	short rdexit
  9333 000001EB 80FC00                  		cmp	ah, 0		; scan code exist?
  9334 000001EE 7402                    		jz	short rdexit	; yes. greek alpha char.
  9335 000001F0 B000                    		mov	al, 0		; no. extended key stroke.
  9336                                  					; change it for	compatibility
  9337                                  rdexit:					
  9338 000001F2 C41E[1200]              		les	bx, [ptrsav]
  9339 000001F6 2688470D                		mov	[es:bx+13], al	; [es:bx+media]
  9340                                  					; return keyboard character here
  9341                                  bc_exvec:				
  9342 000001FA F8                      		clc			; bc_exvec at 2C7h:1FBh	= 70h:276Bh
  9343                                  					; indicate normal termination
  9344 000001FB C3                      		retn
  9345                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9346                                  
  9347                                  ;************************************************************************
  9348                                  ;*									*
  9349                                  ;*	con_write - console write routine				*
  9350                                  ;*									*
  9351                                  ;*	entry:	es:di -> buffer						*
  9352                                  ;*		cx    =  count						*
  9353                                  ;*									*
  9354                                  ;************************************************************************
  9355                                  
  9356                                  con_writ:
  9357                                  		;jcxz	short bc_exvec
  9358 000001FC E3FC                    		jcxz	bc_exvec	; 19/10/2022
  9359                                  		; 12/12/2022
  9360                                  		;jcxz	cc_ret
  9361                                  con_lp:					
  9362 000001FE 268A05                  		mov	al, [es:di]
  9363 00000201 47                      		inc	di
  9364 00000202 CD29                    		int	29h		; DOS 2+ internal - FAST PUTCHAR
  9365                                  					; AL = character to display
  9366 00000204 E2F8                    		loop	con_lp
  9367                                  cc_ret:					
  9368 00000206 F8                      		clc
  9369 00000207 C3                      		retn
  9370                                  
  9371                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
  9372                                  
  9373                                  ;************************************************************************
  9374                                  ;*									*
  9375                                  ;*	con_flush - flush out keyboard queue				*
  9376                                  ;*									*
  9377                                  ;************************************************************************
  9378                                  
  9379                                  con_flush:
  9380 00000208 C606[0C00]00            		mov	byte [altah], 0	; clear	out holding buffer
  9381                                  flloop:					; while	(charavail()) charread();	
  9382 0000020D B401                    		mov	ah, 1
  9383 0000020F CD16                    		int	16h		; KEYBOARD - CHECK BUFFER, DO NOT CLEAR
  9384                                  					; Return: ZF clear if character	in buffer
  9385                                  					; AH = scan code, AL = character
  9386                                  					; ZF set if no character in buffer
  9387 00000211 74F3                    		jz	short cc_ret
  9388 00000213 30E4                    		xor	ah, ah
  9389 00000215 CD16                    		int	16h		; KEYBOARD - READ CHAR FROM BUFFER, WAIT IF EMPTY
  9390                                  					; Return: AH = scan code, AL = character
  9391 00000217 EBF4                    		jmp	short flloop
  9392

  9394                                  
  9395                                  ; 15/10/2022

  9397                                  ;************************************************************************
  9398                                  ;*									*
  9399                                  ;*	some equates for rom bios printer i/o				*
  9400                                  ;*									*
  9401                                  ;************************************************************************
  9402                                  
  9403                                  ; ibm rom status bits (i don't trust them, neither should you)
  9404                                  ; warning!!! the ibm rom does not return just one bit. it returns a
  9405                                  ; whole slew of bits, only one of which is correct.
  9406                                  
  9407                                  ;notbusystatus	equ 10000000b		; not busy
  9408                                  ;nopaperstatus	equ 00100000b		; no more paper
  9409                                  ;prnselected	equ 00010000b		; printer selected
  9410                                  ;ioerrstatus	equ 00001000b		; some kinda error
  9411                                  ;timeoutstatus	equ 00000001b		; time out.
  9412                                  ;
  9413                                  ;noprinter	equ 00110000b		; no printer attached
  9414                                  
  9415                                  ; 18/03/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
  9416                                  ;error_I24_out_of_paper	equ 9 ; MSDOS 6.0, ERR.INC, 1991
  9417                                  
  9418                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9419                                  
  9420                                  ;************************************************************************
  9421                                  ;*									*
  9422                                  ;*	prn_input - return with no error but zero chars read		*
  9423                                  ;*									*
  9424                                  ;*	enter with cx = number of characters requested			*
  9425                                  ;*									*
  9426                                  ;************************************************************************
  9427                                  
  9428                                  prn_input:				; 2C7h:21Ah = 70h:278Ah
  9429 00000219 E8BBFE                  		call	bc_err_cnt	; reset	count to zero
  9430                                  					; (sub reqpkt.count,cx)
  9431                                  		; 12/12/2022
  9432                                  prn_done:
  9433 0000021C F8                      		clc			; but return with carry	reset for no error
  9434 0000021D C3                      		retn
  9435                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9436                                  
  9437                                  ;************************************************************************

  9529                                  	; printer being installed. This tests checks to be sure

  9542                                  ; careful about breaking basic.

  9996 00000397 F7E1                    		mul	cx		; convert to 1/100 sec
  9997 00000399 89C1                    		mov	cx, ax
  9998 0000039B B064                    		mov	al, 100

 10000 0000039F 01C1                    		add	cx, ax		; combine seconds with hours and min
