 10261                                  
 10262                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10263                                  ; gettime reads date and time
 10264                                  ; and returns the following information:
 10265                                  ;
 10266                                  ;	es:[di]  =count of days since 1-1-80
 10267                                  ;	es:[di+2]=hours
 10268                                  ;	es:[di+3]=minutes
 10269                                  ;	es:[di+4]=seconds
 10270                                  ;	es:[di+5]=hundredths of seconds
 10271                                  ;
 10272                                  ;	NOTE:  Any changes in this routine probably require corresponding
 10273                                  ;	changes in the version that is built with the power manager driver.
 10274                                  ;	See ptime.asm.
 10275                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10276                                  
 10277                                  tim_read:				; 2C7h:435h = 70h:29A5h
 10278 000004CE E84A00                  		call	GetTickCnt
 10279 000004D1 8B36[E904]              		mov	si, [daycnt]
 10280                                  
 10281                                  ; we now need to convert the time in tick to the time in 100th of
 10282                                  ; seconds. the relation between tick and seconds is:
 10283                                  ;
 10284                                  ;		 65,536 seconds
 10285                                  ;	       ----------------
 10286                                  ;		1,193,180 tick
 10287                                  ;
 10288                                  ; to get to 100th of second we need to multiply by 100. the equation is:
 10289                                  ;
 10290                                  ;	ticks from clock  * 65,536 * 100
 10291                                  ;      --------------------------------- = time in 100th of seconds
 10292                                  ;		1,193,180
 10293                                  ;
 10294                                  ; fortunately this formula simplifies to:
 10295                                  ;
 10296                                  ;	ticks from clock * 5 * 65,536
 10297                                  ;      --------------------------------- = time in 100th of seconds
 10298                                  ;		59,659
 10299                                  ;
 10300                                  ; the calculation is done by first multipling tick by 5. next we divide by
 10301                                  ; 59,659. in this division we multiply by 65,536 by shifting the dividend
 10302                                  ; my 16 bits to the left.
 10303                                  ;
 10304                                  ; start with ticks in cx:dx
 10305                                  ; multiply by 5
 10306                                  
 10307 000004D5 89C8                    		mov	ax, cx
 10308 000004D7 89D3                    		mov	bx, dx		; start	with ticks in cx:dx
 10309                                  					; multiply by 5
 10310 000004D9 D1E2                    		shl	dx, 1
 10311 000004DB D1D1                    		rcl	cx, 1		; times	2
 10312 000004DD D1E2                    		shl	dx, 1
 10313 000004DF D1D1                    		rcl	cx, 1		; times	4
 10314 000004E1 01DA                    		add	dx, bx
 10315 000004E3 11C8                    		adc	ax, cx		; times	5
 10316 000004E5 92                      		xchg	ax, dx
 10317                                  
 10318                                  ; now have ticks * 5 in	dx:ax
 10319                                  ; we now need to multiply by 65536 and divide by 59659 d.
 10320                                  
 10321 000004E6 B90BE9                  		mov	cx, 59659	; get divisor
 10322 000004E9 F7F1                    		div	cx		; dx now has remainder
 10323                                  					; ax has high word of final quotient
 10324                                  
 10325                                  		; 08/08/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 IO.SYS (optimization)
 10326                                  		;mov	bx, ax		; put high word	in safe	place
 10327 000004EB 93                      		xchg	bx, ax
 10328 000004EC 31C0                    		xor	ax, ax		; this is the multiply by 65536
 10329 000004EE F7F1                    		div	cx		; bx:ax	now has	time in	100th of seconds
 10330                                  
 10331                                  ; rounding based on the	remainder may be added here
 10332                                  ; the result in	bx:ax is time in 1/100 second.
 10333                                  
 10334 000004F0 89DA                    		mov	dx, bx		
 10335 000004F2 B9C800                  		mov	cx, 200		; extract 1/100's
 10336                                  
 10337                                  ; division by 200 is necessary to ensure no overflow--max result
 10338                                  ; is number of seconds in a day/2 = 43200.
 10339                                  
 10340 000004F5 F7F1                    		div	cx
 10341 000004F7 80FA64                  		cmp	dl, 100		; remainder over 100?
 10342 000004FA 7203                    		jb	short noadj
 10343 000004FC 80EA64                  		sub	dl, 100		; keep 1/100's less than 100
 10344                                  noadj:					
 10345 000004FF F5                      		cmc			; if we	subtracted 100,	carry is now set
 10346 00000500 88D3                    		mov	bl, dl		; save 1/100's
 10347                                  
 10348                                  ; to compensate	for dividing by	200 instead of 100, we now multiply
 10349                                  ; by two, shifting a one in if the remainder had exceeded 100.
 10350                                  
 10351 00000502 D1D0                    		rcl	ax, 1		
 10352 00000504 B200                    		mov	dl, 0
 10353 00000506 D1D2                    		rcl	dx, 1
 10354                                  		;mov	cx, 60		; divide out seconds
 10355                                  		; 20/12/2023
 10356 00000508 B13C                    		mov	cl, 60
 10357 0000050A F7F1                    		div	cx
 10358 0000050C 88D7                    		mov	bh, dl		; save the seconds
 10359 0000050E F6F1                    		div	cl		; break	into hours and minutes
 10360 00000510 86C4                    		xchg	al, ah
 10361                                  
 10362                                  ; time is now in ax:bx (hours, minutes, seconds, 1/100 sec)
 10363                                  
 10364                                  		; 08/08/2023
 10365                                  		;push	ax
 10366                                  		;mov	ax, si		; daycnt
 10367 00000512 96                      		xchg	ax, si
 10368 00000513 AB                      		stosw
 10369                                  		;pop	ax
 10370 00000514 96                      		xchg	ax, si		; al = hours, ah = minutes
 10371 00000515 AB                      		stosw
 10372 00000516 89D8                    		mov	ax, bx
 10373 00000518 AB                      		stosw
 10374 00000519 F8                      		clc			; [es:di] = count of days since 1-1-80
 10375                                  					;   [es:di+2] = hours
 10376                                  					;   [es:di+3] = minutes
 10377                                  					;   [es:di+4] = seconds
 10378                                  					;   [es:di+5] = hundredths of seconds
 10379 0000051A C3                      		retn

 10383                                  ; 15/10/2022
 10384                                  
 10385                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10386                                  ;
 10387                                  ; procedure : GetTickCnt
 10388                                  ;
 10389                                  ;		Returns the tick count in CX:DX. Takes care of DayCnt in case
 10390                                  ;		of rollover [except when power management driver is in use]. 
 10391                                  ;		Uses the following logic for updating Daycnt
 10392                                  ;
 10393                                  ;		if ( rollover ) {
 10394                                  ;			if ( t_switch )
 10395                                  ;				daycnt++ ;
 10396                                  ;			else
 10397                                  ;				daycnt += rollover ;
 10398                                  ;		}
 10399                                  ;
 10400                                  ; USES : AX
 10401                                  ;
 10402                                  ; RETURNS : CX:DX - tick count
 10403                                  ; MODIFIES : daycnt
 10404                                  ;
 10405                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10406                                  
 10407                                  		; 17/10/2022
 10408                                  GetTickCnt:	
 10409 0000051B 30E4                    		xor	ah, ah
 10410 0000051D CD1A                    		int	1Ah		; CLOCK	- GET TIME OF DAY
 10411                                  					; Return: CX:DX	= clock	count
 10412                                  					; AL = 00h if clock was	read or	written	(via AH=0,1) since the previous
 10413                                  					; midnight
 10414                                  					; Otherwise, AL	> 0
 10415                                  		; 20/12/2023
 10416 0000051F 30E4                    		xor	ah, ah
 10417 00000521 3826[EB04]              		cmp	byte [t_switch], ah ; 0
 10418                                  		;cmp	byte [t_switch], 0 ; use old method ? (>0 is yes)
 10419 00000525 7505                    		jnz	short inc_case	; old method assumes that Int 1Ah returns rollover flag
 10420                                  		;xor	ah, ah		; new method assumes that Int 1Ah returns roll over count
 10421                                  					; and not flag
 10422 00000527 0106[E904]              		add	[daycnt], ax
 10423 0000052B C3                      		retn
 10424                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10425                                  
 10426                                  inc_case:
 10427 0000052C 08C0                    		or	al, al
 10428 0000052E 7404                    		jz	short no_rollover
 10429 00000530 FF06[E904]              		inc	word [daycnt]
 10430                                  no_rollover:
 10431 00000534 C3                      		retn

 10464                                  ; device attribute bits:
 10465                                  ;	bit 6 - get/set map for logical drives and generic ioctl.

 10467                                  ;MAXERR		equ	5
 10468                                  ;MAX_HD_FMT_ERR	equ	2

 10470                                  ;LSTDRV	equ 504h
 10471                                  
 10472                                  ; some floppies do not have changeline. as a result, media-check would
 10473                                  ; normally return i-don't-know, the dos would continually reread the fat and
 10474                                  ; discard cached data. we optimize this by implementing a logical door-latch:
 10475                                  ; it is physically impossible to change a disk in under 2 seconds. we retain
 10476                                  ; the time of the last successful disk operation and compare it with the current
 10477                                  ; time during media-check. if < 2 seconds and at least 1 timer tick has passed,
 10478                                  ; the we say no change. if > 2 seconds then we say i-don't-know. finally, 
 10479                                  ; since we cannot trust the timer to be always available, we record the number 
 10480                                  ; of media checks that have occurred when no apparent time has elapsed. while
 10481                                  ; this number is < a given threshold, we say no change. when it exceeds that
 10482                                  ; threshold, we say i-don't-know and reset the counter to 0. when we store 
 10483                                  ; the time of last successful access, if we see that time has passed too,
 10484                                  ; we reset the counter.
 10485                                  
 10486                                  accessmax	equ	5
 10487                                  
 10488                                  ; due to various bogosities, we need to continually adjust what the head
 10489                                  ; settle time is.  the following algorithm is used:
 10490                                  ;
 10491                                  ;   get the current head settle value.
 10492                                  ;   if it is 0, then
 10493                                  ;	set slow = 15
 10494                                  ;   else
 10495                                  ;	set slow = value
 10496                                  ;   ...
 10497                                  ;*********************************************
 10498                                  ;************ old algorithm ******************
 10499                                  ;*   if we are seeking and writing then
 10500                                  ;*	 use slow
 10501                                  ;*   else
 10502                                  ;*	 use fast
 10503                                  ;*********************************************
 10504                                  ;*********** ibm's requested logic ***********
 10505                                  ;   if we are seeking and writing and not on an at then
 10506                                  ;	use slow
 10507                                  ;   else
 10508                                  ;	use fast
 10509                                  ;   ...
 10510                                  ;   restore current head settle value
 10511                                  ;
 10512                                  ;
 10513                                  ;---------------------------------------
 10514                                  multrk_on	equ	10000000b	;user spcified mutitrack=on, or system turns
 10515                                  					; it on after handling config.sys file as a
 10516                                  					; default value, if multrk_flag = multrk_off1.
 10517                                  multrk_off1	equ	00000000b	;initial value. no "multitrack=" command entered.
 10518                                  multrk_off2	equ	00000001b	;user specified multitrack=off.
 10519

 10716                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10717                                  ; perform a check on the time passed since the last access for this physical
 10718                                  ; drive.
 10719                                  ; we are accessing the same drive. if the time of last successful access was
 10720                                  ; less than 2 seconds ago, then we may presume that the disk was not changed.
 10721                                  ; returns in si:
 10722                                  ;	0 - if time of last access was >= 2 seconds
 10723                                  ;	1 - if time was < 2 seconds (i.e no media change assumed)
 10724                                  ; registers affected ax,cx,dx, flags.

 10726                                  ;	assume es:di -> bds, ds->Bios_Data

 10732 000005F3 E825FF                  		call	GetTickCnt	; cx:dx	is the elapsed time
 10733 000005F6 268B4547                		mov	ax, [es:di+47h]	; [es:di+BDS.tim_lo]
 10734                                  					; get stored time
 10735 000005FA 29C2                    		sub	dx, ax
 10736 000005FC 268B4549                		mov	ax, [es:di+49h]	; [es:di+BDS.tim_hi]
 10737 00000600 19C1                    		sbb	cx, ax
 10738                                  		; 11/08/2023
 10739                                  		; PCDOS 7.1 IBMBIO.COM - BIOSCODE:0646h
 10740                                  		;mov	al, [accesscount]

 10742 00000604 09D2                    		or	dx, dx		; time must pass
 10743 00000606 750C                    		jnz	short timepassed ; yes, examine max value
 10744                                  		; 11/08/2023
 10745                                  		;inc	al
 10746                                  		;cmp	al, 5

 10748                                  		;;cmp	byte [accesscount], 5

 10751                                  		;;dec	byte [accesscount] ; don't let the count wrap
 10752                                  		; 11/08/2023
 10753                                  		;dec	al
 10754                                  		;jmp	short timecheck_unk ; "i don't know" if media changed
 10755                                  		; 11/08/2023
 10756 00000608 803E[1D01]04            		cmp	byte [accesscount], 4
 10757 0000060D 730A                    		jnb	short timecheck_unk
 10758 0000060F FE06[1D01]              		inc	byte [accesscount]

 10943                                  ;	getbp - return bpb from the drive specified by the bds.
 10944                                  ;	    if the return_fake_bpb flag is set, then it does nothing.

 11160                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
 11161                                  
 11162                                  ; 15/10/2022 - Retro DOS 4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)
 11163                                  
 11164                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------
 11165                                  ; read in the boot sector. set carry if error in reading sector.
 11166                                  ; bx is set to 1 if the boot sector is invalid, otherwise it is 0.
 11167                                  ;
 11168                                  ;	assumes es:di -> bds, ds-> Bios_Data
 11169                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------
 11170                                  
 11171                                  ; 10/03/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 11172                                  
 11173                                  ; 30/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.2
 11174                                  ; (MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS, BIOSCODE:06C3h)
 11175                                  
 11176                                  readbootsec:	
 11177 00000740 B600                    		mov	dh, 0		; head 0
 11178 00000742 B90100                  		mov	cx, 1		; cylinder 0, sector 1
 11179 00000745 E8BF00                  		call	read_sector
 11180 00000748 7243                    		jb	short err_ret
 11181 0000074A 31DB                    		xor	bx, bx		; assume valid boot sector
 11182                                  
 11183                                  		; put a sanity check for the boot sector in here to detect
 11184                                  		; boot sectors that do not have valid bpbs. we examine the
 11185                                  		; first two bytes - they must contain a long jump (69h) or a
 11186                                  		; short jump (EBh) followed by a nop (90h), or a short jump
 11187                                  		; (E9h). if this test is passed, we further check by examining
 11188                                  		; the signature at the end of the boot sector for the word
 11189                                  		; AA55h. if the signature is not present, we examine the media
 11190                                  		; descriptor byte to see if it is valid. for dos 3.3, this
 11191                                  		; logic is modified a little bit. we are not going to check
 11192                                  		; signature. instead we are going to sanity check the media
 11193                                  		; byte in bpb regardless of the validity of signature. this is
 11194                                  		; to save the already developed commercial products that have
 11195                                  		; good jump instruction and signature but with the false bpb
 11196                                  		; informations
 11197                                  
 11198                                  ; that will crash the diskette drive operation. (for example, symphony diskette).
 11199                                  
 11200                                  		; 02/09/2023
 11201                                  		; 19/10/2022
 11202                                  		;cmp	byte [disksector], 69h ; is it a direct jump?
 11203                                  		;jz	short check_bpb_mediabyte ; don't need to find a nop
 11204                                  		;cmp	byte [disksector], 0E9h ; dos 2.0 jump?

 11224                                  ; 15/10/5022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)
 11225                                  ;
 11226                                  ;; 10/03/2019
 11227                                  ;; (MSDOS 3.3, MSDISK.ASM, 1988)
 11228                                  ;;
 11229                                  ;; Don't have to perform the following signature check since
 11230                                  ;; we need to check the media byte even with the good signatured diskette.
 11231                                  ;;
 11232                                  ;;check_signature:
 11233                                  ;;		cmp	word [cs:disksector+1FEh],0AA55h ; see if non-ibm
 11234                                  ;;							 ; disk or 1.x media.
 11235                                  ;;		jz	short checksinglesided ; go see if singled sided medium.
 11236                                  ;;					       ; may need some special handling
 11237                                  
 11238                                  ; check for non-ibm disks which do not have the signature AA55h at the
 11239                                  ; end of the boot sector, but still have a valid boot sector. this is done
 11240                                  ; by examining the media descriptor in the boot sector.
 11241                                  
 11242                                  		; 19/10/2022
 11243                                  check_bpb_mediabyte:
 11244 00000762 A0[6301]                		mov	al, [disksector+15h]
 11245                                  					; [disksector+EXT_BOOT.BPB+EBPB.MEDIADESCRIPTOR]
 11246 00000765 50                      		push	ax ; 02/09/2023
 11247 00000766 24F0                    		and	al, 0F0h
 11248 00000768 3CF0                    		cmp	al, 0F0h	; allow	for strange media
 11249 0000076A 58                      		pop	ax ; 02/09/2023
 11250 0000076B 751E                    		jnz	short invalidbootsec
 11251                                  
 11252                                  ; there were some (apparently a lot of them) diskettes that had been formatted
 11253                                  ; under dos 3.1 and earlier versions which have invalid bpbs in their boot
 11254                                  ; sectors. these are specifically diskettes that were formatted in drives
 11255                                  ; with one head, or whose side 0 was bad. these contain bpbs in the boot
 11256                                  ; sector that have the sec/clus field set to 2 instead of 1, as is standard
 11257                                  ; in dos. in order to support them, we have to introduce a "hack" that will
 11258                                  ; help our build bpb routine to recognise these specific cases, and to
 11259                                  ; set up out copy of the bpb accordingly.
 11260                                  ; we do this by checking to see if the boot sector is off a diskette that
 11261                                  ; is single-sided and is a pre-dos 3.20 diskette. if it is, we set the
 11262                                  ; sec/clus field to 1. if not, we carry on as normal.
 11263                                  
 11264                                  checksinglesided:
 11265                                  		;mov	al, [disksector+15h]
 11266                                  		; 02/09/2023
 11267                                  		; al = [disksector+15h]
 11268 0000076D 3CF0                    		cmp	al, 0F0h
 11269 0000076F 741B                    		jz	short gooddsk
 11270 00000771 A801                    		test	al, 1
 11271 00000773 7517                    		jnz	short gooddsk
 11272 00000775 813E[5601]332E          		cmp	word [disksector+8], 2E33h ; "3."
 11273 0000077B 7507                    		jnz	short mustbeearlier
 11274 0000077D 803E[5801]32            		cmp	byte [disksector+0Ah], 32h ; "2"
 11275 00000782 7308                    		jnb	short gooddsk
 11276                                  
 11277                                  ; we must have a pre-3.20 diskette. set the sec/clus field to 1
 11278                                  
 11279                                  mustbeearlier:				
 11280 00000784 C606[5B01]01            		mov	byte [disksector+0Dh], 1
 11281                                  					; [disksector+EXT_BOOT.BPB+EBPB.SECTORSPERCLUSTER]
 11282 00000789 EB01                    		jmp	short gooddsk
 11283                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 11284                                  
 11285                                  invalidbootsec:				
 11286 0000078B 43                      		inc	bx		; indicate that boot sector invalid
 11287                                  		; 10/12/2022
 11288                                  movbpb_ret:

 11290 0000078C F8                      		clc
 11291                                  err_ret:

 11302                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 11303                                  ; 'movbpb' moves the bpb read from the boot sector into registers for use by
 11304                                  ; getbp routine at has1
 11305                                  ;
 11306                                  ; if the set_id_flag is 1, and if an extended boot record, then set volume
 11307                                  ; serial number, volume label, file system id in bds according to
 11308                                  ; the boot record.  after that, this routine will set the set_id_flag to 2
 11309                                  ; to signal that volume label is set already from the extended boot record
 11310                                  ; (so, don't set it again by calling "set_volume_id" routine which uses
 11311                                  ; the volume label in the root directory.)
 11312                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 11313                                  
 11314                                  ; 10/03/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 11315                                  
 11316                                  		; 19/10/2022

 11323                                  					; number of directory entries

 11326                                  					; size of drive

 11329                                  					; media	descriptor

 11335                                  					; sectors per track

 11354                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
 11355                                  
 11356                                  ;copy the boot_serial number, volume id, and filesystem id from the
 11357                                  ;***extended boot record*** in ds:disksector to the bds table pointed
 11358                                  ;by es:di.
 11359

 11363                                  ;      the boot record information.

 11434                                  ; 15/10/2022
 11435                                  
 11436                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 11437                                  ; read a single sector into the temp buffer.
 11438                                  ; perform three retries in case of error.
 11439                                  ;   inputs:	es:[di].bds_drivenum has physical drive to use
 11440                                  ;		cx has sector and cylinder
 11441                                  ;		dh has head
 11442                                  ;		es:di has bds
 11443                                  ;		ds has Bios_Data
 11444                                  ;
 11445                                  ;   outputs:	carry clear
 11446                                  ;		    Bios_Data:bx point to sector
 11447                                  ;		       (note: some callers assume location of buffer)
 11448                                  ;
 11449                                  ;		carry set
 11450                                  ;		    ax has rom error code
 11451                                  ;
 11452                                  ; register bp is preserved.
 11453                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 11454                                  
 11455                                  ; 10/03/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 11456                                  
 11457                                  		; 19/10/2022
 11458                                  read_sector:	
 11459 00000807 55                      		push	bp
 11460 00000808 BD0300                  		mov	bp, 3		; make 3 attempts
 11461 0000080B 268A5504                		mov	dl, [es:di+4]	; [es:di+BDS.drivenum]
 11462 0000080F BB[4E01]                		mov	bx, disksector	; get es:bx to point to	buffer
 11463                                  rd_ret:					
 11464 00000812 06                      		push	es
 11465 00000813 1E                      		push	ds
 11466 00000814 07                      		pop	es
 11467 00000815 B80102                  		mov	ax, 201h
 11468 00000818 CD13                    		int	13h		; DISK - READ SECTORS INTO MEMORY
 11469                                  					; AL = number of sectors to read, CH = track, CL = sector
 11470                                  					; DH = head, DL	= drive, ES:BX -> buffer to fill
 11471                                  					; Return: CF set on error, AH =	status,	AL = number of sectors read
 11472 0000081A 07                      		pop	es
 11473 0000081B 734A                    		jnb	short okret2
 11474                                  rd_rty:					
 11475 0000081D E86604                  		call	again		; reset	disk, decrement	bp, preserve ax
 11476 00000820 7442                    		jz	short err_rd_ret
 11477 00000822 26F6452301              		test	byte [es:di+23h], 1
 11478                                  		;test	byte ptr [es:di+23h], 1	; [es:di+BDS.flags]
 11479                                  					; fnon_removable

 11485 00000832 C536[2D01]              		lds	si, [dpt]

 11487                                  		;mov	byte [si+9], 15 ; [si+DISK_PARMS.DISK_HEAD_STTL]
 11488                                  		;			; NORMSETTLE
 11489                                  		; 12/12/2022
 11490 00000836 B00F                    		mov	al, 15
 11491 00000838 864409                  		xchg	al, [si+9]
 11492                                  		; 
 11493 0000083B 1F                      		pop	ds
 11494 0000083C A2[2A01]                		mov	[save_head_sttl], al
 11495 0000083F 58                      		pop	ax
 11496                                  rd_skip1_dpt:				
 11497 00000840 06                      		push	es
 11498 00000841 1E                      		push	ds
 11499 00000842 07                      		pop	es
 11500 00000843 B80102                  		mov	ax, 201h
 11501 00000846 CD13                    		int	13h		; DISK - READ SECTORS INTO MEMORY
 11502                                  					; AL = number of sectors to read, CH = track, CL = sector
 11503                                  					; DH = head, DL	= drive, ES:BX -> buffer to fill
 11504                                  					; Return: CF set on error, AH =	status,	AL = number of sectors read
 11505 00000848 07                      		pop	es

 11507 0000084A 803E[2706]00            		cmp	byte [media_set_for_format], 0

 11635                                  ;-----------------------------------------------------------
 11636                                  ; miscellaneous odd jump routines.

 11638                                  
 11639                                  ; if we have a system where we have virtual drives, we need

 12489                                  ; this routine is called if an error occurs while formatting or verifying.
 12490                                  ; it resets the drive,and decrements the retry count.

 12910                                  ; ==========================================================================
 12911                                  ; FormatTrack:
 12912                                  ; if specialfunction byte is 1,then this is a status call to see if there is
 12913                                  ; rom support for the combination of sec/trk and # of cyln,and if the
 12914                                  ; combination is legal. if specialfunction byte is 0,then format the track.
 12915                                  ;
 12916                                  ; input: ES:di points to bds for drive
 12917                                  ;
 12918                                  ; output:
 12919                                  ;	for status call:
 12920                                  ;	specialfunction byte set to:
 12921                                  ;		0 - rom support + legal combination
 12922                                  ;		1 - no rom support
 12923                                  ;		2 - illegal combination
 12924                                  ;		3 - no media present
 12925                                  ;	carry cleared.
 12926                                  ;
 12927                                  ;	for format track:
 12928                                  ;		carry set if error
 12929                                  ;
 12930                                  ; ==========================================================================
 12931                                  
 12932                                  ; 16/03/2019
 12933                                  
 12934                                  		; 19/10/2022
 12935                                  FormatTrack:
 12936 00000E1D C51E[1200]              		lds	bx, [ptrsav]
 12937 00000E21 C55F13                  		lds	bx, [bx+19]	; [bx+IOCTL_REQ.GENERICIOCTL_PACKET

 13459                                  
 13460                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13461                                  ;
 13462                                  ; Set Media Type for Format
 13463                                  ; Performs the int 13 with ah = 18h to see if the medium described in the
 13464                                  ; BPB area in the BDS can be handled by the rom.
 13465                                  ; On Input, ES:DI -> current BDS.
 13466                                  ; The status of the operation is returned in AL
 13467                                  ;
 13468                                  ;	- 0 - if the support is available,and the combination is valid.
 13469                                  ;	- 1 - no rom support
 13470                                  ;	- 2 - illegal combination
 13471                                  ;	- 3 - no media present (rom support exists but cannot determine now)
 13472                                  ;
 13473                                  ; Flags also may be altered. All other registers preserved.
 13474                                  ; If the call to rom returns no error,then the current Dpt is "replaced" by
 13475                                  ; the one returned by the rom. This is Done by changing the pointer in [Dpt]
 13476                                  ; to the one returned. the original pointer to the disk base table is stored
 13477                                  ; in TempDpt, until it is restored.
 13478                                  ;
 13479                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13480                                  
 13481                                  		; 19/10/2022
 13482                                  SetMediaForFormat:

 13869                                  ;	    the media that has the extended boot record.
 13870                                  ;	    for the conventional media,this routine will return "unknown
 13871                                  ;	    media type" error to dos.
 13872                                  ;
 13873                                  ; INPUT :   ES:di -> bds table for this drive.
 13874                                  ;

 13876                                  ;	    if carry set,then al contains the device driver error number
 13877                                  ;	    that will be returned to dos.

 13900                                  ;		  set carry bit;

 13903                                  ;	     ret;	/*already error code is set in the register al

 14074                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14075                                  ;	BootIo
 14076                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14077                                  ;
 14078                                  ; function: read/write the boot record into boot sector.
 14079                                  ;
 14080                                  ; input :
 14081                                  ;	    al=logical drive number
 14082                                  ;	    rFlag = operation (read/write)
 14083                                  ;
 14084                                  ; output:   for read operation,the boot record of the drive specified in bds
 14085                                  ;	    be read into the DiskSector buffer.
 14086                                  ;	    for write operation,the DiskSector buffer image will be written
 14087                                  ;	    to the drive specified in bds.
 14088                                  ;	    if carry set,then al contains the device driver error number
 14089                                  ;	    that will be returned to dos.
 14090                                  ;	    AX,CX,DX register destroyed.
 14091                                  ;	    if carry set,then al will contain the error code from DiskIO.
 14092                                  ;
 14093                                  ; subroutines to be called:
 14094                                  ;	DiskIO:NEAR
 14095                                  ;
 14096                                  ; logic:
 14097                                  ;
 14098                                  ; {
 14099                                  ;	first_sector = 0;	 /*logical sector 0 is the boot sector */
 14100                                  ;	sectorcount = 1;	 /*read 1 sector only */
 14101                                  ;	buffer = DiskSector;	 /*read it into the DiskSector buffer */
 14102                                  ;	call DiskIO (rFlag,drive_number,first_sector,sectorcount,buffer);
 14103                                  ; }
 14104                                  ; ==========================================================================
 14105                                  
 14106                                  		; 19/10/2022
 14107                                  BootIo:	
 14108 00001244 06                      		push	es
 14109 00001245 57                      		push	di
 14110 00001246 53                      		push	bx
 14111 00001247 1E                      		push	ds
 14112 00001248 07                      		pop	es		; Point ES: to Bios_Data
 14113                                  
 14114                                  		; Call DiskIO to read/write the boot sec. The parameters which
 14115                                  		; need to be initialized for this subroutine out here are
 14116                                  		; - Transfer address to Bios_Data:DiskSector
 14117                                  		; - Low sector needs to be initalized to 0. this is a reg. param
 14118                                  		; - Hi sector in [Start_Sec_H] needs to be initialised to 0.
 14119                                  		; - Number of sectors <-- 1
 14120                                  
 14121 00001249 BF[4E01]                		mov	di, disksector	; es:di -> transfer address
 14122 0000124C 31D2                    		xor	dx, dx		; First	sector (h) -> 0
 14123 0000124E 8916[1C05]              		mov	[start_sec_h], dx ; Start sector (h) -> 0
 14124 00001252 B90100                  		mov	cx, 1
 14125 00001255 E8FBF6                  		call	diskio
 14126 00001258 5B                      		pop	bx
 14127 00001259 5F                      		pop	di
 14128 0000125A 07                      		pop	es
 14129 0000125B C3                      		retn

 14136                                  ;	ChangeLineChk
 14137                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14138                                  ;
 14139                                  ; when the user calls get/set media id call before dos establishes the media
 14140                                  ; by calling "media_chk",the change line activity of the drive is going to be
 14141                                  ; lost.	this routine will check the change line activity and will save the
 14142                                  ; history in the flags.
 14143                                  ;
 14144                                  ; FUNCTION: check the change line error activity
 14145                                  ;
 14146                                  ; INPUT :  ES:di -> bds table.
 14147                                  ;
 14148                                  ; OUTPUT:   flag in bds table will be updated if change line occurs.
 14149                                  ;
 14150                                  ; SUBROUTINES TO BE CALLED:
 14151                                  ;	Set_Changed_DL
 14152                                  ;
 14153                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14154                                  
 14155                                  ChangeLineChk:	
 14156 0000125C 268A5504                		mov	dl, [es:di+4]	; [es:di+BDS.drivenum]
 14157 00001260 08D2                    		or	dl, dl		; Fixed	disk?
 14158 00001262 7821                    		js	short ChangeLnChkRet ; Yes, skip it.
 14159                                  		; 12/12/2022
 14160 00001264 26F6452304              		test	byte [es:di+23h], 4
 14161                                  		;test	word [es:di+23h], 4 ; [es:di+BDS.flags]
 14162                                  					; return_fake_bpb
 14163 00001269 751A                    		jnz	short ChangeLnChkRet
 14164 0000126B 803E[7700]01            		cmp	byte [fhave96], 1	; This rom support change line?
 14165 00001270 7513                    		jnz	short ChangeLnChkRet
 14166 00001272 E8EA06                  		call	haschange	; This drive support change line?
 14167 00001275 740E                    		jz	short ChangeLnChkRet ; Do nothing
 14168                                  
 14169                                  		; Execute the rom disk interrupt to check changeline activity.
 14170                                  
 14171 00001277 B416                    		mov	ah, 16h
 14172 00001279 CD13                    		int	13h		; DISK - FLOPPY	DISK - CHANGE OF DISK STATUS (AT,XT2,XT286,CONV,PS)
 14173                                  					; DL = drive to	check
 14174                                  					; Return: AH = disk change status

 14176 0000127D 53                      		push	bx

 14179                                  					; physical drive

 14320                                  ;	    diskette drive and whether the media is the default type
 14321                                  ;	    for that drive. (default type means the max size for that
 14322                                  ;	    drive)
 14323                                  ;
 14324                                  ; INPUT :   ES:DI -> BDS table
 14325                                  ; OUTPUT:   If carry clear
 14326                                  ;	    DS:BX -> Updated IOCtlPacket
 14327                                  ;
 14328                                  ;			 Special Function at offset 0:
 14329                                  ;				0	- Media detected is not default type
 14330                                  ;				1	- Media detected is default type
 14331                                  ;
 14332                                  ;			 Device Type at offset 1:
 14333                                  ;				2       - 720K 3.5" 80 tracks
 14334                                  ;				7	- 1.44M 3.5" 80 tracks
 14335                                  ;				9	- 2.88M 3.5" 80 tracks
 14336                                  ;
 14337                                  ; Error Codes returned in AX if carry set:
 14338                                  ;
 14339                                  ; 8102 - Drive not ready	- No disk is in the drive.
 14340                                  ; 8107 - Unknown media type	- Drive doesn't support this function or
 14341                                  ;				  the media is really unkown, any error
 14342                                  ;				  other than "media not present"
 14343                                  ; 
 14344                                  ; ==========================================================================
 14345                                  
 14346                                  		; 19/10/2022
 14347                                  SenseMediaType:				
 14348 000012D7 C51E[1200]              		lds	bx, [ptrsav]	; DS:BX	points to request header.
 14349 000012DB C55F13                  		lds	bx, [bx+19]	; bx+IOCTL_REQ.GENERICIOCTL_PACKET]
 14350                                  		; 10/10/2022
 14351                                  		;mov	word [bx], 0	; Initialize the 2 packet bytes
 14352 000012DE 31D2                    		xor	dx, dx
 14353 000012E0 8917                    		mov	[bx], dx ; 0
 14354                                  		;
 14355 000012E2 268A5504                		mov	dl, [es:di+4]	; [es:di+BDS.drivenum]
 14356                                  					; Get int 13h drive number from	BDS
 14357                                  		; 10/12/2022
 14358                                  		;xor	dh, dh		; DX = physical	drive number
 14359 000012E6 B420                    		mov	ah, 20h		; Get Media Type function
 14360                                  					; If no	carry media type in AL
 14361 000012E8 CD13                    		int	13h		; DISK - QCACHE	- DISMOUNT
 14362 000012EA 7216                    		jb	short MediaSenseEr ; error code	in AH
 14363 000012EC FE07                    		inc	byte [bx]	; Signal media type is default (bit 1)
 14364                                  DetermineMediaType:			
 14365 000012EE FEC8                    		dec	al
 14366 000012F0 3C02                    		cmp	al, 2		; Chk for 720K ie: (3-1) = 2
 14367 000012F2 740A                    		jz	short GotMediaType
 14368 000012F4 0404                    		add	al, 4
 14369 000012F6 3C07                    		cmp	al, 7		; Chk for 1.44M ie: (4-1+4) = 7
 14370 000012F8 7404                    		jz	short GotMediaType
 14371 000012FA 3C09                    		cmp	al, 9		; Chk for 2.88M	ie: (6-1+4) = 9
 14372 000012FC 7510                    		jnz	short UnknownMediaType ; Just didn't recognize media type
 14373                                  GotMediaType:				
 14374 000012FE 884701                  		mov	[bx+1],	al	; Save the return value
 14375                                  		; 10/12/2022
 14376                                  		; cf = 0
 14377                                  		;clc			; Signal success
 14378 00001301 C3                      		retn
 14379                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14380                                  
 14381                                  MediaSenseEr:				
 14382 00001302 80FC32                  		cmp	ah, 32h		; See if not default media error
 14383 00001305 74E7                    		jz	short DetermineMediaType ; Not really an error

 14385 00001309 80FC31                  		cmp	ah, 31h		; See if media was present
 14386 0000130C 7402                    		jz	short SenseErrExit ; Return drive not ready
 14387                                  UnknownMediaType:

 14389                                  SenseErrExit:

 14399                                  ; 16/10/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)
 14400                                  
 14401                                  ;-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14402                                  ; MSINT13.ASM - MSDOS 6.0 - 1991
 14403                                  ;-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14404                                  ; 16/03/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 14405                                  
 14406                                  ;	int 2f function 13h allows the user to change the orig13 int_13 vector
 14407                                  ;	after booting. this allows testing and implementation of custom int_13
 14408                                  ;	handlers, without giving up ms-dos error recovery
 14409                                  ;	entry:	ds:dx	== addr. of new int_13 handler
 14410                                  ;		es:bx	== addr. of new int_13 vector used by warm boot (int19)
 14411                                  ;	exit:	orig13	== address of new int_13 handler
 14412                                  ;		ds:dx	== old orig13 value
 14413                                  ;		es:bx	== old old13  value
 14414                                  ;
 14415                                  ; int 2f handler for external block drivers to communicate with the internal
 14416                                  ; block driver in msdisk. the multiplex number chosen is 8. the handler
 14417                                  ; sets up the pointer to the request packet in [ptrsav] and then jumps to
 14418                                  ; dsk_entry, the entry point for all disk requests.
 14419                                  ;
 14420                                  ; on exit from this driver, we will return to the external driver
 14421                                  ; that issued this int 2f, and can then remove the flags from the stack.
 14422                                  ; this scheme allows us to have a small external device driver, and makes
 14423                                  ; the maintainance of the various drivers (driver and msbio) much easier,
 14424                                  ; since we only need to make changes in one place (most of the time).
 14425                                  ;
 14426                                  ;   ax=800h - check for installed handler - reserved
 14427                                  ;   ax=801h - install the bds into the linked list
 14428                                  ;   ax=802h - dos request
 14429                                  ;   ax=803h - return bds table starting pointer in ds:di
 14430                                  ;	   (ems device driver hooks int 13h to handle 16kb dma overrun
 14431                                  ;	    problem. bds table is going to be used to get head/sector
 14432                                  ;	    informations without calling generic ioctl get device parm call.)
 14433                                  
 14434                                  ;BIOSSEGMENT equ 70h
 14435                                  DOSBIOSSEG equ 0070h ; 17/10/2022	
 14436                                  
 14437                                  ;;BIOSCODE:1302h (MSDOS 6.21, IO.SYS)
 14438                                  
 14439                                  i2f_handler:				; here is 02C7h:1302h =	0070h:3872h
 14440 00001314 80FC13                  		cmp	ah, 13h
 14441 00001317 7413                    		jz	short int2f_replace_int13
 14442 00001319 80FC08                  		cmp	ah, 8
 14443 0000131C 7431                    		jz	short mine

 14701                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14702                                  ;
 14703                                  ; procedure : HMAPtr
 14704                                  ;
 14705                                  ;		Gets the offset of the free HMA area ( with respect to
 14706                                  ;							seg ffff )
 14707                                  ;		If DOS has not moved high, tries to move DOS high.
 14708                                  ;		In the course of doing this, it will allocate all the HMA
 14709                                  ;		and set the FreeHMAPtr to past the end of the BIOS and 
 14710                                  ;		DOS code. The call to MoveDOSIntoHMA (which is a pointer)
 14711                                  ;		enters the routine in sysinit1 called FTryToMovDOSHi.
 14712                                  ;
 14713                                  ;	RETURNS : offset of free HMA in DI
 14714                                  ;		  BIOS_DATA, seg in DS
 14715                                  ;
 14716                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14717                                  
 14718                                  		; 17/10/2022
 14719                                  HMAPtr:
 14720 0000140F 2E8E1E[3000]            		mov	ds, [cs:BIOSDATAWORD]
 14721                                  		;mov	ds, word ptr cs:BIOSDATAWORD ; [cs:Bios_Data_Word]
 14722 00001414 8B3E[8C08]              		mov	di, [FreeHMAPtr]
 14723                                  		;mov	di, ds:FreeHMAPtr
 14724 00001418 83FFFF                  		cmp	di, 0FFFFh
 14725 0000141B 750F                    		jnz	short HMAPtr_retn
 14726 0000141D 803E[9208]00            		cmp	byte [SysinitPresent], 0
 14727                                  		;cmp	ds:SysinitPresent, 0
 14728 00001422 7408                    		jz	short HMAPtr_retn
 14729 00001424 FF1E[8E08]              		call	far [MoveDOSIntoHMA]
 14730                                  		;call	ds:MoveDOSIntoHMA ; call far [MoveDOSIntoHMA]
 14731 00001428 8B3E[8C08]              		mov	di, [FreeHMAPtr]
 14732                                  		;mov	di, ds:FreeHMAPtr
 14733                                  HMAPtr_retn:				
 14734 0000142C C3                      		retn
 14735                                  
 14736                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
 14737                                  
 14738                                  ; 16/10/2022
 14739                                  
 14740                                  ; move a 512 byte sector from ds:si to es:di, do not trash cx
 14741                                  ; but go ahead and update direction flag, si, & di
 14742                                  
 14743                                  move_sector:
 14744                                  
 14745                                  ; The 80386 microprocessor considers an access to WORD 0FFFFh in
 14746                                  ; any segment to be a fault. Theoretically, this could be handled
 14747                                  ; by the fault handler and the behavior of an 8086 could be emulated
 14748                                  ; by wrapping the high byte to offset 0000h. This would be a lot
 14749                                  ; of work and was, indeed, blown off by the Win386 guys. COMPAQ
 14750                                  ; also handles the fault incorrectly in their ROM BIOS for real
 14751                                  ; mode. Their fault handler was only designed to deal with one
 14752                                  ; special case which occurred in a magazine benchmark, but didn't
 14753                                  ; handle the general case worth beans.
 14754                                  ;
 14755                                  ; Simply changing this code to do a byte loop would work okay but
 14756                                  ; would involve a general case performance hit. Therefore, we'll
 14757                                  ; check for either source or destination offsets being within one
 14758                                  ; sector of the end of their segments and only in that case fall
 14759                                  ; back to a byte move.
 14760                                  
 14761 0000142D FC                      		cld
 14762 0000142E 51                      		push	cx
 14763 0000142F B90001                  		mov	cx, 256
 14764 00001432 81FE00FE                		cmp	si, 0FE00h
 14765 00001436 770A                    		ja	short movsec_bytes
 14766 00001438 81FF00FE                		cmp	di, 0FE00h
 14767 0000143C 7704                    		ja	short movsec_bytes
 14768 0000143E F3A5                    		rep movsw
 14769 00001440 59                      		pop	cx

 14781                                  ; 16/10/2022
 14782                                  
 14783                                  ; check_wrap is a routine that adjusts the starting sector, starting head
 14784                                  ; and starting cylinder for an int 13 request that requests i/o of a lot
 14785                                  ; of sectors. it only does this for fixed disks. it is used in the sections
 14786                                  ; of code that handle ecc errors and dma errors. it is necessary, because
 14787                                  ; ordinarily the rom would take care of wraps around heads and cylinders,
 14788                                  ; but we break down a request when we get an ecc or dma error into several
 14789                                  ; i/o of one or more sectors. in this case, we may already be beyond the
 14790                                  ; number of sectors on a track on the medium, and the request would fail.
 14791                                  ;
 14792                                  ; input conditions:
 14793                                  ;	all registers set up for an int 13 request.
 14794                                  ;
 14795                                  ; output:
 14796                                  ;	dh - contains starting head number for request
 14797                                  ;	cx - contains starting sector and cylinder numbers
 14798                                  ;	(the above may or may not have been changed, and are 0-based)
 14799                                  ;	all other registers preserved.
 14800                                  
 14801                                  check_wrap:	
 14802 00001448 50                      		push	ax
 14803 00001449 53                      		push	bx
 14804 0000144A 06                      		push	es
 14805 0000144B 57                      		push	di
 14806 0000144C E86C00                  		call	find_bds	; get pointer to bds for drive in dl
 14807 0000144F 725E                    		jb	short no_wrap	; finished if DOS doesn't use it
 14808                                  		; 12/12/2022
 14809 00001451 26F6452301              		test	byte [es:di+23h], 1
 14810                                  		;test	word [es:di+23h], 1 ; [es:di+BDS.flags],fnon_removable
 14811 00001456 7457                    		jz	short no_wrap	; no wrapping for removable media
 14812 00001458 268B5D13                		mov	bx, [es:di+13h]	; [es:di+BDS.secpertrack]
 14813 0000145C 89C8                    		mov	ax, cx
 14814 0000145E 83E03F                  		and	ax, 3Fh		; extract sector number
 14815 00001461 39D8                    		cmp	ax, bx		; are we going to wrap?
 14816 00001463 764A                    		jbe	short no_wrap
 14817 00001465 F6F3                    		div	bl		; ah=new sector	#, al=#	of head	wraps
 14818                                  
 14819                                  ; we need to be careful here. if the new sector # is 0, then we are on the
 14820                                  ; last sector on that track.
 14821                                  
 14822 00001467 08E4                    		or	ah, ah
 14823 00001469 7503                    		jnz	short not_on_bound
 14824                                  		; 18/12/2022
 14825 0000146B 48                      		dec	ax ; *
 14826 0000146C 88DC                    		mov	ah, bl		; set sector=BDS_BPB.BPB_SECTORSPERTRACK
 14827                                  					; if on	boundary
 14828                                  		;dec	al ; *		; also decrement # of head wraps
 14829                                  not_on_bound:
 14830 0000146E 80E1C0                  		and	cl, 0C0h	; zero out sector #
 14831 00001471 08E1                    		or	cl, ah		; or in	new sector #
 14832 00001473 30E4                    		xor	ah, ah		; ax = # of head wraps
 14833 00001475 40                      		inc	ax
 14834 00001476 00F0                    		add	al, dh		; add in starting head #
 14835 00001478 80D400                  		adc	ah, 0		; catch	any carry
 14836                                  		; 02/09/2023
 14837 0000147B 268B5D15                		mov	bx, [es:di+15h]	; [es:di+BDS.heads]
 14838 0000147F 39D8                    		cmp	ax, bx
 14839                                  		;cmp	ax, [es:di+15h]	; [es:di+BDS.heads]
 14840                                  					; are we going to wrap around a	head?
 14841 00001481 7632                    		jbe	short no_wrap_head ; do	not lose new head number!!
 14842 00001483 52                      		push	dx		; preserve drive number and head number
 14843 00001484 31D2                    		xor	dx, dx
 14844                                  		;mov	bx, [es:di+15h]	; [es:di+BDS.heads]
 14845 00001486 F7F3                    		div	bx		; dx=new head #, ax=# of cylinder wraps
 14846                                  
 14847                                  ; careful here! if new head # is 0, then we are on the last head.
 14848                                  
 14849 00001488 09D2                    		or	dx, dx
 14850 0000148A 7507                    		jnz	short no_head_bound
 14851 0000148C 89DA                    		mov	dx, bx		; on boundary. set to BDS_BPB.BPB_HEADS
 14852                                  
 14853                                  ; if we had some cylinder wraps, we need to reduce them by one!!
 14854                                  
 14855 0000148E 09C0                    		or	ax, ax
 14856 00001490 7401                    		jz	short no_head_bound
 14857 00001492 48                      		dec	ax		; reduce number	of cylinder wraps
 14858                                  no_head_bound:				
 14859 00001493 88D7                    		mov	bh, dl		; bh has new head number
 14860 00001495 5A                      		pop	dx		; restore drive number and head number
 14861 00001496 FECF                    		dec	bh		; get it 0-based
 14862 00001498 88FE                    		mov	dh, bh		; set up new head number in dh
 14863 0000149A 88CF                    		mov	bh, cl
 14864 0000149C 80E73F                  		and	bh, 3Fh		; preserve sector number
 14865 0000149F B306                    		mov	bl, 6
 14866 000014A1 86CB                    		xchg	cl, bl
 14867 000014A3 D2EB                    		shr	bl, cl		; get ms cylinder bits to ls end
 14868 000014A5 00C5                    		add	ch, al		; add in cylinder wrap
 14869 000014A7 10E3                    		adc	bl, ah		; add in high byte
 14870 000014A9 D2E3                    		shl	bl, cl		; move up to ms	end
 14871 000014AB 86D9                    		xchg	bl, cl		; restore cylinder bits	into cl
 14872 000014AD 08F9                    		or	cl, bh		; or in	sector number
 14873                                  no_wrap:				
 14874 000014AF F8                      		clc
 14875 000014B0 5F                      		pop	di
 14876 000014B1 07                      		pop	es
 14877 000014B2 5B                      		pop	bx
 14878 000014B3 58                      		pop	ax
 14879 000014B4 C3                      		retn
 14880                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14881                                  
 14882                                  no_wrap_head:				
 14883 000014B5 88C6                    		mov	dh, al		; do not lose new head number
 14884 000014B7 FECE                    		dec	dh		; get it 0-based
 14885 000014B9 EBF4                    		jmp	short no_wrap

 14891                                  ; this is a special version of the bds lookup code which is
 14892                                  ; based on physical drives rather than the usual logical drives
 14893                                  ; carry is set if the physical drive in dl is found, es:di -> its bds
 14894                                  ; otherwise carry is clear
 14895                                  ;
 14896                                  ; guaranteed to trash no registers except es:di
 14897                                  
 14898                                  		; 19/10/2022
 14899                                  find_bds:	
 14900 000014BB C43E[1901]              		les	di, [start_bds]	; point es:di to first bds
 14901                                  fbds_1:					
 14902 000014BF 26385504                		cmp	[es:di+4], dl	; [es:di+BDS.drivenum]
 14903 000014C3 7409                    		jz	short fdbs_2
 14904 000014C5 26C43D                  		les	di, [es:di]	; [es:di+BDS.link]
 14905                                  					; go to next bds
 14906 000014C8 83FFFF                  		cmp	di, 0FFFFh
 14907 000014CB 75F2                    		jnz	short fbds_1
 14908 000014CD F9                      		stc
 14909                                  fdbs_2:					
 14910 000014CE C3                      		retn

 14945                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14946                                  
 14947                                  ; 16/10/2022
 14948                                  
 14949                                  ; this is the true int 13 handler. we parse the request to see if there is
 14950                                  ; a dma violation. if so, depending on the function, we:
 14951                                  ;   read/write break the request into three pieces and move the middle one
 14952                                  ;	       into our internal buffer.
 14953                                  ;
 14954                                  ;   format     copy the format table into the buffer
 14955                                  ;   verify     point the transfer address into the buffer
 14956                                  ;
 14957                                  ; this is the biggest bogosity of all. the ibm controller does not handle
 14958                                  ; operations that cross physical 64k boundaries. in these cases, we copy
 14959                                  ; the offending sector into the buffer below and do the i/o from there.
 14960                                  
 14961                                  ;struc INT13FRAME
 14962                                  ;.oldbp: resw
 14963                                  ;.oldax: resw 
 14964                                  ;.oldbx: resw
 14965                                  ;.oldcx: resw
 14966                                  ;.olddx: resw
 14967                                  ;.oldds: resw	; now we save caller's ds, too
 14968                                  ;.olddd: resd
 14969                                  ;.oldf:	resw
 14970                                  ;end struc
 14971                                  
 14972                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14973                                  
 14974                                  ;   entry conditions:
 14975                                  ;	ah = function
 14976                                  ;	al = number of sectors
 14977                                  ;	es:bx = dma address
 14978                                  ;	cx = packed track and sector
 14979                                  ;	dx = head and drive
 14980                                  ;   output conditions:
 14981                                  ;	no dma violation.
 14982                                  
 14983                                  ;	use extreme caution when working with this code. In general,
 14984                                  ;	  all registers are hot at all times.
 14985                                  ;
 14986                                  ;	question:  does this code handle cases where dma errors
 14987                                  ;	  occur during ecc retries, and where ecc errors occur during
 14988                                  ;	  dma breakdowns???? Hmmmmm.
 14989                                  
 14990                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14991                                  
 14992                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14993                                  
 14994 000014E9 90004000                dtype_array:	dd 400090h		; 40:90	is drive type array
 14995                                  
 14996                                  ; 17/10/2022
 14997                                  ;DTYPEARRAY equ dtype_array - DOSBIOSEG_2C7h ; (14F5h for MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)
 14998                                  ; 09/12/2022

 15178 000015AB 74B7                    		jz	short ret_from_i13 ; return with carry clear
 15179 000015AD 53                      		push	bx

 15181 000015AF 52                      		push	dx

 15183                                  loop_ecc:
 15184 000015B3 B80102                  		mov	ax, 201h	; read one sector
 15185                                  
 15186                                  ; we do reads one sector at a time. this ensures that we will eventually
 15187                                  ; finish the request since ecc errors on one sector do read in that sector.
 15188                                  ;
 15189                                  ; we need to put in some "intelligence" into the ecc handler to handle reads
 15190                                  ; that attempt to read more sectors than are available on a particular
 15191                                  ; track.

 15194                                  ; this request.

 15197                                  ; that there may be a starting sector number that is bigger than the number
 15198                                  ; of sectors on a track.

 15201                                  		;;call	far 70:797h ; MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS BIOSCODE:15C5h
