 15206 000015C0 80FC09                  		cmp	ah, 9		; DMA error during ECC read?
 15207 000015C3 741B                    		jz	short handle_dma_during_ecc
 15208 000015C5 80FC11                  		cmp	ah, 11h		; only allow ecc errors
 15209 000015C8 7510                    		jnz	short ok11_exit_err
 15210                                  		; 10/12/2022
 15211                                  		; xor ax ax -> ah = 0
 15212                                  		;mov	ah, 0		; ecc error. reset the system again.
 15213 000015CA 31C0                    		xor	ax, ax		; clear	the error code so that if this
 15214                                  					; was the last sector, no error	code
 15215                                  					; will be returned for the corrected
 15216                                  					; read.	(clear carry too.)
 15217                                  ok11_op:
 15218 000015CC FE0E[2000]              		dec	byte [number_of_sec]
 15219 000015D0 7409                    		jz	short ok11_exit	; all done?
 15220 000015D2 FEC1                    		inc	cl		; advance sector number
 15221                                  					; add 200h to address
 15222 000015D4 FEC7                    		inc	bh
 15223 000015D6 FEC7                    		inc	bh
 15224 000015D8 EBD9                    		jmp	short loop_ecc
 15225                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15226                                  
 15227                                  ; locate error returns centrally
 15228                                  
 15229                                  ok11_exit_err:
 15230 000015DA F9                      		stc			; set carry bit again.
 15231                                  ok11_exit:
 15232 000015DB 5A                      		pop	dx
 15233 000015DC 59                      		pop	cx
 15234 000015DD 5B                      		pop	bx
 15235 000015DE EB88                    		jmp	short i13ret_ck_chglinerr
 15236                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15237                                  
 15238                                  ; do the single sector read again, this time into our temporary
 15239                                  ; buffer, which is guaranteed not to have a DMA error, then
 15240                                  ; move the data to its proper location and proceed
 15241                                  
 15242                                  handle_dma_during_ecc:
 15243 000015E0 06                      		push	es
 15244 000015E1 53                      		push	bx
 15245 000015E2 BB[4E01]                		mov	bx, disksector
 15246 000015E5 1E                      		push	ds
 15247 000015E6 07                      		pop	es		; point es:bx to buffer
 15248 000015E7 B80102                  		mov	ax, 201h	; read one sector
 15249                                  		;;call	far 70:797h ; MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS BIOSCODE:15F8h
 15250                                  		; 17/10/2022
 15251 000015EA 9A[6907]7000            		call	DOSBIOSSEG:call_orig13
 15252                                  		;call	call_orig13	; call far KERNEL_SEGMENT:call_orig13
 15253 000015EF 5B                      		pop	bx
 15254 000015F0 07                      		pop	es
 15255 000015F1 7305                    		jnb	short handle_dma_during_ecc_noerr
 15256 000015F3 80FC11                  		cmp	ah, 11h
 15257 000015F6 75E2                    		jnz	short ok11_exit_err ; if anything but ecc error, bomb out
 15258                                  
 15259                                  ; now we're kosher. Copy the data to where it belongs and resume
 15260                                  ; the ECC looping code.
 15261                                  
 15262                                  handle_dma_during_ecc_noerr:
 15263 000015F8 56                      		push	si
 15264 000015F9 57                      		push	di
 15265 000015FA 89DF                    		mov	di, bx
 15266 000015FC BE[4E01]                		mov	si, disksector
 15267 000015FF E82BFE                  		call	move_sector
 15268 00001602 5F                      		pop	di
 15269 00001603 5E                      		pop	si
 15270 00001604 EBC6                    		jmp	short ok11_op
 15271                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15272                                  
 15273                                  ; we truly have a dma violation. restore register ax and retry the
 15274                                  ; operation as best we can.
 15275                                  
 15276                                  gotdmaerr:
 15277 00001606 A1[1E00]                		mov	ax, [prevoper]	; 19/10/2022
 15278 00001609 FB                      		sti
 15279 0000160A 80FC02                  		cmp	ah, 2		; romread
 15280 0000160D 723B                    		jb	short i13_done_dmaerr
 15281                                  					; just pass dma error thru for
 15282                                  					; functions we don't handle
 15283 0000160F 80FC04                  		cmp	ah, 4		; romverify
 15284 00001612 743C                    		jz	short intverify
 15285 00001614 80FC05                  		cmp	ah, 5		; romformat
 15286 00001617 7448                    		jz	short intformat
 15287 00001619 772F                    		ja	short i13_done_dmaerr
 15288                                  
 15289                                  ; we are doing a read/write call. check for dma problems
 15290                                  
 15291                                  ;	******** set up stack frame here!!! ********
 15292                                  
 15293 0000161B 52                      		push	dx
 15294 0000161C 51                      		push	cx
 15295 0000161D 53                      		push	bx
 15296 0000161E 50                      		push	ax
 15297 0000161F 55                      		push	bp
 15298 00001620 89E5                    		mov	bp, sp
 15299 00001622 8CC2                    		mov	dx, es		; check	for 64k	boundary error
 15300 00001624 D1E2                    		shl	dx, 1
 15301 00001626 D1E2                    		shl	dx, 1
 15302 00001628 D1E2                    		shl	dx, 1
 15303 0000162A D1E2                    		shl	dx, 1		; segment converted to absolute	address
 15304 0000162C 01DA                    		add	dx, bx		; combine with offset
 15305 0000162E 81C2FF01                		add	dx, 511		; simulate a transfer
 15306                                  
 15307                                  ; if carry is set, then we are within 512 bytes of the end of the segment.
 15308                                  ; we skip the first transfer and perform the remaining buffering and transfer
 15309                                  
 15310 00001632 7303                    		jnb	short no_skip_first
 15311 00001634 E98300                  		jmp	bufferx		; restore dh=head & do buffer
 15312                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15313                                  
 15314                                  no_skip_first:
 15315 00001637 D0EE                    		shr	dh, 1		; dh = number of sectors before	address
 15316 00001639 B480                    		mov	ah, 128		; ah = max number of sectors in	segment
 15317 0000163B 28F4                    		sub	ah, dh
 15318                                  
 15319                                  ; ah is now the number of sectors that we can successfully write in this
 15320                                  ; segment. if this number is above or equal to the requested number, then we
 15321                                  ; continue the operation as normal. otherwise, we break it into pieces.
 15322                                  ;
 15323                                  ; wait a sec. this is goofy. the whole reason we got here in the
 15324                                  ; first place is because we got a dma error. so it's impossible
 15325                                  ; for the whole block to fit, unless the dma error was returned
 15326                                  ; in error.
 15327                                  
 15328 0000163D 38C4                    		cmp	ah, al		; can we fit it	in?
 15329 0000163F 7236                    		jb	short doblock	; no, perform blocking.
 15330                                  
 15331                                  ; yes, the request fits. let it happen.
 15332                                  
 15333 00001641 8A7609                  		mov	dh, [bp+9]	; [bp+INT13FRAME.olddx+1]
 15334                                  					; set up head number
 15335 00001644 E888FE                  		call	doint
 15336 00001647 E9D900                  		jmp	bad13		; and return from this place
 15337                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15338                                  
 15339                                  i13_done_dmaerr:
 15340 0000164A B409                    		mov	ah, 9		; pass dma error thru to caller
 15341 0000164C F9                      		stc
 15342 0000164D E914FF                  		jmp	ret_from_i13	; return with error,
 15343                                  					; we know it's not a changeline error
 15344                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15345                                  
 15346                                  ; verify the given sectors. place the buffer pointer into our space.
 15347                                  
 15348                                  intverify:
 15349 00001650 06                      		push	es		; save caller's dma address
 15350 00001651 53                      		push	bx
 15351 00001652 1E                      		push	ds		; es:bx	-> Bios_Data:disksector
 15352 00001653 07                      		pop	es
 15353                                  dosimple:
 15354 00001654 BB[4E01]                		mov	bx, disksector
 15355                                  					; do the i/o from Bios_Data:disksector
 15356                                  		;;call	far 70:797h ; MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS BIOSCODE:1665h
 15357                                  		; 17/10/2022
 15358 00001657 9A[6907]7000            		call	DOSBIOSSEG:call_orig13
 15359                                  		;call	call_orig13	; call far KERNEL_SEGMENT:call_orig13
 15360 0000165C 5B                      		pop	bx
 15361 0000165D 07                      		pop	es
 15362 0000165E E907FF                  		jmp	i13ret_ck_chglinerr
 15363                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15364                                  
 15365                                  ; format operation. copy the parameter table into Bios_Data:disksector
 15366                                  
 15367                                  intformat:
 15368 00001661 06                      		push	es
 15369 00001662 53                      		push	bx
 15370 00001663 56                      		push	si
 15371 00001664 57                      		push	di
 15372 00001665 1E                      		push	ds
 15373                                  
 15374                                  ; point ds to the caller's dma buffer, es to Bios_Data
 15375                                  ; in other words, swap (ds, es)
 15376                                  
 15377 00001666 06                      		push	es
 15378 00001667 1E                      		push	ds
 15379 00001668 07                      		pop	es
 15380 00001669 1F                      		pop	ds
 15381 0000166A 89DE                    		mov	si, bx
 15382 0000166C BF[4E01]                		mov	di, disksector
 15383 0000166F E8BBFD                  		call	move_sector	; user's data into Bios_Data:disksector
 15384 00001672 1F                      		pop	ds
 15385 00001673 5F                      		pop	di
 15386 00001674 5E                      		pop	si		; do the i/o from
 15387 00001675 EBDD                    		jmp	short dosimple	; Bios_Data:disksector
 15388                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15389                                  
 15390                                  ; we can't fit the request into the entire block. perform the operation on
 15391                                  ; the first block.
 15392                                  ;
 15393                                  ; doblock is modified to correctly handle multi-sector disk i/o.
 15394                                  ; old doblock had added the number of sectors i/oed (ah in old doblock) after
 15395                                  ; the doint call to cl. observing only the lower 6 bits of cl(=max. 64) can
 15396                                  ; represent a starting sector, if ah was big, then cl would be clobbered.
 15397                                  ; by the way, we still are going to use cl for this purpose since checkwrap
 15398                                  ; routine will use it as an input. to prevent cl from being clobbered, a
 15399                                  ; safe number of sectors should be calculated like "63 - # of sectors/track".
 15400                                  ; doblock will handle the first block of requested sectors within the
 15401                                  ; boundary of this safe value.
 15402                                  
 15403                                  doblock:
 15404                                  
 15405                                  ; try to get the # of sectors/track from bds via rom drive number.
 15406                                  ; for any mini disks installed, here we have to pray that they have the
 15407                                  ; same # of sector/track as the main dos partition disk drive.
 15408                                  				
 15409 00001677 8B5608                  		mov	dx, [bp+8]	; [bp+INT13FRAME.olddx]
 15410                                  					; get head #, drive #
 15411 0000167A 51                      		push	cx
 15412 0000167B 06                      		push	es
 15413 0000167C 57                      		push	di		; ah - # of sectors before dma boundary
 15414                                  					; al - requested # of sectors for i/o.
 15415 0000167D E83BFE                  		call	find_bds
 15416 00001680 268B4D13                		mov	cx, [es:di+13h]	; [es:di+BDS.secpertrack]
 15417                                  		; 12/12/2022
 15418 00001684 26F6452301              		test	byte [es:di+23h], 1
 15419                                  		;test	word [es:di+23h], 1 ; [es:di+BDS.flags],fnon_removable
 15420 00001689 5F                      		pop	di
 15421 0000168A 07                      		pop	es
 15422 0000168B 88E0                    		mov	al, ah		; set al=ah for	floppies
 15423 0000168D 7404                    		jz	short doblockflop ; they are track by track operation
 15424 0000168F B43F                    		mov	ah, 63		; ah = 63-secpt	(# safe	sectors??)
 15425 00001691 28CC                    		sub	ah, cl		; al - # of sectors before dma boundary
 15426                                  doblockflop:
 15427 00001693 59                      		pop	cx
 15428                                  doblockcontinue:
 15429 00001694 38C4                    		cmp	ah, al		; if safe_# >= #_of_sectors_to_go_before dma,
 15430 00001696 7305                    		jnb	short doblocklast ; then #_of_sectors_to_go as it is for doint.
 15431 00001698 50                      		push	ax
 15432 00001699 88E0                    		mov	al, ah		; otherwise, set al to ah to operate.
 15433 0000169B EB03                    		jmp	short doblockdoint
 15434                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15435                                  
 15436                                  doblocklast:
 15437 0000169D 88C4                    		mov	ah, al
 15438 0000169F 50                      		push	ax
 15439                                  doblockdoint:				; let ah = al =	# of sectors for this shot
 15440 000016A0 E82CFE                  		call	doint
 15441 000016A3 727E                    		jb	short bad13	; something happened, bye!
 15442 000016A5 58                      		pop	ax
 15443 000016A6 286602                  		sub	[bp+2],	ah	; sub [bp+INT13FRAME.oldax], ah
 15444                                  					; decrement by the successful operation
 15445 000016A9 00E1                    		add	cl, ah		; advance sector #. safety gauranteed.
 15446 000016AB 00E7                    		add	bh, ah		; advance dma addres
 15447 000016AD 00E7                    		add	bh, ah		; twice	for 512	byte sectors
 15448 000016AF 38C4                    		cmp	ah, al		; check	the previous value
 15449 000016B1 740A                    		jz	short buffer	; if #_of_sectors_to_go	< safe_#,
 15450                                  					; then we are done already.
 15451 000016B3 28E0                    		sub	al, ah		; otherwise,
 15452                                  					; #_sector_to_go = #_of_sector_to_go - safe_#
 15453 000016B5 E890FD                  		call	check_wrap	; get new cx, dh for the next operation.
 15454 000016B8 EBDA                    		jmp	short doblockcontinue ;	handles	next sectors left.
 15455                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15456                                  
 15457                                  bufferx:
 15458 000016BA 8A7609                  		mov	dh, [bp+9]	; [bp+INT13FRAME.olddx+1]
 15459                                  					; set up head number
 15460                                  buffer:
 15461 000016BD 53                      		push	bx
 15462 000016BE 8A6603                  		mov	ah, [bp+3]	; [bp+INT13FRAME.oldax+1]
 15463 000016C1 80FC03                  		cmp	ah, 3		; romwrite
 15464 000016C4 7525                    		jnz	short doread	;
 15465                                  
 15466                                  ; copy the offending sector into local buffer
 15467                                  
 15468 000016C6 06                      		push	es
 15469 000016C7 1E                      		push	ds
 15470 000016C8 56                      		push	si
 15471 000016C9 57                      		push	di
 15472 000016CA 1E                      		push	ds		; exchange segment registers
 15473 000016CB 06                      		push	es
 15474 000016CC 1F                      		pop	ds
 15475 000016CD 07                      		pop	es
 15476 000016CE BF[4E01]                		mov	di, disksector	; where to move
 15477 000016D1 57                      		push	di		; save it
 15478 000016D2 89DE                    		mov	si, bx		; source
 15479 000016D4 E856FD                  		call	move_sector	; move sector into local buffer
 15480 000016D7 5B                      		pop	bx		; new transfer address
 15481                                  					; (es:bx = Bios_Data:diskbuffer)
 15482 000016D8 5F                      		pop	di		; restore caller's di & si
 15483 000016D9 5E                      		pop	si
 15484 000016DA 1F                      		pop	ds		; restore Bios_Data
 15485                                  
 15486                                  ; see if we are wrapping around a track or head
 15487                                  
 15488 000016DB B001                    		mov	al, 1		; [bp+INT13FRAME.olddx]
 15489                                  					; get drive number
 15490 000016DD 8A5608                  		mov	dl, [bp+8]
 15491 000016E0 E865FD                  		call	check_wrap	; sets up registers if wrap-around
 15492                                  					;
 15493                                  					; ah is	function
 15494                                  					; al is	1 for single sector transfer
 15495                                  					; es:bx	is local transfer addres
 15496                                  					; cx is	track/sector number
 15497                                  					; dx is	head/drive number
 15498                                  					; si,di	unchanged
 15499 000016E3 E8E9FD                  		call	doint
 15500 000016E6 07                      		pop	es		; restore caller's dma segment
 15501 000016E7 723A                    		jb	short bad13	; go clean up
 15502 000016E9 EB22                    		jmp	short dotail
 15503                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15504                                  
 15505                                  ; reading a sector. do int first, then move things around
 15506                                  
 15507                                  doread:
 15508 000016EB 06                      		push	es
 15509 000016EC 53                      		push	bx
 15510 000016ED 1E                      		push	ds		; es = Bios_Code
 15511 000016EE 07                      		pop	es
 15512 000016EF BB[4E01]                		mov	bx, disksector
 15513 000016F2 B001                    		mov	al, 1
 15514 000016F4 8A5608                  		mov	dl, [bp+8]	; [bp+INT13FRAME.olddx]
 15515                                  					; get drive number
 15516 000016F7 E84EFD                  		call	check_wrap	;
 15517                                  					; ah = function
 15518                                  					; al = 1 for single sector
 15519                                  					; es:bx	points to local	buffer
 15520                                  					; cx, dx are track/sector, head/drive
 15521 000016FA E8D2FD                  		call	doint
 15522 000016FD 5B                      		pop	bx
 15523 000016FE 07                      		pop	es
 15524 000016FF 7222                    		jb	short bad13
 15525 00001701 56                      		push	si
 15526 00001702 57                      		push	di
 15527 00001703 89DF                    		mov	di, bx
 15528 00001705 BE[4E01]                		mov	si, disksector
 15529 00001708 E822FD                  		call	move_sector
 15530 0000170B 5F                      		pop	di
 15531 0000170C 5E                      		pop	si
 15532                                  
 15533                                  ; note the fact that we've done 1 more sector
 15534                                  
 15535                                  dotail:
 15536 0000170D 5B                      		pop	bx		; retrieve new dma area
 15537 0000170E 80C702                  		add	bh, 2		; advance over sector
 15538 00001711 41                      		inc	cx
 15539 00001712 8A4602                  		mov	al, [bp+2]	; [bp+INT13FRAME.oldax]
 15540 00001715 F8                      		clc
 15541 00001716 FEC8                    		dec	al
 15542 00001718 7409                    		jz	short bad13	; no more i/o
 15543                                  
 15544                                  ; see if we wrap around a track or head boundary with starting sector
 15545                                  ; we already have the correct head number to pass to check_wrap
 15546                                  
 15547 0000171A 8A5608                  		mov	dl, [bp+8]	; [bp+INT13FRAME.olddx]
 15548 0000171D E828FD                  		call	check_wrap
 15549 00001720 E8ACFD                  		call	doint
 15550                                  
 15551                                  ; we are done. ax has the final code; we throw away what we got before
 15552                                  
 15553                                  ; M046  -- okay gang. Now we've either terminated our DMA loop,
 15554                                  ;	   or we've finished. If carry is set now, our only
 15555                                  ;	   hope for salvation is that it was a read operation
 15556                                  ;	   and the error code is ECC error. In that case, we'll
 15557                                  ;	   just pop the registers and go do the old ECC thing.
 15558                                  ;	   When the DMA error that got us here in the first
 15559                                  ;	   place occurs, it'll handle it.
 15560                                  
 15561                                  bad13:
 15562 00001723 89EC                    		mov	sp, bp
 15563 00001725 5D                      		pop	bp
 15564 00001726 5B                      		pop	bx
 15565 00001727 5B                      		pop	bx
 15566 00001728 59                      		pop	cx
 15567 00001729 5A                      		pop	dx
 15568 0000172A 7203                    		jb	short xgoterr13_xxxx ; go handle ECC errors
 15569 0000172C E935FE                  		jmp	ret_from_i13	; non-error exit
 15570                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15571                                  
 15572                                  xgoterr13_xxxx:
 15573 0000172F E958FE                  		jmp	goterr13_xxxx
 15574                                  
 15575                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15576                                  		; 10/12/2022
 15577                                  		;db 	0
 15578                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15579

 15590                                  dsk_init:				; 2C7h:1742h = 70h:3CB2h
 15591 00001732 8A26[7500]              		mov	ah, [drvmax]

 15594 0000173A 07                      		pop	es

 15597                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
 15598                                  
 15599                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15600                                  ; install_bds installs a bds at location es:di into the current linked list of
 15601                                  ; bds maintained by this device driver. it places the bds at the end of the
 15602                                  ; list. Trashes (at least) ax, bx, di, si
 15603                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15604                                  
 15605                                  install_bds:
 15606 0000173E 1E                      		push	ds		; save Bios_Data segment
 15607 0000173F BE[1901]                		mov	si, start_bds	; beginning of chain
 15608                                  
 15609                                  		; ds:si now points to link to first bds
 15610                                  		; assume bds list is non-empty
 15611                                  loop_next_bds:
 15612 00001742 C534                    		lds	si, [si]	; [si+BDS.link]
 15613                                  					; fetch	next bds
 15614 00001744 268A4504                		mov	al, [es:di+4]	; [es:di+BDS.drivenum]
 15615 00001748 384404                  		cmp	[si+4],	al	; does this one	share a	physical
 15616                                  					; drive	with new one?
 15617 0000174B 7518                    		jnz	short next_bds
 15618 0000174D B310                    		mov	bl, 10h		; fi_am_mult
 15619 0000174F 26085D23                		or	[es:di+23h], bl	; [es:di+BDS.flags]
 15620                                  					; set both of them to i_am_mult	if so
 15621 00001753 085C23                  		or	[si+23h], bl	; [si+BDS.flags]
 15622 00001756 26806523DF              		and	byte [es:di+23h], 0DFh ; [es:di+BDS.flags],~fi_own_physical
 15623                                  					; we don't own it
 15624 0000175B 8A5C23                  		mov	bl, [si+23h]	; [si+BDS.flags]
 15625                                  					; determine if changeline available
 15626 0000175E 80E302                  		and	bl, 2		; fchangeline
 15627 00001761 26085D23                		or	[es:di+23h], bl	; [es:di+BDS.flags]
 15628                                  next_bds:
 15629                                  		; 02/09/2023 (PCDOS 7.1)
 15630 00001765 B8FFFF                  		mov	ax, 0FFFFh	; -1
 15631 00001768 3904                    		cmp	[si], ax	; [si+BDS.link],-1
 15632                                  		;cmp	word [si], 0FFFFh ; [si+BDS.link],-1
 15633                                  					; are we at end	of list?
 15634 0000176A 75D6                    		jnz	short loop_next_bds
 15635 0000176C 8C4402                  		mov	[si+2], es	; [si+BDS.link+2],es
 15636                                  					; install bds
 15637 0000176F 893C                    		mov	[si], di

 15639                                  		;mov	word [es:di], 0FFFFh ; [es:di+BDS.link],-1
 15640                                  					; set next pointer to null
 15641 00001774 1F                      		pop	ds

 15803                                  ; if a different drive is accessed after the current one. in order to avoid

 15805                                  ; is not active and we are accessing a different drive from the last one.

 15848                                  
 15849                                  ; simple, quick check of latched change. if no indication, then return
 15850                                  ; otherwise do expensive check. if the expensive test fails, pop off the
 15851                                  ; return and set al = 15 (for invalid media change) which will be returned to

 15902                                  
 15903                                  		; fall into check_vid
 15904                                  
 15905                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
 15906                                  
 15907                                  ; now with the extended boot record, the logic should be enhanced.
 15908                                  ;
 15909                                  ; if it is the extended boot record, then we check the volume serial
 15910                                  ; number instead of volume id. if it is different, then set si to -1.
 15911                                  ;

 15914                                  ; if it is not the extended boot record, then just follows the old
 15915                                  ; logic. dos 4.00 will check if the # of fat in the boot record bpb
 15916                                  ; is not 0.  if it is 0 then it must be non_fat based system and
 15917                                  ; should have already covered by extended boot structure checking.
 15918                                  ; so, we will return "i don't know" by setting si to 0.

 15921                                  ; (this will be gauranteed by a successful getbp call right before this

 15969                                  ; extended id check
 15970                                  
 15971                                  ; 16/10/2022
 15972                                  
 15973                                  ; the code to check extended id is basically a check to see if the
 15974                                  ; volume serial number is still the same. the volume serial number
 15975                                  ; previously read is in cs:disksector.EXT_BOOT_SERIAL
 15976                                  ; ds:di points to the bds of the drive under consideration.
 15977                                  ; the bds has fields containing the high and low words 
 15978                                  ; of the volume serial number of the media in the drive.
 15979                                  ; compare these fields to the fields mentioned above. if these fields
 15980                                  ; do not match the media has changed and so we should jump to the code
 15981                                  ; starting at ext_changed else return "i don't know" status
 15982                                  ; in the register used for the changeline status and continue executing
 15983                                  ; the code given below. for temporary storage use the register which
 15984                                  ; has been saved and restored around this block.
 15985                                  ;
 15986                                  ; bds fields in inc\msbds.inc
 15987                                  
 15988                                  		; 19/10/2022
 15989                                  do_ext_check_id:

 15991                                  		;mov	ax, word ptr ds:disksector+27h
 15992                                  					; [DiskSector+EXT_BOOT.SERIAL]

 16098                                  
 16099                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16100                                  ;   hidensity - examine a drive/media descriptor to set the media type. if
 16101                                  ;   the media descriptor is not f9 (not 96tpi or 3 1/2), we return and let the
 16102                                  ;   caller do the rest. otherwise, we pop off the return and jump to the tail
 16103                                  ;   of getbp. for 3.5" media, we just return.
 16104                                  ;
 16105                                  ;   inputs:	es:di point to correct bds for this drive
 16106                                  ;		ah has media byte
 16107                                  ;
 16108                                  ;   outputs:	carry clear
 16109                                  ;		    no registers modified
 16110                                  ;		carry set
 16111                                  ;		    al = sectors/fat
 16112                                  ;		    bh = number of root directory entries
 16113                                  ;		    bl = sectors per track
 16114                                  ;		    cx = number of sectors
 16115                                  ;		    dh = sectors per allocation unit
 16116                                  ;		    dl = number of heads
 16117                                  ;
 16118                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16119                                  
 16120                                  hidensity:
 16121                                  
 16122                                  ; check for correct drive
 16123                                  		
 16124                                  		; 12/12/2022
 16125 00001906 26F6452302              		test	byte [es:di+23h], 2		
 16126                                  		;test	word [es:di+23h], 2 ; is it special?

 16184                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16185                                  ; set_changed_dl - sets flag bits according to bits set in bx.
 16186                                  ;		   essentially used to indicate changeline, or format.
 16187                                  ;
 16188                                  ;   inputs:	dl contains physical drive number
 16189                                  ;		bx contains bits to set in the flag field in the bdss
 16190                                  ;   outputs:	none
 16191                                  ;   registers modified: flags
 16192                                  ;
 16193                                  ;	called from int13 hooker.  Must preserve ALL registers!!!
 16194                                  ;
 16195                                  ; in the virtual drive system we *must* flag the other drives as being changed
 16196                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16197                                  
 16198                                  set_changed_dl:	
 16199 00001938 06                      		push	es
 16200 00001939 57                      		push	di
 16201                                  		;les	di, ds:start_bds
 16202                                  		; 19/10/2022
 16203 0000193A C43E[1901]              		les	di, [start_bds]
 16204                                  
 16205                                  ; note: we assume that the list is non-empty
 16206                                  
 16207                                  scan_bds:				
 16208 0000193E 26385504                		cmp	[es:di+4], dl	; [es:di+BDS.drivenum]
 16209 00001942 7504                    		jnz	short get_next_bds
 16210                                  
 16211                                  ; someone may complain, but this *always* must be done when a disk change is
 16212                                  ; noted. there are *no* other compromising circumstances.
 16213                                  
 16214 00001944 26095D23                		or	[es:di+23h], bx	; [es:di+BDS.flags]
 16215                                  					; signal change	on other drive
 16216                                  get_next_bds:				
 16217 00001948 26C43D                  		les	di, [es:di]	; [es:di+BDS.link]
 16218                                  					; go to	next bds
 16219 0000194B 83FFFF                  		cmp	di, 0FFFFh
 16220 0000194E 75EE                    		jnz	short scan_bds	; loop unless we hit end of chain
 16221 00001950 5F                      		pop	di
 16222 00001951 07                      		pop	es
 16223 00001952 C3                      		retn

 16285                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16286                                  ; set_volume_id      -	main routine, calls other routines.
 16287                                  ; read_volume_id     -	read the volume id and tells if it has been changed.
 16288                                  ; transfer_volume_id -	copy the volume id from tmp to special drive.
 16289                                  ; check_volume_id    -	compare volume id in tmp area with one expected for drive.
 16290                                  ; fat_check          -	see of the fatid has changed in the specified drive.
 16291                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16292                                  
 16293                                  ; set_volume_id
 16294                                  ;   if drive has changeline support, read in and set the volume_id
 16295                                  ; and the last fat_id byte. if no change line support then do nothing.
 16296                                  ;
 16297                                  ;   on entry:
 16298                                  ;	es:di points to the bds for this disk.
 16299                                  ;	ah contains media byte
 16300                                  ;
 16301                                  ;   on exit:
 16302                                  ;	carry clear:
 16303                                  ;	   successful call
 16304                                  ;	carry set
 16305                                  ;	   error and ax has error code
 16306                                  
 16307                                  set_volume_id:				
 16308 00001965 52                      		push	dx		; save registers
 16309 00001966 50                      		push	ax
 16310 00001967 E8F5FF                  		call	haschange	; does drive have changeline support?
 16311 0000196A 740B                    		jz	short setvret	; no, get out
 16312 0000196C E81000                  		call	read_volume_id
 16313 0000196F 7209                    		jb	short seterr
 16314 00001971 E8A800                  		call	transfer_volume_id ; copy the volume id	to special drive
 16315 00001974 E8E2FF                  		call	resetchanged	; restore value	of change line
 16316                                  setvret:				
 16317                                  		; 10/12/2022
 16318                                  		; cf = 0
 16319                                  		;clc			; no error, clear carry flag
 16320 00001977 58                      		pop	ax		; restore registers
 16321 00001978 5A                      		pop	dx
 16322 00001979 C3                      		retn

 16324                                  
 16325                                  seterr:

 16327 0000197B 5A                      		pop	dx		; restore dx
 16328 0000197C C3                      		retn

 16330 0000197D 0000                    root_sec:	dw 0			; root sector #

 16341                                  ; read_volume_id read the volume id and tells if it has been changed.
 16342                                  ;
 16343                                  ;   on entry:
 16344                                  ;	es:di points to current bds for drive.
 16345                                  ;
 16346                                  ;   on exit:
 16347                                  ;	carry clear
 16348                                  ;	    si = 1  no change
 16349                                  ;	    si = 0  ?
 16350                                  ;	    si = -1 change
 16351                                  ;
 16352                                  ;	carry set:
 16353                                  ;	    error and ax has error code.
 16354                                  
 16355                                  read_volume_id:
 16356 0000197F 52                      		push	dx		; preserve registers
 16357 00001980 51                      		push	cx
 16358 00001981 53                      		push	bx
 16359 00001982 50                      		push	ax
 16360 00001983 06                      		push	es		; stack the bds last
 16361 00001984 57                      		push	di
 16362 00001985 1E                      		push	ds		; point es to Bios_Data
 16363 00001986 07                      		pop	es
 16364 00001987 BF[A108]                		mov	di, tmp_vid	; "NO NAME	 "
 16365 0000198A BE[9508]                		mov	si, nul_vid	; "NO NAME	 "
 16366                                  		;mov	cx, 11		; PCDOS 7.1 - 02/09/2023
 16367 0000198D B90C00                  		mov	cx, 12		; initialize tmp_vid to	null vi_id
 16368 00001990 F3A4                    		rep movsb
 16369 00001992 5F                      		pop	di
 16370 00001993 07                      		pop	es
 16371 00001994 268A450B                		mov	al, [es:di+11]	; [es:di+BDS.fats]
 16372                                  					; # of fats
 16373 00001998 268B4D11                		mov	cx, [es:di+17]	; [es:di+BDS.fatsecs]
 16374                                  					; sectors / fat
 16375 0000199C F6E1                    		mul	cl		; size taken by	fats
 16376 0000199E 26034509                		add	ax, [es:di+9]	; [es:di+BDS.resectors]
 16377                                  					; add on reserved sectors
 16378                                  					;
 16379                                  					; ax is	now sector # (0	based)
 16380                                  		; 17/10/2022
 16381 000019A2 2EA3[7D19]              		mov	[cs:ROOTSEC], ax
 16382                                  		;mov	word ptr cs:198Fh, ax ; [cs:root_sec]
 16383                                  					; 0070h:3EFFh =	2C7h:198Fh
 16384 000019A6 268B450C                		mov	ax, [es:di+12]	; [es:di+BDS.direntries]
 16385                                  					; # root dir entries
 16386 000019AA B104                    		mov	cl, 4		; 16 entries/sector
 16387 000019AC D3E8                    		shr	ax, cl		; divide by 16
 16388                                  		;mov	cx, ax		; cx is	# of sectors to	scan
 16389                                  		; 02/09/2023 (PCDOS 7.1, one byte opcode)
 16390 000019AE 91                      		xchg	ax, cx		; cx is	# of sectors to	scan
 16391                                  next_sec:
 16392 000019AF 51                      		push	cx		; save outer loop counter
 16393 000019B0 2EA1[7D19]              		mov	ax, [cs:ROOTSEC]
 16394                                  		;mov	ax, word ptr cs:198Fh ; [cs:root_sec]
 16395                                  					; get sector #
 16396 000019B4 268B4D13                		mov	cx, [es:di+19]	; [es:di+BDS.secpertrack]
 16397                                  					; sectors / track

 16400                                  
 16401                                  ; set up registers for call to read_sector
 16402

 16404                                  					; ax= track count from 0

 16406 000019BF 31D2                    		xor	dx, dx

 16408                                  					; # heads on this disc
 16409 000019C5 88D6                    		mov	dh, dl		; head number
 16410 000019C7 88C5                    		mov	ch, al		; track	#
 16411 000019C9 E83BEE                  		call	read_sector	; get first sector of the root directory,
 16412                                  					; ds:bx	-> directory sector
 16413 000019CC 723F                    		jb	short readviderr
 16414 000019CE B91000                  		mov	cx, 16		; # of dir entries in a	block of root
 16415 000019D1 B008                    		mov	al, 8		; volume label bit
 16416                                  fvid_loop:
 16417                                  		; 02/09/2023 (PCDOS 7.1)
 16418 000019D3 382F                    		cmp	[bx], ch ; 0				
 16419                                  		;cmp	byte [bx], 0 ; end of dir?
 16420 000019D5 7433                    		jz	short no_vid	; yes, no vol id
 16421 000019D7 803FE5                  		cmp	byte [bx], 0E5h ; empty entry?
 16422 000019DA 7405                    		jz	short ent_loop	; yes, skip
 16423 000019DC 84470B                  		test	[bx+11], al	; is volume label bit set in fcb?
 16424 000019DF 750F                    		jnz	short found_vid	; jmp yes
 16425                                  ent_loop:
 16426 000019E1 83C320                  		add	bx, 32		; add length of	directory entry
 16427 000019E4 E2ED                    		loop	fvid_loop
 16428 000019E6 59                      		pop	cx		; outer loop
 16429 000019E7 2EFF06[7D19]            		inc	word [cs:ROOTSEC]
 16430                                  		;inc	word ptr cs:198Fh ; inc word [root_sec]
 16431                                  					; next sector
 16432 000019EC E2C1                    		loop	next_sec	; continue
 16433                                  notfound:
 16434                                  		; 02/09/2023
 16435                                  		;xor	si, si
 16436 000019EE EB13                    		jmp	short fvid_ret

 16438                                  
 16439                                  found_vid:
 16440                                  		; 02/09/2023
 16441                                  		; cf = 0  ('test' instruction clears cf)

 16443 000019F1 89DE                    		mov	si, bx		; point	to volume_id
 16444 000019F3 06                      		push	es		; preserve current bds
 16445 000019F4 57                      		push	di
 16446 000019F5 1E                      		push	ds
 16447 000019F6 07                      		pop	es		; point es to Bios_Data
 16448 000019F7 BF[A108]                		mov	di, tmp_vid	; "NO NAME	 "
 16449 000019FA B90B00                  		mov	cx, 11		; VOLID_SIZ-1
 16450                                  					; length of string minus nul

 16452                                  		;xor	al, al
 16453                                  		; 02/09/2023

 16455 00001A00 AA                      		stosb			; null terminate
 16456                                  		;;xor	si, si
 16457                                  		; 02/09/2023

 16610                                  %if (number2mod>0) & (number2mod<16) ; 17/09/2023
 16611                                  		times (16-number2mod) db 0
 16612                                  %endif
 16613                                  
 16614                                  ;align 16
 16615                                  
 16616                                  ; 09/12/2022
 16617                                  BCODE_END	equ $ - BCode_start
 16618                                  ; 29/09/2023
 16619                                  BCODEEND:
 16620                                  ;SYSINITSEG	equ IOSYSCODESEG+(BCODE_END>>4)
 16621                                  ; 13/12/2022
 16622                                  SYSINITOFFSET	equ BCODE_END
 16623                                  SYSINITSEG	equ IOSYSCODESEG+(SYSINITOFFSET>>4)
 16624                                  
 16625                                  ; 30/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.2
 16626                                  ; (SYSINITSEG is 473h for MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS)
 16627

 16673                                  ; 21/10/2022
 16674                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16675                                  ; This source code (version) is based on SYSINIT source code of disassembled
 16676                                  ; MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS file (SYSINIT.BIN)

 16679                                  ; Binary file splitter & joiner: FFSJ v3.3

 16681                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------
 16682                                  ; SYSINIT.TXT (27/01/1983)
 16683                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------
 16684                                  ;    SYSINIT is  a module linked behind the OEM bios.  It takes
 16685                                  ;over  the  system  initialization  after  the  OEM  bios   has
 16686                                  ;performed any  initialization  it  needs  to  do.   Control is
 16687                                  ;transfered with a long jump to the external  variable  SYSINIT
 16688                                  ;
 16689                                  ;
 16690                                  ;   The OEM  has  the  following  variables declared external:
 16691                                  ;
 16692                                  ;   CURRENT_DOS_LOCATION    WORD
 16693                                  ;
 16694                                  ;This word  contains  the  segment  number of the DOS before it
 16695                                  ;is relocated.  The OEM bios must set this value.
 16696                                  ;
 16697                                  ;   FINAL_DOS_LOCATION      WORD
 16698                                  ;
 16699                                  ;This word contains the segment number of the DOS after SYSINIT
 16700                                  ;moves it.  The OEM bios must set this value.
 16701                                  ;
 16702                                  ;   DEVICE_LIST             DWORD
 16703                                  ;
 16704                                  ;This  double  word  pointer  points  to  the  linked  list  of
 16705                                  ;character and block device drivers.  The  OEM  must  set  this
 16706                                  ;value.
 16707                                  ;
 16708                                  ;   MEMORY_SIZE             WORD
 16709                                  ;
 16710                                  ;This word  contains  the  number  of  RAM  paragraphs.  If the
 16711                                  ;bios doesn't set  this  variable  SYSINIT  will  automatically
 16712                                  ;calculate it.   NOTE:  systems with PARITY checked memory must
 16713                                  ;size memory in the BIOS.  SYSINITs method is to  write  memory
 16714                                  ;and read it back until it gets a mismatch.
 16715                                  ;
 16716                                  ;   DEFAULT_DRIVE           BYTE
 16717                                  ;
 16718                                  ;This is  the initial default drive when the system first comes
 16719                                  ;up.  drive a=0, drive b=1,  etc.   If  the  bios  doesn't  set
 16720                                  ;it then drive a is assumed.
 16721                                  ;
 16722                                  ;   BUFFERS                 BYTE
 16723                                  ;
 16724                                  ;This is  the  default  number of buffers for the system.  This
 16725                                  ;value may be overridden by the user in  the  CONFIG.SYS  file.
 16726                                  ;It is DBed to 2 in SYSINIT it should be greater than 1.
 16727                                  ;
 16728                                  ;   FILES                   BYTE
 16729                                  ;
 16730                                  ;This is  the  default  number  of  files for the system.  This
 16731                                  ;value may be overridden by the user in  the  CONFIG.SYS  file.
 16732                                  ;It is  DBed  to  8 in SYSINIT, values less than 5 are ignored.
 16733                                  ;
 16734                                  ;   SYSINIT                 FAR
 16735                                  ;
 16736                                  ;The entry  point  of  the  SYSINIT  module.  OEM BIOS jumps to
 16737                                  ;this label at the end of its INIT code.
 16738                                  ;
 16739                                  ;   The OEM  has  the  following  variables declared public:
 16740                                  ;
 16741                                  ;   RE_INIT                 FAR
 16742                                  ;
 16743                                  ;This is an entry point which allows the BIOS to do some INIT
 16744                                  ;work  after  the  DOS is initialized.  ALL REGISTERS MUST BE
 16745                                  ;PRESERVED.  On entry DS points to the first available memory
 16746                                  ;(after  the DOS).  DS:0 points to a 100H byte program header
 16747                                  ;prefix which represents  the  "program"  currently  running.
 16748                                  ;This  program  should  be  thought  of  as  the OEM BIOS and
 16749                                  ;SYSINIT taken together.  This is not  a  normal  program  in
 16750                                  ;that  no  memory  is  allocated to it, it is running in free
 16751                                  ;memory.
 16752                                  ;NOTES:
 16753                                  ;     At the time this routine is called SYSINIT occupies the
 16754                                  ;highest 10K of memory ("highest" is determined by the  value
 16755                                  ;of the MEMORY_SIZE variable), DO NOT DO WRITES THERE.
 16756                                  ;     Since this is called AFTER DOS is initialized, you can
 16757                                  ;make system calls.  This also implies that the code for this
 16758                                  ;routine    CANNOT   be   thrown   away   by   use   of   the
 16759                                  ;FINAL_DOS_LOCATION since the DOS has already been moved.
 16760                                  ;     If you don't want  anything done just set this to point
 16761                                  ;at a FAR RET instruction.
 16762                                  
 16763                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 16764                                  ; TITLE   BIOS SYSTEM INITIALIZATION
 16765                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 16766

 16969                                  ;**	DPB - Drive Parameter Block
 16970                                  
 16971                                  ; 25/03/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0 (MSDOS 6.0, DPB.INC, 1991)
 16972                                  
 16973                                  ;	BUGBUG - this isn't authorative - it's my probably incomplete and
 16974                                  ;	possibly inaccurate deductions from code study... - jgl
 16975                                  ;
 16976                                  ;	The DPB is DOS's main structure for describing block devices.
 16977                                  ;	It contains info about the "Drive" intermingled with info about
 16978                                  ;	the FAT file system which is presumably on the drive.  I don't know
 16979                                  ;	how those fields are used if it's not the FAT file system - BUGBUG
 16980                                  ;
 16981                                  ;	The DPBs are statically allocated and chained off of DPBHead.
 16982                                  ;	Users scan this chain looking for a match on DPB_DRIVE.
 16983                                  ;	The DPBs are built at init time from info in the SYSDEV structure.
 16984                                  
 16985                                  ; 08/06/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0 (MSDOS 3.3, DPB.INC, 24/07/1987)
 16986                                  
 16987                                  ; 12/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0

 17074                                  ;**	BIOS PARAMETER BLOCK DEFINITION
 17075                                  ;
 17076                                  ;	The BPB contains information about the disk structure.  It dates
 17077                                  ;	back to the earliest FAT systems and so FAT information is
 17078                                  ;	intermingled with physical driver information.
 17079                                  ;

 17084                                  ;	The BDS structure contains a BPB within it.

 17365                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 17366                                  ; BIOSTRUC.INC (MSDOS 3.3 - 24/07/1987) 	
 17367                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 17368                                  					  ;;Rev 3.30 Modification
 17369                                  ; ROM BIOS CALL PACKET STRUCTURES					  
 17370                                  									  
 17371                                  ;*******************************					  
 17372                                  ;System Service call ( Int 15h )					  
 17373                                  ;*******************************					  
 17374                                  ;Function AH = 0C0h, Return system configuration			  
 17375                                  ;For PC and PCJR on return:						  
 17376                                  ;	(AH)	= 80h							  
 17377                                  ;	(CY)	= 1							  
 17378                                  ;For PCXT, PC PORTABLE and PCAT on return:				  
 17379                                  ;	(AH)	= 86h							  
 17380                                  ;	(CY)	= 1							  
 17381                                  ;For all others:							  
 17382                                  ;	(AH)	= 0							  
 17383                                  ;	(CY)	= 0							  
 17384                                  ;	(ES:BX) = pointer to system descriptor vector in ROS		  
 17385                                  ; System descriptor :							  
 17386                                  ;	DW	xxxx		length of descriptor in bytes,		  
 17387                                  ;				minimum length = 8			  
 17388                                  ;	DB	xx		model byte				  
 17389                                  ;				0FFh	= PC				  
 17390                                  ;				0FEh	= PC/XT, Portable		  
 17391                                  ;				0FDh	= PC/JR 			  
 17392                                  ;				0FCh	= PC/AT				  
 17393                                  ;				0F9h	= Convertable			  
 17394                                  ;				0F8h	= Model 80			  
 17395                                  ;				0E0 thru 0EFh = reserved		  
 17396                                  ;									  
 17397                                  ;	DB	xx		secondary model byte			  
 17398                                  ;				000h	= PC1				  
 17399                                  ;				000h	= PC/XT, Portable		  
 17400                                  ;				000h	= PC/JR 			  
 17401                                  ;				000h	= PC/AT 			  
 17402                                  ;				001h	= PC/AT Model 339		  
 17403                                  ;				003h	= PC/RT				  
 17404                                  ;				000h	= Convertable			  
 17405                                  ;									  
 17406                                  ;	DB	xx		bios revision level			  
 17407                                  ;				00 for first release, subsequent release  
 17408                                  ;				of code with same model byte and	  
 17409                                  ;				secondary model byte require revison level
 17410                                  ;				to increase by one.			  
 17411                                  ;									  
 17412                                  ;	DB	xx		feature information byte 1		  
 17413                                  ;				X0000000 = 1, bios use DMA channel 3	  
 17414                                  ;					 = 0, DMA channel 3 not used	  
 17415                                  ;									  
 17416                                  ;				0X000000 = 1, 2nd Interrupt chip present  
 17417                                  ;					 = 0, 2nd Interrupt chip not present
 17418                                  ;									  
 17419                                  ;				00X00000 = 1, Real Time Clock present	  
 17420                                  ;					 = 0, Real Time Clock not present 
 17421                                  ;									  
 17422                                  ;				000X0000 = 1, Keyboard escape sequence(INT 15h)
 17423                                  ;						called in keyboard interrupt
 17424                                  ;						(Int 09h).		  
 17425                                  ;					 = 0, Keyboard escape sequence not
 17426                                  ;						called. 		  
 17427                                  ;				0000XXXX reserved			  
 17428                                  ;									  
 17429                                  ;	DB	xx		feature information byte 2 - reserved	  
 17430                                  ;									  
 17431                                  ;	DB	xx		feature information byte 2 - reserved	  
 17432                                  ;									  
 17433                                  ;	DB	xx		feature information byte 2 - reserved	  
 17434                                  ;									  
 17435                                  ;	DB	xx		feature information byte 2 - reserved	  
 17436                                  ;									  
 17437                                  
 17438                                  ; 22/03/2019									  
 17439                                  struc ROMBIOS_DESC		; BIOS_SYSTEM_DESCRIPTOR						  
 17440 00000000 ????                    .bios_sd_leng:		resw 1				  
 17441 00000002 ??                      .bios_sd_modelbyte:	resb 1					  
 17442                                  .bios_sd_scnd_modelbyte: 
 17443 00000003 ??                      			resb 1					  
 17444 00000004 ??                      			resb 1					  
 17445 00000005 ??                      .bios_sd_featurebyte1:	resb 1					  
 17446 00000006 ????????                			resb 4					  
 17447                                  endstruc

 17556                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 17557                                  ; CURDIR.INC (MSDOS 6.0 - 1991) 	
 17558                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 17559                                  ; 22/03/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 17560                                  
 17561                                  ;**	CDS - Current Directory Structure
 17562                                  ;
 17563                                  ; CDS items are used bu the internal routines to store cluster numbers and
 17564                                  ; network identifiers for each logical name.  The ID field is used dually,
 17565                                  ; both as net ID and for a cluster number for local devices. In the case
 17566                                  ; of local devices, the cluster number will be -1 if there is a potential
 17567                                  ; of the disk being changed or if the path must be recracked.
 17568                                  ;
 17569                                  ;	Some pathnames have special preambles, such as
 17570                                  ;
 17571                                  ;		\\machine\sharename\...
 17572                                  ;	For these pathnames we can't allow ".." processing to back us
 17573                                  ;	up into the special front part of the name.  The CURDIR_END field
 17574                                  ;	holds the address of the seperator character which marks
 17575                                  ;	the split between the special preamble and the regular
 17576                                  ;	path list; ".." processing isn't allowed to back us up past
 17577                                  ;	(i.e., before) CURDIR_END
 17578                                  ;	For the root, it points at the leading /. For net
 17579                                  ;	assignments it points at the end (nul) of the initial assignment:
 17580                                  ;	A:/	\\foo\bar	    \\foo\bar\blech\bozo
 17581                                  ;	  ^		 ^		     ^
 17582                                  
 17583                                  DIRSTRLEN	EQU	64+3		; Max length in bytes of directory strings
 17584                                  TEMPLEN 	EQU	DIRSTRLEN*2
 17585                                  
 17586                                  struc 		curdir_list
 17587                                  ; MSDOS 3.3
 17588 00000000 <res 43h>               .cdir_text	resb	DIRSTRLEN	; text of assignment and curdir
 17589 00000043 ????                    .cdir_flags	resw	1		; various flags
 17590 00000045 ????????                .cdir_devptr	resd	1		; local pointer to DPB or net device
 17591 00000049 ????????                .cdir_ID	resw	2		; cluster of current dir (net ID)
 17592 0000004D ????                    .cdir_usr_word	resw	1
 17593 0000004F ????                    .cdir_end	resw	1		; end of assignment
 17594                                  ; MSDOS 6.0
 17595 00000051 ??                      .cdir_type:	resb	1		; IFS drive (2=ifs, 4=netuse)
 17596 00000052 ????????                .cdir_ifd_hdr:	resd	1		; Ptr to File System Header
 17597 00000056 ????                    .cdir_fsda:	resb	2		; File System Dependent Data Area
 17598                                  .size:
 17599                                  endstruc
 17600                                  
 17601                                  curdirlen	EQU	curdir_list.size	; Needed for screwed up
 17602                                  						; ASM87 which doesn't allow
 17603                                  						; Size directive as a macro
 17604                                  						; argument
 17605                                  %define curdir_netID	dword [curdir_list.cdir_ID]

 17623                                  ; system file table
 17624                                  
 17625                                  ;**	System File Table SuperStructure
 17626                                  ;
 17627                                  ;	The system file table entries are allocated in contiguous groups.
 17628                                  ;	There may be more than one such groups; the SF "superstructure"
 17629                                  ;	tracks the groups.
 17630                                  
 17631                                  struc	SF
 17632 00000000 ????????                .SFLink:	resd	1
 17633 00000004 ????                    .SFCount:	resw	1		; number of entries
 17634 00000006 ????                    .SFTable:	resw	1		; beginning of array of the following
 17635                                  .size:
 17636                                  endstruc
 17637                                  
 17638                                  ;**	System file table entry
 17639                                  ;
 17640                                  ;	These are the structures which are at SFTABLE in the SF structure.
 17641                                  
 17642                                  struc	SF_ENTRY
 17643 00000000 ????                    .sf_ref_count:	resw	1		; number of processes sharing entry
 17644                                  					;   if FCB then ref count
 17645 00000002 ????                    .sf_mode: 	resw	1		; mode of access or high bit on if FCB
 17646 00000004 ??                      .sf_attr: 	resb	1		; attribute of file
 17647 00000005 ????                    .sf_flags:	resw	1		;Bits 8-15
 17648                                  					; Bit 15 = 1 if remote file
 17649                                  					;	 = 0 if local file or device
 17650                                  					; Bit 14 = 1 if date/time is not to be
 17651                                  					;   set from clock at CLOSE.  Set by
 17652                                  					;   FILETIMES and FCB_CLOSE.  Reset by
 17653                                  					;   other reseters of the dirty bit
 17654                                  					;   (WRITE)
 17655                                  					; Bit 13 = Pipe bit (reserved)
 17656                                  					;
 17657                                  					; Bits 0-7 (old FCB_devid bits)
 17658                                  					; If remote file or local file, bit
 17659                                  					; 6=0 if dirty Device ID number, bits
 17660                                  					; 0-5 if local file.
 17661                                  					; bit 7=0 for local file, bit 7
 17662                                  					;      =1 for local I/O device
 17663                                  					; If local I/O device, bit 6=0 if EOF (input)
 17664                                  					;		Bit 5=1 if Raw mode
 17665                                  					;		Bit 0=1 if console input device
 17666                                  					;		Bit 1=1 if console output device
 17667                                  					;		Bit 2=1 if null device
 17668                                  					;		Bit 3=1 if clock device
 17669 00000007 ????????                .sf_devptr:	resd	1		; Points to DPB if local file, points
 17670                                  					; to device header if local device,
 17671                                  					; points to net device header if
 17672                                  					; remote
 17673 0000000B ????                    .sf_firclus:	resw	1		; First cluster of file (bit 15 = 0)
 17674                                  ;.sf_lstclus:	resw	1 ; *	
 17675 0000000D ????                    .sf_time: 	resw	1		; Time associated with file
 17676 0000000F ????                    .sf_date: 	resw	1		; Date associated with file
 17677 00000011 ????????                .sf_size: 	resd	1		; Size associated with file
 17678 00000015 ????????                .sf_position:	resd	1		; Read/Write pointer or LRU count for FCBs
 17679                                  ;
 17680                                  ; Starting here, the next 7 bytes may be used by the file system to store an
 17681                                  ; ID
 17682                                  ;
 17683 00000019 ????                    .sf_cluspos:	resw	1		; Position of last cluster accessed
 17684 0000001B ????????                .sf_dirsec:	resd	1 ; 09/04/2024	; Sector number of directory sector for this file
 17685 0000001F ??                      .sf_dirpos:	resb	1		; Offset of this entry in the above
 17686                                  ;
 17687                                  ; End of 7 bytes of file-system specific info.
 17688                                  ;
 17689 00000020 <res Bh>                .sf_name:	resb	11		; 11 character name that is in the
 17690                                  					; directory entry.  This is used by
 17691                                  					; close to detect file deleted and
 17692                                  					; disk changed errors.
 17693                                  ; SHARING INFO
 17694 0000002B ????????                .sf_chain:	resd	1		; link to next SF
 17695 0000002F ????                    .sf_UID:	resw	1
 17696 00000031 ????                    .sf_PID:	resw	1
 17697 00000033 ????                    .sf_MFT:	resw	1
 17698 00000035 ????                    .sf_lstclus:	resw	1 ; *		; Last cluster accessed
 17699 00000037 ????????                .sf_IFS_HDR:	resd 	1 ; **
 17700                                  .size:
 17701                                  endstruc

 17983                                  
 17984                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 17985                                  ; 21/10/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS - SYSINIT)
 17986                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 17987                                  
 17988                                  ;	MSStack.inc
 17989                                  ;
 17990                                  ;	Interrupt level 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7,(10, 11, 12, 14, 15 - AT level)
 17991                                  ;	should follow the standard Interrupt Sharing Scheme which has
 17992                                  ;	a standard header structure.
 17993                                  ;	Fyi, the following shows the relations between
 17994                                  ;	the interrupt vector and interrupt level.
 17995                                  ; VEC(Hex)    2  8  9  A  B  C	D  E  70  72  73  74  76  77
 17996                                  ; LVL(Deci)   9  0  1  2  3  4	5  6   8  10  11  12  14  15
 17997                                  ;	MSSTACK module modifies the following interrupt vectors
 17998                                  ;	to meet the standard Interrupt Sharing standard;
 17999                                  ;	  A, B, C, D, E, 72, 73, 74, 76, 77.
 18000                                  ;	Also, for interrupt level 7 and 15, the FirstFlag in a standard header
 18001                                  ;	should be initialized to indicat whether this interrupt handler is
 18002                                  ;	the first (= 80h) or not.  The FirstFlag entry of INT77h's
 18003                                  ;	program header is initialized in STKINIT.INC module.
 18004                                  ;	FirstFlag is only meaningful for interrupt level 7 and 15.
 18005                                  ;
 18006                                  
 18007                                  ;  User specifies the number of stack elements - default = 9
 18008                                  ;						 minimum = 8
 18009                                  ;						 maximum = 64
 18010                                  ;
 18011                                  ;  Intercepts Asynchronous Hardware Interrupts only
 18012                                  ;
 18013                                  ;  Picks a stack from pool of stacks and switches to it
 18014                                  ;
 18015                                  ;  Calls the previously saved interrupt vector after pushing flags
 18016                                  ;
 18017                                  ;  On return, returns the stack to the stack pool
 18018                                  ;
 18019                                  
 18020                                  ; This is a modification of STACKS:
 18021                                  ; 1. To fix a bug which was causing the program to take up too much space.
 18022                                  ; 2. To dispense stack space from hi-mem first rather than low-mem first.
 18023                                  ;    . Clobbers the stack that got too big instead of innocent stack
 18024                                  ;    . Allows system to work if the only stack that got too big was the most
 18025                                  ;      deeply nested one
 18026                                  ; 3. Disables NMI interrupts while setting the NMI vector.
 18027                                  ; 4. Does not intercept any interupts on a PCjr.
 18028                                  ; 5. Double checks that a nested interrupt didn't get the same stack.
 18029                                  ; 6. Intercepts Ints 70, 72-77 for PC-ATs and other future products
 18030                                  
 18031                                  		;EVEN
 18032                                  ;align 2
 18033                                  		; 21/10/2022
 18034                                  
 18035 00000000 0000                    		dw	0	; spare field but leave these in order
 18036 00000002 0000                    stackcount:	dw	0
 18037 00000004 0000                    stackat: 	dw	0
 18038 00000006 0000                    stacksize:	dw	0
 18039 00000008 0000                    stacks:		dw	0
 18040 0000000A 0000                    		dw	0
 18041                                  
 18042 0000000C [0800]                  firstentry:	dw	stacks
 18043 0000000E [4800]                  lastentry:	dw	stacks+(defaultcount*entrysize)-entrysize
 18044 00000010 [4800]                  nextentry:	dw	stacks+(defaultcount*entrysize)-entrysize
