 31581                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31582                                  ;*** FixMem - scans the upper memory chain and concatenates adjacent free MCBs
 31583                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31584                                  ; ENTRY   : None
 31585                                  ; EXIT    : None
 31586                                  ; ERROR   : None
 31587                                  ; USES    : Flags, fm_umb, fm_strat
 31588                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31589                                  
 31590                                  	; 01/01/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS)
 31591                                  	; (SYSINIT:2F22h)
 31592                                  FixMem:
 31593                                  	; 01/01/2023
 31594                                  	;push	ax
 31595                                  	;push	bx
 31596                                  	;push	cx
 31597                                  	;push	dx
 31598 000029FE 06                      	push	es
 31599                                  
 31600 000029FF E84900                  	call	fm_link		; Link in UMBs
 31601                                  
 31602 00002A02 E80002                  	call	UmbHead		; Get first upper-memory MCB address (0x9FFF)
 31603 00002A05 723F                    	jc	short fmX	; (if couldn't get it, leave now).
 31604                                  
 31605 00002A07 8EC0                    	mov	es,ax		; It returns in AX, so move it to ES.
 31606                                  
 31607                                  ; - Walk MCB Chain ------------------------------------------------------------
 31608                                  
 31609 00002A09 31D2                    	xor	dx,dx		; We're keeping the address of the last MCB
 31610 00002A0B 89D1                    	mov 	cx,dx		; in CX... and the last owner
 31611 00002A0D 42                      	inc	dx		; in dx as we go through the loop:
 31612                                  
 31613                                  ; ------------------------------------------
 31614                                  ; FM10--DX  = last MCB's owner's PSP address
 31615                                  ;       CX  = last MCB's address (segment)
 31616                                  ; ------------------------------------------
 31617                                  
 31618 00002A0E 26A00000                fm10:	mov	al,[es:ARENA.SIGNATURE] ; if 'Z', don't repeat loop
 31619 00002A12 268B1E0100              	mov	bx,[es:ARENA.OWNER]	; if not zero, do nothing
 31620 00002A17 09D3                    	or	bx,dx			; dx was owner of previous MCB
 31621 00002A19 7516                    	jnz	short fm30		; If not both zero, don't cat.
 31622                                  
 31623                                  	; - Coalesce memory blocks at ES:00 and CX:00 -------------------------
 31624                                  
 31625 00002A1B 268B1E0300              fm20:	mov	bx,[es:ARENA.SIZE]	; Grab this block's Size,
 31626 00002A20 8EC1                    	mov	es,cx			; Go back to prev MCB's address
 31627 00002A22 26A20000                	mov	[es:ARENA.SIGNATURE],al ; & move the SECOND sig here
 31628                                  
 31629 00002A26 26031E0300              	add	bx,[es:ARENA.SIZE]	; Size += first MCB's size
 31630                                  	;add	bx,1			; And add one for the header
 31631                                  	; 11/07/2023
 31632 00002A2B 43                      	inc	bx
 31633 00002A2C 26891E0300              	mov	[es:ARENA.SIZE],bx	; Write the size
 31634                                  
 31635                                  	; ---------------------------------------------------------------------
 31636                                  
 31637 00002A31 8CC1                    fm30:	mov	cx,es			; Put this address on the stack
 31638 00002A33 268B160100              	mov	dx,[es:ARENA.OWNER]	; And remember its owner
 31639                                  
 31640 00002A38 8CC3                    	mov	bx,es			; Move to the next MCB
 31641 00002A3A 26031E0300              	add	bx,[es:ARENA.SIZE]
 31642 00002A3F 43                      	inc	bx
 31643 00002A40 8EC3                    	mov	es,bx
 31644                                  
 31645                                  	;cmp	al,'Z'
 31646 00002A42 3C5A                    	cmp	al,arena_signature_end
 31647 00002A44 75C8                    	jne	short fm10		; If signature != 'Z', there are more.
 31648                                  fmX:	
 31649 00002A46 E81300                  	call	fm_unlink		; Unlink UMBs
 31650                                  
 31651 00002A49 07                      	pop	es
 31652                                  	; 01/01/2023
 31653                                  	;pop	dx
 31654                                  	;pop	cx
 31655                                  	;pop	bx
 31656                                  	;pop	ax
 31657                                  
 31658 00002A4A C3                      	retn
 31659                                  
 31660                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31661                                  ;*** fm_link - links UMBs not already linked in
 31662                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31663                                  ; ENTRY:    None
 31664                                  ; EXIT:     fm_umb == 0 if not linked in previously, 1 if already linked in
 31665                                  ; ERROR:    None
 31666                                  ; USES:     AX, BX, fm_umb
 31667                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31668                                  
 31669                                  	; 01/01/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2
 31670                                  fm_link:
 31671 00002A4B B80258                  	mov	ax,DOS_CHECK_UMBLINK ; 5802h
 31672 00002A4E CD21                    	int	21h			; Current link-state is now in al
 31673                                  
 31674                                  	;putdata fm_umb,al		; So store it in fm_umb for later
 31675                                  	;
 31676                                  	;push	es
 31677                                  	;push	cs
 31678                                  	;pop	es
 31679                                  	;mov	[es:fm_umb],al
 31680                                  	;pop	es
 31681                                  	
 31682                                  	; 01/01/2023
 31683                                  	; ds = cs
 31684                                  	;mov	[cs:fm_umb],al
 31685 00002A50 A2[351F]                	mov	[fm_umb],al
 31686                                  
 31687 00002A53 B80358                  	mov	ax,DOS_SET_UMBLINK ; 5803h
 31688 00002A56 BB0100                  	mov	bx,1
 31689 00002A59 CD21                    	int	21h
 31690 00002A5B C3                      	retn
 31691                                  
 31692                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31693                                  ;*** fm_unlink - unlinks UMBs if fm_umb is set to 0
 31694                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31695                                  ; ENTRY:    fm_umb == 1 : leave linked, else unlink
 31696                                  ; EXIT:     None
 31697                                  ; ERROR:    None
 31698                                  ; USES:     AX, BX
 31699                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31700                                  
 31701                                  	; 01/01/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2
 31702                                  fm_unlink:
 31703 00002A5C 31DB                    	xor	bx,bx
 31704                                  	
 31705                                  	;getdata bl,fm_umb		; fm_umb already has the old link-state
 31706                                  	;
 31707                                  	;push	ds
 31708                                  	;push	cs
 31709                                  	;pop	ds
 31710                                  	;mov	bl,[fm_umb]	
 31711                                  	;pop	ds
 31712                                  	
 31713                                  	; 01/01/2023
 31714                                  	; ds = cs
 31715                                  	;mov	bl,[cs:fm_umb]
 31716 00002A5E 8A1E[351F]              	mov	bl,[fm_umb]
 31717                                  
 31718 00002A62 B80358                  	mov	ax,DOS_SET_UMBLINK ; 5803h
 31719 00002A65 CD21                    	int	21h			; so just use that, and call int 21h
 31720 00002A67 C3                      	retn
 31721                                  
 31722                                  ; 08/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 31723                                  
 31724                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31725                                  ;*** ParseVar - parses [/S][/L:umb[,size][;umb[,size]]*] and builds the table
 31726                                  ; laid out in highvar.inc
 31727                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31728                                  ; ENTRY:    ES:SI points to command tail of LoadHigh/DeviceHigh (whitespace ok)
 31729                                  ; EXIT:     ES:SI points to first character in child program name
 31730                                  ; ERROR:    ES:SI points to character which caused error, carry set, AX == code
 31731                                  ; USES:     ES:SI, AX, flags, variables in highvar.inc
 31732                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31733                                  ; Error codes (in AX if carry set on return):
 31734                                  ;
 31735                                  PV_InvArg	equ	1	; Invalid argument passed
 31736                                  PV_BadUMB	equ	2	; Bad UMB number passed (duplicate?)
 31737                                  PV_InvSwt	equ	3	; Unrecognized switch passed
 31738                                  ;
 31739                                  ; This routine exects ES:SI to point to a string much like the following:
 31740                                  ;    "/S/L:1,200;2 module options"
 31741                                  ; Optionally, the string can begin with whitespace; neither /S nor /L is
 31742                                  ; required, though that's what this routine is supposed to parse.
 31743                                  ;
 31744                                  optS		equ	'S'	; /S
 31745                                  optL		equ	'L'	; /L:...
 31746                                  ;
 31747                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31748                                  ; LoadHigh has a list of arguments, returned by cparse, which is used to create
 31749                                  ; a command-line for spawning a child process. For a typical LH command, say,
 31750                                  ;     lh /l:1,1000;2 print/d:lpt2
 31751                                  ; the arguments would look like (one per line):
 31752                                  ;     lh
 31753                                  ;     /l
 31754                                  ;     1
 31755                                  ;     1000
 31756                                  ;     2
 31757                                  ;     print
 31758                                  ;     /d
 31759                                  ;     :lpt2
 31760                                  ; In short, if "print" were, say, "43", there'd be no way to determine which
 31761                                  ; arg was the filename. So, inside this routine, we keep a running counter
 31762                                  ; of the number of arguments LH will need to skip in order to get to the
 31763                                  ; program name. The "lh" is implicit--it'll always have to skip that. So if
 31764                                  ; there's no "/l" or "/s", fm_argc will be 0 ... other than that, 1 is added
 31765                                  ; for:
 31766                                  ;    Each /L
 31767                                  ;    Each /S (there should be only one)
 31768                                  ;    Each UMB number (they follow ":" or ";")
 31769                                  ;    Each UMB size   (they follow ",")
 31770                                  ; So, in the above example, fm_argc would be 4-- and LH would skip right to
 31771                                  ; "print".  Note that InitVar initializes fm_argc to zero.
 31772                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31773                                  
 31774                                  	; 01/01/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS)
 31775                                  	; (SYSINIT:2F9Fh)
 31776                                  
 31777                                  ParseVar:
 31778                                  	;pushreg <di, ds, es>
 31779                                  	; 01/01/2023

 31781 00002A68 1E                      	push	ds
 31782 00002A69 06                      	push	es
 31783                                  
 31784 00002A6A 06                      	push	es		; Make DS:SI point to it, as well as ES:SI
 31785 00002A6B 1F                      	pop	ds		; (regardless if we're in devhigh or loadhigh)
 31786 00002A6C FC                      	cld
 31787

 31789                                  ; PV10--ES:SI = any whitespace on the command-line
 31790                                  ; ------------------------------------------------

 31793 00002A6E E8A200                  	call	isWhite

 31800 00002A78 F8                      	clc			; that "m" we just read (or whatever it is).

 31802

 31804                                  	;toUpper al		; So we make it upper-case, and...

 31806                                  	;cmp	al,'S'

 31808 00002A80 750D                    	jne	short pv30

 31832 00002A98 E80E00                  	call	parseL
 31833 00002A9B 73D0                    	jnc	short pv10	; If no carry, go back and look for more
 31834                                  
 31835 00002A9D 4E                      	dec	si		; Else, back up and exit.
 31836 00002A9E EB03                    	jmp	short pvErr	; AX has already been set by parseL

 31845 00002AA7 1F                      	pop	ds

 31848 00002AA8 C3                      	retn

 31850                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31851                                  ;*** parseL - parses ":nnnn[,nnnn][;nnnn[,nnnn]]*" for ParseVar
 31852                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31853                                  ; ENTRY:    ES:SI points to colon
 31854                                  ; EXIT:     ES:SI points to first character not parsed
 31855                                  ; ERROR:    Carry set; rewind three characters and return (see ParseVar)
 31856                                  ; USES:     ES:SI, flags, AX, CX, DX, variables in highvar.inc
 31857                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31858                                  ; If the string here is terminated with anything other than whitespace or a
 31859                                  ; switchchar (perhaps it's /S or another /L:... ), then we return with carry
 31860                                  ; set, indicating that they've screwed up the syntax.  The 3-character rewind
 31861                                  ; makes sure the app /L: is reported as being the culprit.
 31862                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 32172                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32173                                  ;*** toDigit - converts a character-digit to its binary counterpart
 32174                                  ;            -- verifies that CL contains a valid character-digit; if so, it
 32175                                  ; changes CL to its counterpart binary digit ((CL-'0') or (CL-'A'+10)).
 32176                                  ; A-F are considered valid iff gnradix is 16.
 32177                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32178                                  ; ENTRY:    CL contains a digit ('0' to '9' or, if gnradix==16, 'A' to 'F')
 32179                                  ; EXIT:     CL contains digit in binary (0 to 9 or, if gnradix==16, 0 to 15)
 32180                                  ; ERROR:    Carry set indicates invalid digit; carry clear indicates good digit
 32181                                  ; USES:     CL, Flags
 32182                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32183                                  ; If the string is preceeded with "0x", the value is read as hexadecimal; else,
 32184                                  ; as decimal. After a read, you may check the radix by examining gnradix--it
 32185                                  ; will be 10 or 16.
 32186                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32187                                  
 32188                                  gnradix:
 32189 00002B56 0000                    	dw	0		; Must be a word--16x16 multiplication
 32190                                  
 32191                                  toDigit:
 32192 00002B58 2E833E[562B]10          	cmp	word [cs:gnradix],16
 32193 00002B5E 751C                    	jne	short td20	; Don't check hex digits if radix isn't 16
 32194                                  
 32195                                  toDigit_hex:
 32196 00002B60 80F961                  	cmp	cl,'a'	; 61h
 32197 00002B63 7209                    	jb	short td10
 32198 00002B65 80F966                  	cmp	cl,'f'	; 66h
 32199 00002B68 7720                    	ja	short tdE	; Nothing valid above 'z' at all...
 32200 00002B6A 80E957                  	sub	cl,'a'-10 ; 57h	; Make 'a'==10 and return.
 32201                                  	;clc			; <- CLC is implicit from last SUB
 32202 00002B6D C3                      	retn
 32203                                  td10:	
 32204 00002B6E 80F941                  	cmp	cl,'A'  ; 41h
 32205 00002B71 7209                    	jb	short td20	; Below 'A'?  Not a letter...
 32206 00002B73 80F946                  	cmp	cl,'F'	; 46h
 32207 00002B76 7712                    	ja	short tdE	; Above 'F'?  Not a digit.
 32208 00002B78 80E937                  	sub	cl,'A'-10 ; 37h	; Make 'A'==10 and return.
 32209                                  	;clc			; <- CLC is implicit from last SUB
 32210 00002B7B C3                      	retn
 32211                                  toDigit_dec:
 32212                                  td20:	
 32213 00002B7C 80F930                  	cmp	cl,'0'		; If less than zero,
 32214                                  	;jb	short tdE	; Done.
 32215 00002B7F 720A                    	jb	short tdEr ; 08/04/2019
 32216 00002B81 80F939                  	cmp	cl,'9'		; Or, if greater than nine,
 32217 00002B84 7704                    	ja	short tdE	; Done.
 32218 00002B86 80E930                  	sub	cl,'0'	; 30h	; Okay--make '0'==0 and return.
 32219                                  	;clc			; <- CLC is implicit from last SUB
 32220 00002B89 C3                      	retn
 32221                                  tdE:	
 32222 00002B8A F9                      	stc

 32226                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32227                                  ;*** GetXNum - reads a 32-bit ASCII number at ES:SI and returns it in DX:AX
 32228                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32229                                  ; ENTRY:    ES:SI points to an ascii string to scan
 32230                                  ; EXIT:     ES:SI moved to first invalid digit, DX:AX contains value read
 32231                                  ; ERROR:    Carry set if # is too big, or has no digits (EOL possibly)
 32232                                  ; USES:     ES:SI, DX, AX, Flags, gnradix
 32233                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32234                                  ; If the string is preceeded with "0x", the value is read as hexadecimal; else,
 32235                                  ; as decimal. After a read, you may check the radix by examining gnradix--it
 32236                                  ; will be 10 or 16.
 32237                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32238                                  
 32239                                  ; 08/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 32240                                  
 32241                                  ; 01/01/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS)
 32242                                  ; (SYSINIT:3109h)
 32243                                  
 32244                                  GetXNum:
 32245                                  	;pushreg <bx, cx, ds>
 32246                                  	; 01/01/2023
 32247                                  	;push	bx
 32248 00002B8C 51                      	push	cx ; *
 32249                                  	;push	ds
 32250                                  
 32251 00002B8D FC                      	cld
 32252 00002B8E 31C0                    	xor	ax,ax
 32253 00002B90 31DB                    	xor	bx,bx
 32254 00002B92 31C9                    	xor	cx,cx
 32255 00002B94 31D2                    	xor	dx,dx			; Start with 0 (makes sense)
 32256                                  
 32257 00002B96 2EC706[562B]0A00        	mov	word [cs:gnradix],10	; And default to a radix of 10 (dec)
 32258                                  
 32259 00002B9D 268A0C                  	mov	cl,[es:si]		; Now AX=0, BX=0, CH=0/CL=char, DX=0
 32260                                  	;call	toDigit
 32261 00002BA0 E8D9FF                  	call	toDigit_dec
 32262                                  	;jc	short gxnE		; If it's not a digit, leave now.
 32263                                  	; 01/01/2023
 32264 00002BA3 7233                    	jc	short gxnX
 32265                                  
 32266 00002BA5 08C9                    	or	cl,cl
 32267 00002BA7 7517                    	jnz	short gxn20		; Doesn't have '0x'
 32268 00002BA9 268A4C01                	mov	cl,[es:si+1]
 32269 00002BAD 80F978                  	cmp	cl,'x'			; Either 'x'...
 32270 00002BB0 7405                    	je	short gxn10
 32271 00002BB2 80F958                  	cmp	cl,'X'			; ...or 'X' means it's hexadecimal
 32272 00002BB5 7509                    	jne	short gxn20
 32273                                  
 32274                                  gxn10:	
 32275 00002BB7 2EC706[562B]1000        	mov	word [cs:gnradix], 16
 32276 00002BBE 46                      	inc	si			; Since we read "0x", march over it.
 32277 00002BBF 46                      	inc	si
 32278                                  
 32279                                  ; ------------------------------------------------------
 32280                                  ; GXN20--ES:SI = a digit in a number; if not, we're done
 32281                                  ;        DX:AX = current total
 32282                                  ;        BX    = 0
 32283                                  ;        CH    = 0
 32284                                  ; ------------------------------------------------------
 32285                                  
 32286                                  gxn20:	
 32287 00002BC0 268A0C                  	mov	cl,[es:si]	; Now DX:AX=current total, CH=0/CL=char
 32288 00002BC3 46                      	inc	si
 32289                                  
 32290 00002BC4 E891FF                  	call	toDigit		; Accepts only valid digits, A-F -> 10-16
 32291 00002BC7 720D                    	jc	short gxnQ	; <- Ah... wasn't a digit. Stop.
 32292                                  
 32293 00002BC9 E80E00                  	call	mul32		; Multiply DX:AX by gnradix
 32294 00002BCC 720A                    	jc	short gxnX	; (if it's too big, error out)
 32295                                  
 32296 00002BCE 01C8                    	add	ax,cx		; Add the digit
 32297 00002BD0 11DA                    	adc	dx,bx		; (BX is 0!)--Adds 1 iff last add wrapped
 32298                                  	;jc	short gxnX	; If _that_ wrapped, it's too big.
 32299                                  	;jmp	short gxn20
 32300 00002BD2 73EC                    	jnc	short gxn20
 32301                                  gxnE:	
 32302                                  	;stc			; In this case, we need to set the carry
 32303 00002BD4 EB02                    	jmp	short gxnX	; and leave--there were no digits given.
 32304                                  gxnQ:	
 32305 00002BD6 4E                      	dec	si		; Don't read in the offensive character.
 32306 00002BD7 F8                      	clc			; And clear carry, so they know it's okay.
 32307                                  gxnX:	
 32308                                  	; 01/01/2023
 32309                                  	;pop	ds
 32310 00002BD8 59                      	pop	cx ; *
 32311                                  	;pop	bx
 32312 00002BD9 C3                      	retn
 32313                                  
 32314                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32315                                  ;*** mul32 - multiplies the number in DX:AX by gnradix
 32316                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32317                                  ; ENTRY:   DX:AX = the number to be multiplied, BX = 0, gnradix = multiplier
 32318                                  ; EXIT:    DX:AX has been multiplied by gnradix if carry clear; BX still 0
 32319                                  ; ERROR:   Carry set if number was too large
 32320                                  ; USES:    Flags, AX, DX
 32321                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32322                                  
 32323                                  mul32:
 32324 00002BDA 50                      	push	ax		; DX=old:hi, AX=old:lo, TOS=old:lo, BX=0
 32325 00002BDB 89D0                    	mov	ax,dx		; DX=old:hi, AX=old:hi, TOS=old:lo, BX=0
 32326 00002BDD 2EF726[562B]            	mul	word [cs:gnradix] ; DX=?, AX=new:hi, TOS=old:lo, BX=0
 32327 00002BE2 7211                    	jc	short m32E	; Too big?
 32328                                  
 32329 00002BE4 89C2                    	mov	dx,ax		; DX=new:hi, AX=new:hi, TOS=old:lo, BX=0
 32330 00002BE6 58                      	pop	ax		; DX=new:hi, AX=old:lo, TOS=orig, BX=0
 32331                                  
 32332 00002BE7 87D3                    	xchg	dx,bx		; DX=0, AX=old:lo, TOS=orig, BX=new:hi
 32333 00002BE9 2EF726[562B]            	mul	word [cs:gnradix] ; DX=carry,  AX=new:lo, TOS=orig, BX=new:hi
 32334 00002BEE 87D3                    	xchg	dx,bx		; DX=new:hi, AX=new:lo, TOS=orig, BX=carry
 32335 00002BF0 01DA                    	add	dx,bx		; DX=new:hi, AX=new:lo, TOS=orig, BX=carry
 32336 00002BF2 31DB                    	xor	bx,bx		; DX=new:hi, AX=new:lo, TOS=orig, BX=0
 32337 00002BF4 C3                      	retn
 32338                                  m32E:	
 32339 00002BF5 58                      	pop	ax
 32340 00002BF6 C3                      	retn
 32341                                  
 32342                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32343                                  ;*** toPara - divides DX:AX by 16; result in AX only (discards extra DX data)
 32344                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32345                                  ; ENTRY:   DX:AX = the number to be divided

 32347                                  ; ERROR:   None

 32363 00002C01 09D0                    	or	ax,dx		;    AX=hhhh LLLL llll llll

 32454                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32455                                  ;*** AddrToUmb - converts a segment address in AX to its appropriate UMB number
 32456                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32457                                  ; ENTRY:  AX contains a segment address
 32458                                  ; EXIT:   AX will contain the UMB number which contains the address (0==conv)
 32459                                  ; ERROR:  If the address is above UM Range, AX will return as FFFF.
 32460                                  ; USES:   Flags, AX
 32461                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32462                                  ; An address in the following areas is treated as:
 32463                                  ;    0      <-> umbhead (0x9FFF)          = Conventional memory
 32464                                  ;    0x9FFF <-> addr of first UM sys MCB  = UMB #1
 32465                                  ;      ...
 32466                                  ;    addr of last UM sys MCB <-> TOM      = invalid; returns #0xFFFF
 32467                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32468                                  
 32469                                  	; 01/01/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2
 32470                                  AddrToUmb:
 32471                                  	; 01/01/2023
 32472                                  	;push	cx
 32473                                  	;push	dx
 32474 00002C22 06                      	push	es
 32475                                  
 32476 00002C23 89C2                    	mov	dx,ax		; DX = address to search for
 32477                                  
 32478 00002C25 E8DDFF                  	call	UmbHead		; AX = first segment
 32479 00002C28 7222                    	jc	short atuE	; If it couldn't get it, error out.
 32480                                  
 32481                                  	; 22/07/2023
 32482                                  	;mov	es,ax ; *	; ES = first UMB segment
 32483 00002C2A 31C9                    	xor	cx,cx ; 0	; Pretend we're on UMB 0 for now... (cx = UMB#)
 32484                                  
 32485                                  	; 22/07/2023
 32486                                  atu10:
 32487 00002C2C 8EC0                    	mov	es,ax ; * ; ** ; 22/07/2023
 32488                                  ; ----------------------------------------
 32489                                  ; ATU10--ES - Current MCB address
 32490                                  ;        DX - Address given for conversion
 32491                                  ;        CX - Current UMB #
 32492                                  ; ----------------------------------------
 32493                                  
 32494                                  ;atu10:	
 32495                                  	;mov	ax,es ; * ; 18/07/2023
 32496 00002C2E 39D0                            cmp	ax,dx		; Present segment >= given segment?
 32497 00002C30 731D                    	jae	short atuX	; Yep--done.
 32498                                  
 32499 00002C32 E8DDFF                  	call	isSysMCB	; Returns with ZF set if this is a system MCB
 32500 00002C35 7501                    	jnz	short atu20
 32501                                  
 32502 00002C37 41                      	inc	cx		; If it _was_ a system MCB, we're in a new UMB.
 32503                                  atu20:	
 32504                                  	;mov	al,[es:ARENA.SIGNATURE]
 32505                                  	;cmp	al,arena_signature_end  ; 'Z'
 32506                                  	; 22/07/2023
 32507                                  	; ax = es
 32508                                  	;mov	ax,es ; **
 32509 00002C38 2603060300              	add	ax,[es:ARENA.SIZE]
 32510 00002C3D 26803E00005A            	cmp	byte [es:ARENA.SIGNATURE],arena_signature_end
 32511 00002C43 7403                    	je	short atu30		; 'Z' means this was the last MCB... that's it.
 32512                                  
 32513                                  	;NextMCB es,ax
 32514                                  
 32515                                  	;mov	ax,es ; **
 32516                                  	;;add	ax,[es:3]
 32517                                  	;add	ax,[es:ARENA.SIZE]
 32518 00002C45 40                      	inc	ax
 32519                                  	; 22/07/2023
 32520                                  	;mov	es,ax ; *
 32521 00002C46 EBE4                    	jmp	short atu10
 32522                                  
 32523                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32524                                  ; if we get to atu30, they specified a number that was past the last MCB.
 32525                                  ; make sure it's not _inside_ that MCB before we return an error condition.
 32526                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32527                                  
 32528                                  atu30:	
 32529                                  	; 22/07/2023
 32530                                  	; ax = es + [es:ARENA.SIZE] 
 32531                                  	;mov	ax,es ; **
 32532                                  	;add	ax,[es:ARENA.SIZE] ; **
 32533 00002C48 39D0                    	cmp	ax,dx		; Present >= given?
 32534 00002C4A 7303                    	jae	short atuX	; Yep! It _was_ inside.
 32535                                  atuE:	
 32536 00002C4C 31C9                    	xor	cx,cx ; 0	; Else, fall through with UMB # == -1
 32537 00002C4E 49                      	dec	cx		; (that makes it return 0xFFFF and sets CF)
 32538                                  atuX:	
 32539 00002C4F 89C8                    	mov	ax,cx		; Return the UMB number in AX
 32540                                  	
 32541 00002C51 07                      	pop	es	
 32542                                  	; 01/01/2023
 32543                                  	;pop	dx
 32544                                  	;pop	cx
 32545 00002C52 C3                      	retn

 33295                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 33296                                  ;*** shrinkMCB - breaks an MCB into two pieces, the lowest one's size==AX
 33297                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 33298                                  ; ENTRY:    AX == new size, ES:0 == current MCB
 33299                                  ; EXIT:     None; MCB broken if carry clear
 33300                                  ; ERROR:    Carry set if MCB isn't as large as AX+0x20 (not a useful split)
 33301                                  ; USES:     Flags
 33302                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 33303                                  ; If the size of the to-be-split MCB isn't at least 0x20 bytes greater than
 33304                                  ; the specified new size, the split is useless; if it's only 0x10 bytes, that
 33305                                  ; 0x10 will be used to make a header that mentions a 0-byte free space, and
 33306                                  ; that just sucks up 0x10 bytes for nothing. So we make 0x20 bytes the
 33307                                  ; minimum for performing a split.
 33308                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 33388                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 33389                                  ;*** hideUMB? - hides as appropriate the UMB in CL
 33390                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 33391                                  ; ENTRY:    CL should be to a valid UMB number, and AX to its address (findUMB)
 33392                                  ; EXIT:     None; UMB is hidden as necessary
 33393                                  ; ERROR:    None
 33394                                  ; USES:     Flags, AX, CX
 33395                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 33396                                  ; PRIMARY LOGIC:
 33397                                  ;
 33398                                  ; If the UMB is specified in the DH/LH statement, then:
 33399                                  ;    If the largest free segment is too small (check specified size), then:
 33400                                  ;       Pretend it wasn't ever specified, and fall out of this IF.
 33401                                  ;    Else, if largest free segment is LARGER than specified size, then:
 33402                                  ;       If /S was given on the command-line, then:
 33403                                  ;          Break that element into two pieces
 33404                                  ;          Set a flag that we're shrinking
 33405                                  ;       Endif
 33406                                  ;    Endif
 33407                                  ; Endif
 33408                                  ; If the UMB is NOT specified (or was removed by the above):
 33409                                  ;    Hide all free elements in the UMB
 33410                                  ;    If the flag that we're shrinking was set, then:
 33411                                  ;       UN-hide the lower portion of the shrunken UMB
 33412                                  ;    ENDIF
 33413                                  ; ENDIF
 33414                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 33415

 33449                                  hu_10:	
 33450                                  	;call	isTiny		; Returns ZF clear if user specified /S
 33451                                  	;jz	short hu_20

 33455                                  	;or	al,al

 33461                                  
 33462 00002E0F 8CC2                    	mov	dx,es
 33463 00002E11 EB09                    	jmp	short hu_30	; Skip the spec check.. we wanna hide this one.
 33464                                  
 33465 00002E13 89C8                    hu_20:	mov	ax,cx
 33466 00002E15 E87EFF                  	call	isSpecified	; If they specified this UMB, we're done...
 33467 00002E18 7510                    	jnz	short hu_X	; so leave.
 33468                                  
 33469 00002E1A 31D2                    	xor	dx,dx
 33470                                  hu_30:

 33472

 33474

 34093                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 34094                                  ;
 34095                                  ; procedure : InitDevLoad
 34096                                  ;
 34097                                  ;	Input : DeviceHi = 0 indicates load DD in low memory
 34098                                  ;			 = 1 indicates load in UMB:
 34099                                  ;		           ConvLoad = 0 indicates a new-style load (see below)
 34100                                  ;		                    = 1 indicates a DOS 5-style load
 34101                                  ;		DevSize  = Size of the device driver file in paras
 34102                                  ;
 34103                                  ;	Output : none
 34104                                  ;
 34105                                  ;	Initializes DevLoadAddr, DevLoadEnd & DevEntry.
 34106                                  ;	Also sets up a header for the Device driver entry for mem utility
 34107                                  ;
 34108                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 34109                                  ; For a "new-style load", we break off the current DevEntry and link the umbs
 34110                                  ; as we see fit, using HideUMBs (and UnHideUMBs at exit, though _it_ decides
 34111                                  ; whether it's entitled to do anything). HideUMBs uses the chart built by
 34112                                  ; ParseVar to determine which UMBs to leave FREE, and which not.
 34113                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 34114                                  
 34115                                  	; 01/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)
 34116                                  	; 01/01/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS)
 34117                                  	; (SYSINIT:364Ah)
 34118                                  InitDevLoad:
 34119                                  	; 01/01/2023
 34120                                  	;push	es ; *
 34121                                  
 34122                                  	; 11/12/2022
 34123                                  	; ds = cs
 34124 00002FBD 803E[561F]00            	cmp	byte [DeviceHi],0
 34125                                  	;cmp	byte [cs:DeviceHi],0	; Are we loading in UMB ?
 34126                                  	;je	short InitForLo		; no, init for lo mem
 34127 00002FC2 7439                    	je	short initforlo_x ; 09/04/2019
 34128                                  
 34129                                  ; 01/01/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS)
 34130                                  ; 01/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS SYSINIT compatibility)
 34131                                  ; %if 0
 34132                                  	; 01/01/2023
 34133 00002FC4 803E[461F]01            	cmp	byte [ConvLoad],1	; Are we loading as per DOS 5?
 34134                                  	;cmp	byte [cs:ConvLoad],1	; Are we loading as per DOS 5?
 34135 00002FC9 7413                    	je	short InitForConv
 34136                                  
 34137                                  ; There are two stages to preparing upper-memory; first, we mark as 8+HIDDEN
 34138                                  ; any areas not specified on the /L:... chain. Second, we mark as 8+FROZEN
 34139                                  ; any areas left in upper-memory, except for elements in the load UMB...
 34140                                  ; we then malloc space as per Dos-5 style, and mark as free any spaces which
 34141                                  ; are 8+FROZEN (but leave 8+HIDDEN still hidden). The load is performed,
 34142                                  ; and UnHideUMBs later on marks all 8+HIDDEN as free.
 34143                                  
 34144 00002FCB E85704                  	call	ShrinkUMB		; Stop using the old device arena
 34145                                  
 34146 00002FCE E892FC                  	call	HideUMBs		; Mark up the UM area as we see fit
 34147 00002FD1 E8CBFE                  	call	FreezeUM		; Hide everything BUT the load area
 34148 00002FD4 E85700                  	call	GetUMBForDev		; And grab that load area as needed
 34149 00002FD7 9C                      	pushf
 34150 00002FD8 E851FE                  	call	UnFreeze		; Then unhide everything frozen
 34151 00002FDB 9D                      	popf
 34152                                  	;jc	short InitForLo		; (if carry, it's loading low)
 34153                                  	;jmp	short InitForHi
 34154                                  	; 06/07/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 IO.SYS (optimization)
 34155 00002FDC EB0B                    	jmp	short idl0
 34156                                  
 34157                                  ;%endif ; 01/11/2022
 34158                                  
 34159                                  	; 01/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)
 34160                                  	; (SYSINIT:2B67h)
 34161                                  InitForConv:
 34162                                  	; 11/12/2022
 34163                                  	; ds = cs
 34164 00002FDE E83700                  	call	SpaceInUMB		; Do we have space left in the
 34165                                  					;  current UMB ?
 34166 00002FE1 7308                    	jnc	short InitForHi		; yes, we have
 34167 00002FE3 E83F04                  	call	ShrinkUMB		; shrink the current UMB in use
 34168 00002FE6 E84500                  	call	GetUMBForDev		; else try to allocate new UMB
 34169                                  idl0: ; 06/07/2023
 34170 00002FE9 720D                    	jc	short InitForLo		; we didn't succeed, so load
 34171                                  					;  in low memory
 34172                                  InitForHi:
 34173                                  	; 11/12/2022
 34174                                  	; ds = cs
 34175                                  	;mov	ax,[cs:DevUMBFree]	; get Para addr of free mem
 34176                                  	;mov	dx,[cs:DevUMBAddr]	; UMB start addr
 34177                                  	;add	dx,[cs:DevUMBSize]	; DX = UMB End addr
 34178 00002FEB A1[4C1F]                	mov	ax,[DevUMBFree]
 34179 00002FEE 8B16[481F]              	mov	dx,[DevUMBAddr]
 34180 00002FF2 0316[4A1F]              	add	dx,[DevUMBSize]
 34181 00002FF6 EB0C                    	jmp	short idl1
 34182                                  
 34183                                  InitForLo:
 34184                                  	; 11/12/2022
 34185                                  	; ds = cs
 34186                                  	;mov	byte [cs:DeviceHi],0	; in case we failed to load
 34187 00002FF8 C606[561F]00            	mov	byte [DeviceHi],0
 34188                                  initforlo_x:
 34189                                  	; 11/12/2022
 34190                                  	; ds = cs
 34191                                  					;  into UMB indicate that
 34192                                  					;  we are loading low
 34193                                  	;mov	ax,[cs:memhi]		; AX = start of Low memory
 34194                                  	;mov	dx,[cs:ALLOCLIM]	; DX = End of Low memory
 34195 00002FFD A1[6403]                	mov	ax,[memhi]
 34196 00003000 8B16[A502]              	mov	dx,[ALLOCLIM]
 34197                                  idl1:
 34198 00003004 E86600                  	call	DevSetMark		; setup a sub-arena for DD
 34199                                  	; 11/12/2022
 34200                                  	; ds = cs
 34201                                  	;mov	[cs:DevLoadAddr],ax	; init the Device load address
 34202                                  	;mov	[cs:DevLoadEnd],dx	; init the limit of the block
 34203                                  	;mov	word [cs:DevEntry],0	; init Entry point to DD
 34204                                  	;mov	[cs:DevEntry+2],ax
 34205 00003007 A3[3A1F]                	mov	[DevLoadAddr],ax
 34206 0000300A 8916[3C1F]              	mov	[DevLoadEnd],dx
 34207 0000300E C706[3E1F]0000          	mov	word [DevEntry],0

 35185                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 35186                                  ;
 35187                                  ;**	umb_coalesce - Combine free blocks ahead with current block
 35188                                  ;
 35189                                  ;	Coalesce adds the block following the argument to the argument block,
 35190                                  ;	if it's free. Coalesce is usually used to join free blocks, but
 35191                                  ;	some callers (such as $setblock) use it to join a free block to it's
 35192                                  ;	preceeding allocated block.
 35193                                  ;
 35194                                  ;	EXIT	'C' clear if OK
 35195                                  ;		  (ds) unchanged, this block updated
 35196                                  ;		  (ax) = address of next block, IF not at end
 35197                                  ;		'C' set if arena trashed

 35199                                  ;

 35218 00003333 7407                    	je	short uc_again		; Y: try to coalesce with next block
 35219                                  					; N: get next arena

 35221 00003338 72D3                    	jc	short uc_done	; *!
 35222 0000333A EBEE                    	jmp	short uc_nextfree

 35225 0000333F 72CC                    	jc	short uc_done	; *!
 35226                                  uc_check:

 35228 00003346 75E2                    	jne	short uc_nextfree	; N: get next free arena
 35229                                  					; Y: coalesce

 35231 0000334D 41                      	inc     cx                      ; cx <- cx + 1 (for header size)

 35559                                  ; SYSINIT2.ASM - MSDOS 6.0 - 1991
 35560                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 35561                                  ; 14/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 35562                                  
 35563                                  ; Multiple configuration block support  Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 35564                                  ;
 35565                                  ; Summary:
 35566                                  ;
 35567                                  ;   The procedure "organize" crunches the in-memory copy of config.sys
 35568                                  ;   into lines delimited by CR/LF (sometimes no CR, but *always* an LF)
 35569                                  ;   with the leading "keyword=" replaced by single character codes (eg, B
 35570                                  ;   for BUFFERS, D for DEVICE, Z for any unrecognized keyword); see comtab
 35571                                  ;   and/or config.inc for the full list.
 35572                                  ;
 35573                                  ;   [blockname] and INCLUDE are the major syntactical additions for multi-
 35574                                  ;   configuration support. blockname is either MENU, which contains one
 35575                                  ;   or more MENUITEM lines, an optional MENUDEFAULT (which includes optional
 35576                                  ;   time-out), or any user-defined keyword, such as NETWORK, CD-ROM, etc.
 35577                                  ;   INCLUDE allows the current block to name another block for inclusion
 35578                                  ;   during the processing phase of CONFIG.SYS. An INCLUDE is only honored
 35579                                  ;   once, precluding nasty infinite-loop scenarios. If blocks are present
 35580                                  ;   without a MENU block, then only lines inside COMMON blocks are processed.
 35581                                  ;
 35582                                  ; Example:
 35583                                  ;
 35584                                  ;   [menu]
 35585                                  ;   menuitem=misc,Miscellaneous
 35586                                  ;   menuitem=network,Network Configuration
 35587                                  ;   menudefault=network,15
 35588                                  ;
 35589                                  ;   [network]
 35590                                  ;   include misc
 35591                                  ;   device=foo
 35592                                  ;
 35593                                  ;   [misc]
 35594                                  ;   device=bar
 35595                                  ;   include alternate
 35596                                  ;
 35597                                  ;   [alternate]
 35598                                  ;   device=tar
 35599                                  ;
 35600                                  ;
 35601                                  ;   When the menu is displayed
 35602                                  ;
 35603                                  ;    1. Miscellaneous
 35604                                  ;    2. Network Configuration
 35605                                  ;
 35606                                  ;   #2 is highlighted as the default option, and will be automatically
 35607                                  ;   selected after 15 seconds. It will invoke the following lines in the
 35608                                  ;   following order:
 35609                                  ;
 35610                                  ;       DEVICE=BAR
 35611                                  ;       DEVICE=TAR
 35612                                  ;       DEVICE=FOO
 35613                                  ;
 35614                                  
 35615                                  ;MULTI_CONFIG equ 1
 35616                                  
 35617                                  ; the following depend on the positions of the various letters in switchlist
 35618                                  
 35619                                  switchnum	equ 11111000b ; 0F8h	; which switches require number
 35620                                  
 35621                                  flagec35	equ 00000100b ; 4	; electrically compatible 3.5 inch disk drive
 35622                                  flagdrive	equ 00001000b ; 8 
 35623                                  flagcyln	equ 00010000b ; 16
 35624                                  flagseclim	equ 00100000b ; 32
 35625                                  flagheads	equ 01000000b ; 64
 35626                                  flagff		equ 10000000b ; 128
 35627

 36138                                  ; procedure : setdeviceparameters
 36139                                  ;
 36140                                  ; setdeviceparameters sets up the recommended bpb in each bds in the
 36141                                  ; system based on the form factor. it is assumed that the bpbs for the
 36142                                  ; various form factors are present in the bpbtable. for hard files,
 36143                                  ; the recommended bpb is the same as the bpb on the drive.
 36144                                  ; no attempt is made to preserve registers since we are going to jump to
 36145                                  ; sysinit straight after this routine.
 36146                                  ;
 36147                                  ;	if we return carry, the DRIVPARM will be aborted, but presently
 36148                                  ;	  we always return no carry

 36151                                  ;
 36152                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 36159                                  	; (SYSINIT:3FC4h)

 36996

 36998 000038C5 750D                            jne	short kbd_notf5	; no

 37080                                  ;   menu_check:  check for presence of menu (and other) configuration blocks
 37081                                  ;
 37082                                  ;   INPUT

 37084                                  ;    ES:SI -> "organized" config.sys memory image
 37085                                  ;       DS == CS == sysinitseg
 37086                                  ;
 37087                                  ;   OUTPUT
 37088                                  ;       Same as above; the idea is that menu_check simply transforms
 37089                                  ;       a block-structured config.sys image into a conventional image,
 37090                                  ;       based on the user's block selection and any other boot-time options
 37091                                  ;       the user may have employed...

 37095                                  ;
 37096                                  ;   NOTES
 37097                                  ;       [count] and [org_count] are set to the new config.sys image length

 37109                                  ;   Search for SWITCHES, determine if /N or /F are present; if so, then
 37110                                  ;   disable clean/interactive boot options
 37111                                  
 37112 00003928 51                              push    cx              ;
 37113 00003929 56                              push    si              ;
 37114 0000392A 29DB                            sub     bx,bx           ; remains ZERO until first block
 37115                                  swchk_loop:                     ;
 37116 0000392C E83507                          call    get_char        ; get first char of current line
 37117 0000392F 724C                            jc	short swchk_end	; hit eof

 37120 00003935 43                              inc     bx              ; remember that we've seen a block

 37124 0000393A 750E                            jne	short swchk_next2 ;

 37128 00003943 26C644FF30                      mov     byte [es:si-1],CONFIG_REM

 37808                                  ;
 37809                                  ;   copy_block:  copy the current block to the new config.sys workspace

 37923                                  ;
 37924                                  ;   get_linenum:  return line # (in BX) of current line (@ES:SI)
 37925                                  ;
 37926                                  ;   INPUT
 37927                                  ;    ES:SI -> some line in the config.sys memory image
 37928                                  ;
 37929                                  ;   OUTPUT
 37930                                  ;       BX == line # (relative to 1)
 37931                                  ;

 37951                                  get_linenum_loop:               ;

 37963                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37964                                  ;
 37965                                  ;   srch_block:  searches entire config.sys for block name @ES:DI
 37966                                  ;
 37967                                  ;   INPUT
 37968                                  ;       ES -> config.sys image
 37969                                  ;    ES:DI -> block name to find
 37970                                  ;
 37971                                  ;   OUTPUT
 37972                                  ;       ZF flag set, if found
 37973                                  ;    ES:DI -> just past the name in the block heading, if found
 37974                                  ;       BX == # bytes remaining from that point, if found
 37975                                  ;
 37976                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 37977                                  ;       None
 37978                                  ;
 37979                                  ;   NOTES
 37980                                  ;       This differs from "find_block" in that it searches the ENTIRE
 37981                                  ;       config.sys image, not merely the remaining portion, and that it
 37982                                  ;       takes a pointer to block name that is *elsewhere* in the image
 37983                                  ;       (ie, ES) as opposed to some string constant in our own segment (DS).
 37984                                  ;
 37985                                  ;   HISTORY
 37986                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 37987                                  ;
 37988                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37989                                  
 37990                                  srch_block:	          ; returns BX -> named block in CONFIG.SYS
 37991 00003D80 50                              push    ax              ;
 37992 00003D81 51                              push    cx              ;
 37993 00003D82 2E8B0E[5603]                    mov     cx,[cs:count]   ;
 37994 00003D87 56                              push    si              ;
 37995 00003D88 29F6                            sub     si,si           ;
 37996 00003D8A 1E                              push    ds              ;
 37997 00003D8B 06                              push    es              ;
 37998 00003D8C 1F                              pop     ds              ;
 37999 00003D8D E80900                          call    find_block      ;
 38000 00003D90 89F7                            mov     di,si           ;
 38001 00003D92 89CB                            mov     bx,cx           ;
 38002 00003D94 1F                              pop     ds              ;
 38003 00003D95 5E                              pop     si              ;
 38004 00003D96 59                              pop     cx              ;
 38005 00003D97 58                              pop     ax              ;
 38006                                  find_exit: ; 16/04/2019
 38007 00003D98 C3                              retn			;
 38008                                  
 38009                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38010                                  ;
 38011                                  ;   find_block:  searches rest of config.sys for block name @DS:DI
 38012                                  ;
 38013                                  ;   INPUT
 38014                                  ;    DS:DI -> block name to find
 38015                                  ;    ES:SI -> remainder of config.sys image
 38016                                  ;       CX == remaining size of config.sys image
 38017                                  ;
 38018                                  ;   OUTPUT
 38019                                  ;       ZF flag set, if found (also, CF set if EOF)
 38020                                  ;    ES:SI -> where the search stopped (at end of block name or EOF)
 38021                                  ;       CX == # bytes remaining from that point
 38022                                  ;
 38023                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 38024                                  ;       AX
 38025                                  ;
 38026                                  ;   NOTES
 38027                                  ;       This differs from "srch_block" in that it searches only the
 38028                                  ;       remaining portion of the config.sys image and leaves SI and CX
 38029                                  ;       pointing to where the search left off, and that it takes a pointer
 38030                                  ;       to search string in our own segment (DS:DI instead of ES:DI).
 38031                                  ;
 38032                                  ;   HISTORY
 38033                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 38034                                  ;
 38035                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38036                                  
 38037                                  find_block:
 38038 00003D99 E8C802                          call    get_char        ; get line code
 38039 00003D9C 72FA                            jc	short find_exit	; end of file
 38040 00003D9E 247F                            and     al,~CONFIG_OPTION_QUERY
 38041 00003DA0 3C5B                            cmp     al,CONFIG_BEGIN ; beginning of a block?
 38042 00003DA2 740C                            je	short check_line ; no
 38043 00003DA4 3C4A                            cmp     al,CONFIG_INCLUDE
 38044 00003DA6 7513                            jne	short next_line	;
 38045 00003DA8 2E800E[9A14]01                  or	byte [cs:config_multi],1
 38046 00003DAE EB0B                            jmp     short next_line ;
 38047                                  check_line:
 38048 00003DB0 2E800E[9A14]01                  or      byte [cs:config_multi],1
 38049 00003DB6 E80700                          call    comp_names      ; compare block names
 38050 00003DB9 76DD                            jbe	short find_exit	; end of file, or names matched
 38051                                  next_line:
 38052 00003DBB E88002                          call    skip_opt_line   ; no, so skip to next line
 38053 00003DBE EBD9                            jmp	short find_block  ;
 38054                                  ;find_exit:
 38055                                  ;	retn
 38056                                  
 38057                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38058                                  ;
 38059                                  ;   comp_names:  compares keyword @DS:DI to position in config.sys @ES:SI
 38060                                  ;
 38061                                  ;   INPUT
 38062                                  ;    DS:DI -> keyword to compare
 38063                                  ;    ES:SI -> position in config.sys
 38064                                  ;       CX == remaining bytes in config.sys
 38065                                  ;
 38066                                  ;   OUTPUT
 38067                                  ;       ZF flag set, if match (also, CF set if EOF)
 38068                                  ;    ES:SI -> where the comparison stopped (at end of block name or EOF)
 38069                                  ;       CX == # bytes remaining from that point
 38070                                  ;
 38071                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 38072                                  ;       AX
 38073                                  ;
 38074                                  ;   NOTES
 38075                                  ;       None
 38076                                  ;
 38077                                  ;   HISTORY
 38078                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 38079                                  ;
 38080                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38081                                  
 38082                                  comp_names:
 38083 00003DC0 57                              push    di              ;
 38084                                  comp_loop:                      ;
 38085 00003DC1 E8A002                          call    get_char        ;
 38086 00003DC4 7210                            jc	short comp_exit	;
 38087 00003DC6 E80704                          call    any_delim       ; is next character a delimiter?
 38088 00003DC9 8A25                            mov     ah,[di]         ; (get next character we're supposed to match)
 38089 00003DCB 740B                            je	short comp_almost ; yes, it *could* be a match
 38090 00003DCD 47                              inc     di              ;
 38091 00003DCE 25DFDF                          and     ax,~2020h ; 0DFDFh 
 38092                                  				; BUGBUG -- assumes both names are alphanumeric -JTP
 38093 00003DD1 38E0                            cmp     al,ah           ; match?
 38094 00003DD3 74EC                            je	short comp_loop ; yes, keep looking at the characters
 38095 00003DD5 F8                              clc                     ; prevent erroneous eof indication: clear carry
 38096                                  comp_exit:                      ;
 38097 00003DD6 5F                              pop     di              ;
 38098 00003DD7 C3                              retn			;
 38099                                  comp_almost:                    ;
 38100 00003DD8 86C4                            xchg    al,ah           ; we don't know for sure if it's a match
 38101 00003DDA E8F303                          call    any_delim       ; until we verify that the second string has
 38102 00003DDD 86C4                            xchg    al,ah           ; been exhausted also...
 38103 00003DDF EBF5                            jmp     short comp_exit ; if we are, this call to any_delim will tell...
 38104                                  
 38105                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38106                                  
 38107                                  	; 10/09/2023 - Retrodos v4.2 IO.SYS (Optimization)
 38108                                  comp_names_x:
 38109                                  	;
 38110                                  comp_names_safe:
 38111 00003DE1 50                              push    ax
 38112 00003DE2 51                              push    cx
 38113 00003DE3 56                              push	si
 38114 00003DE4 1E                              push    ds
 38115 00003DE5 0E                              push    cs
 38116 00003DE6 1F                              pop     ds
 38117 00003DE7 E8D6FF                          call    comp_names
 38118 00003DEA 1F                              pop     ds
 38119 00003DEB 5E                      	pop	si
 38120 00003DEC 59                              pop     cx
 38121 00003DED 58                              pop     ax
 38122 00003DEE C3                              retn

 38126                                  ;   print_item:  display menu item #BL
 38127                                  ;
 38128                                  ;   INPUT
 38129                                  ;       BL == menu item # to display
 38130                                  ;
 38131                                  ;   OUTPUT
 38132                                  ;       Menu item displayed, with appropriate highlighting if BL == bDefBlock
 38133                                  ;
 38134                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 38135                                  ;       None
 38136                                  ;
 38137                                  ;   NOTES
 38138                                  ;       This function saves/restores the current cursor position, so you
 38139                                  ;       needn't worry about it.
 38140                                  ;
 38141                                  ;   HISTORY
 38142                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 38143                                  ;
 38144                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 38146                                  	; 04/01/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS)
 38147                                  	; (SYSINIT:485Ah)

 38149                                  print_item:		; prints menu item #BL (1 to N)
 38150 00003DEF 50                              push    ax              ;
 38151 00003DF0 53                              push    bx              ;
 38152 00003DF1 51                              push    cx              ;
 38153 00003DF2 52                              push    dx              ;
 38154 00003DF3 56                              push    si              ;

 38156 00003DF6 8A3E[D446]                      mov     bh,[bMenuPage]  ; always page zero
 38157 00003DFA CD10                            int     10h             ; DH/DL = row/column
 38158 00003DFC 52                              push    dx              ; save it
 38159 00003DFD B402                            mov     ah,02h          ; set cursor position
 38160 00003DFF 88DE                            mov     dh,bl           ;
 38161 00003E01 80C603                          add     dh,3            ;
 38162 00003E04 B205                            mov     dl,5            ;
