 38164 00003E08 88D8                            mov     al,bl           ;
 38165 00003E0A 0430                            add     al,'0'          ; convert menu item # to ASCII digit
 38166 00003E0C 8A26[D346]                      mov     ah,[bMenuColor] ; normal attribute
 38167 00003E10 3A1E[DD46]                      cmp     bl,[bDefBlock]  ; are we printing the current block?
 38168 00003E14 7510                            jne	short print_other ; no
 38169 00003E16 80CC70                          or      ah,70h          ; yes, set bgnd color to white
 38170 00003E19 88E5                            mov     ch,ah           ;
 38171 00003E1B B104                            mov     cl,4            ;
 38172 00003E1D D2C5                            rol     ch,cl           ;
 38173 00003E1F 38E5                            cmp     ch,ah           ; are fgnd/bgnd the same?
 38174 00003E21 7503                            jne	short print_other ; no
 38175 00003E23 80F408                          xor     ah,08h          ; yes, so modify the fgnd intensity
 38176                                  print_other:                    ;
 38177 00003E26 B700                            mov     bh,0            ;
 38178 00003E28 01DB                            add     bx,bx           ;
 38179 00003E2A 8BBF[0147]                      mov     di,[aoffBlockDesc+bx]
 38180 00003E2E 88E3                            mov     bl,ah           ; put the attribute in the correct register now
 38181 00003E30 8A3E[D446]                      mov     bh,[bMenuPage]  ; get correct video page #
 38182 00003E34 B409                            mov     ah,09h          ; write char/attr
 38183 00003E36 B90100                          mov     cx,1            ;
 38184 00003E39 CD10                            int     10h             ;
 38185 00003E3B FEC2                            inc     dl              ; increment column
 38186 00003E3D B402                            mov     ah,02h          ;
 38187 00003E3F CD10                            int     10h             ;
 38188                                          ;mov	ax,0900h+'.'    ;
 38189 00003E41 B82E09                          mov	ax,092Eh
 38190 00003E44 CD10                    	int     10h             ; display '.'
 38191 00003E46 FEC2                            inc     dl              ; increment column
 38192 00003E48 B402                            mov     ah,02h          ;
 38193 00003E4A CD10                            int     10h             ;
 38194                                          ;mov	ax,0900h+' '    ;
 38195 00003E4C B82009                          mov	ax,0920h
 38196 00003E4F CD10                    	int     10h             ; display ' '
 38197 00003E51 FEC2                            inc     dl              ; increment column
 38198 00003E53 B402                            mov     ah,02h          ;
 38199 00003E55 CD10                            int     10h             ;
 38200 00003E57 06                              push    es              ;
 38201                                  print_loop:                     ;
 38202 00003E58 268A05                          mov     al,[es:di]	; get a character of the description
 38203 00003E5B 47                              inc     di              ;
 38204 00003E5C 3C09                            cmp     al,TAB ; 9	; substitute spaces for tabs
 38205 00003E5E 7502                            jne	short print_nontab ;
 38206 00003E60 B020                            mov     al,' '          ;
 38207                                  print_nontab:                   ;
 38208 00003E62 3C20                            cmp     al,' '          ;
 38209 00003E64 7215                            jb	short print_done ; stop at the 1st character < space
 38210 00003E66 3C24                            cmp     al,'$'          ;
 38211 00003E68 7411                            je	short print_done ; also stop on $
 38212 00003E6A B409                            mov     ah,09h          ; display function #
 38213 00003E6C CD10                            int     10h             ;
 38214 00003E6E FEC2                            inc     dl              ; increment column
 38215 00003E70 80FA4E                          cmp     dl,78           ; far enough?
 38216 00003E73 7306                            jae	short print_done ; yes
 38217 00003E75 B402                            mov     ah,02h          ;
 38218 00003E77 CD10                            int     10h             ;
 38219 00003E79 EBDD                            jmp	short  print_loop
 38220                                  print_done:                     ;
 38221 00003E7B 07                              pop     es              ;
 38222 00003E7C 5A                              pop     dx              ;
 38223 00003E7D B402                            mov     ah,02h          ;
 38224 00003E7F CD10                            int     10h             ; restore previous row/col
 38225 00003E81 5E                              pop     si              ;
 38226 00003E82 5A                              pop     dx              ;
 38227 00003E83 59                              pop     cx              ;
 38228 00003E84 5B                              pop     bx              ;
 38229 00003E85 58                              pop     ax              ;
 38230 00003E86 C3                              retn			;

 38232                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38233                                  ;
 38234                                  ;   select_item:  wait for user to select menu item, with time-out
 38235                                  ;
 38236                                  ;   INPUT
 38237                                  ;       None
 38238                                  ;
 38239                                  ;   OUTPUT
 38240                                  ;       BX == menu item # (1-N), or -1 for clean boot
 38241                                  ;       Selected menu item highlighted
 38242                                  ;       Cursor positioned beneath menu, ready for tty-style output now
 38243                                  ;
 38244                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 38245                                  ;       None
 38246                                  ;
 38247                                  ;   NOTES
 38248                                  ;       None
 38249                                  ;
 38250                                  ;   HISTORY
 38251                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 38252                                  ;

 38255                                  select_item:		; returns digit value in BX (trashes AX/CX/DX)
 38256 00003E87 8A1E[DD46]                      mov     bl,[bDefBlock]  ; BL will be the default block #
 38257 00003E8B 88D8                            mov     al,bl           ;
 38258 00003E8D E83701                          call    disp_num        ;

 38260 00003E93 803E[E146]FF                    cmp     byte [secTimeOut],-1
 38261 00003E98 7452                            je	short input_key	; no time-out, just go to input
 38262 00003E9A B42C                            mov     ah,GET_TIME ; 2Ch
 38263 00003E9C CD21                            int     21h             ;
 38264 00003E9E 88F7                            mov     bh,dh           ; BH = initial # of seconds
 38265                                  check_time:
 38266 00003EA0 A0[E146]                        mov     al,[secTimeOut] ;
 38267 00003EA3 2A06[E246]                      sub     al,[secElapsed] ;
 38268 00003EA7 730D                            jae	short show_time	;
 38269 00003EA9 800E[DC46]02                    or      byte [bQueryOpt],2  ; disable all further prompting
 38270 00003EAE C606[E246]00                    mov     byte [secElapsed],0
 38271 00003EB3 E9F600                          jmp	select_done	; time's up!
 38272                                  show_time:
 38273 00003EB6 53                              push    bx              ;
 38274 00003EB7 88C3                            mov     bl,al           ; save # in BL
 38275 00003EB9 8A3E[D446]                      mov     bh,[bMenuPage]  ;
 38276 00003EBD B403                            mov     ah,03h          ; get cursor position
 38277 00003EBF CD10                            int     10h             ;
 38278 00003EC1 52                              push    dx              ;
 38279 00003EC2 80C208                  	add	dl,8		; move cursor to the right
 38280 00003EC5 B402                            mov     ah,02h          ; set cursor position
 38281 00003EC7 CD10                            int     10h             ;
 38282 00003EC9 BA[984C]                        mov     dx,_$TimeOut
 38283 00003ECC E8DB05                          call    print           ; print the "Time remaining: " prompt
 38284 00003ECF 88D8                            mov     al,bl           ; recover # from BL
 38285 00003ED1 98                              cbw                     ; this works because AL is always <= 90
 38286 00003ED2 B10A                            mov     cl,10           ;
 38287 00003ED4 F6F1                            div     cl              ; AL = tens digit, AH = ones digit
 38288 00003ED6 88E1                            mov     cl,ah           ;
 38289 00003ED8 0430                            add     al,'0'          ;
 38290 00003EDA B40E                            mov     ah,0Eh          ;
 38291 00003EDC CD10                            int     10h             ; write TTY tens digit
 38292 00003EDE 88C8                            mov     al,cl           ;
 38293 00003EE0 0430                            add     al,'0'          ;
 38294 00003EE2 B40E                            mov     ah,0Eh          ;
 38295 00003EE4 CD10                            int     10h             ; write TTY ones digit
 38296 00003EE6 5A                              pop     dx
 38297 00003EE7 B402                            mov     ah,02h          ; set cursor position back to where it was
 38298 00003EE9 CD10                            int     10h             ;
 38299 00003EEB 5B                              pop     bx              ;
 38300                                  input_key:
 38301 00003EEC B406                            mov     ah,RAW_CON_IO ; 6
 38302 00003EEE B2FF                            mov     dl,0FFh         ; input request
 38303 00003EF0 CD21                            int     21h             ;
 38304 00003EF2 751F                            jnz	short got_key	;
 38305 00003EF4 803E[E146]FF                    cmp     byte [secTimeOut],-1; is there a time-out?
 38306 00003EF9 74F1                            je	short input_key	; no, just go back to input
 38307 00003EFB B42C                            mov     ah,GET_TIME     ;
 38308 00003EFD CD21                            int     21h             ; DH = seconds
 38309 00003EFF 88F4                            mov     ah,dh           ;
 38310 00003F01 28FE                            sub     dh,bh           ; should generally be zero or one
 38311 00003F03 88E7                            mov     bh,ah           ;
 38312 00003F05 7302                            jnc	short got_time	;
 38313 00003F07 B601                            mov     dh,1            ; it wrapped back to zero, so assume one
 38314                                  got_time:
 38315 00003F09 08F6                            or      dh,dh           ; any change?
 38316 00003F0B 74DF                            jz	short input_key	; no
 38317 00003F0D 0036[E246]                      add     [secElapsed],dh ;
 38318 00003F11 EB8D                            jmp	short check_time ;
 38319                                  got_key:
 38320 00003F13 50                              push    ax              ;
 38321 00003F14 B8FFFF                          mov     ax,-1           ; zap both secTimeOut and secElapsed
 38322 00003F17 8706[E146]                      xchg    [secTimeOut],ax
 38323 00003F1B 3CFF                            cmp     al,-1           ; was time-out already disabled?
 38324 00003F1D 740E                            je	short timeout_disabled ; yes
 38325 00003F1F 53                              push    bx              ; let's disable # seconds display
 38326 00003F20 B8200A                          mov     ax,0A20h        ; write multiple spaces
 38327 00003F23 8B1E[D346]                      mov     bx,[bMenuColor]
 38328 00003F27 B95000                          mov     cx,80           ; 80 of them, to be safe

 38330 00003F2C 5B                              pop     bx   		;
 38331                                  
 38332                                  timeout_disabled:

 38336 00003F32 CD21                            int     21h             ; get the next part of the key then
 38337 00003F34 74B6                            jz	short input_key	; hmmm, what happened to the second part?
 38338                                  
 38339 00003F36 3C48                            cmp     al,48h          ; up arrow?

 38342 00003F3D 76AD                            jbe	short input_key	; yes, ignore it
 38343 00003F3F FE0E[DD46]                      dec     byte [bDefBlock] ;

 38345 00003F46 FECB                            dec     bl              ; and then print the new current item
 38346 00003F48 EB12                            jmp     short print1
 38347                                  not_up:
 38348 00003F4A 3C50                            cmp     al,50h          ; down arrow?
 38349 00003F4C 7518                            jne	short not_down	; no
 38350 00003F4E 3A1E[DE46]                      cmp     bl,[bMaxBlock]  ; are we as down as down can get?
 38351 00003F52 7310                            jae	short to_input_key ; yes, ignore it
 38352 00003F54 FE06[DD46]                      inc     byte [bDefBlock] ;
 38353 00003F58 E894FE                          call    print_item      ; re-print the current item
 38354 00003F5B 43                              inc     bx              ; and then print the new current item
 38355                                  print1: 
 38356 00003F5C 88D8                    	mov     al,bl           ;
 38357                                  print2: 
 38358 00003F5E E88EFE                  	call    print_item      ;
 38359 00003F61 E86300                          call    disp_num        ;
 38360                                  to_input_key:
 38361 00003F64 EB86                            jmp	short input_key ; 10/09/2023
 38362                                  not_down:
 38363 00003F66 F606[D846]01                    test    byte [bDisableUI],1
 38364 00003F6B 75F7                            jnz	short to_input_key ; don't allow F8 or F5
 38365 00003F6D 3C42                            cmp     al,42h          ; F8 function key?
 38366 00003F6F 750B                            jne	short not_f8	; no

 38368 00003F76 E85E00                          call    show_status     ;
 38369 00003F79 E970FF                          jmp     input_key	;
 38370                                  not_f8:
 38371 00003F7C 3C3F                            cmp     al,3Fh          ; F5 function key?
 38372 00003F7E 75E4                            jne	short to_input_key ; no
 38373                                  	; 02/08/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 IO.SYS (optimization)
 38374                                  	; MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS - SYSINIT:49EBh

 38381                                  normal_key:
 38382 00003F8C 3C0D                            cmp     al,0Dh          ; Enter?
 38383 00003F8E 741C                            je	short select_done ; yes

 38402

 38602                                  ;   skip_opt_line: same as skip_line provided AL != LF
 38603                                  ;
 38604                                  ;   INPUT
 38605                                  ;       AL == last character read
 38606                                  ;    ES:SI -> position in config.sys
 38607                                  ;       CX == remaining bytes in config.sys
 38608                                  ;
 38609                                  ;   OUTPUT
 38610                                  ;       CF set if EOF hit
 38611                                  ;       AL == 1st char of new line

 38613                                  ;       CX == # bytes remaining from that point
 38614                                  ;
 38615                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 38616                                  ;       AX
 38617                                  ;
 38618                                  ;   NOTES
 38619                                  ;       In other words, the purpose here is to skip to the next line,
 38620                                  ;       unless ES:SI is already sitting at the front of the next line (which
 38621                                  ;       it would be if the last character fetched -- AL -- was a linefeed)

 38623                                  ;   HISTORY

 39346                                  ;
 39347                                  ; procedure : getnum
 39348                                  ;
 39349                                  ; getnum parses a decimal number.
 39350                                  ; returns it in ax, sets zero flag if ax = 0 (may be considered an
 39351                                  ; error), if number is bad carry is set, zero is set, ax=0.
 39352                                  ;
 39353                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 39354                                  
 39355                                  getnum:
 39356 000042BB 53                      	push	bx
 39357 000042BC 31DB                    	xor	bx,bx			; running count is zero
 39358                                  b2:
 39359 000042BE E8F2FF                  	call	todigit 		; do we have a digit ?
 39360 000042C1 7247                    	jc	short badnum		; no, bomb
 39361                                  
 39362 000042C3 93                      	xchg	ax,bx			; put total in ax
 39363 000042C4 53                      	push	bx			; save digit (0 to 9)
 39364                                  	;mov	bx,10			; base of arithmetic
 39365                                  	; 12/12/2022
 39366 000042C5 B30A                    	mov	bl,10
 39367 000042C7 F7E3                    	mul	bx			; shift by one decimal digit
 39368 000042C9 5B                      	pop	bx			; get back digit (0 to 9)
 39369 000042CA 00D8                    	add	al,bl			; get total
 39370 000042CC 80D400                  	adc	ah,0			; make that 16 bits
 39371 000042CF 7239                    	jc	short badnum		; too big a number
 39372                                  
 39373 000042D1 93                      	xchg	ax,bx			; stash total
 39374                                  
 39375 000042D2 E830FF                  	call	getchr			;get next digit
 39376 000042D5 722D                    	jc	short b1		; no more characters
 39377 000042D7 3C20                    	cmp	al,' ' 			; space?
 39378 000042D9 741F                    	je	short b15		; then end of digits
 39379 000042DB 3C2C                    	cmp	al,',' 			; ',' is a seperator!!!
 39380 000042DD 741B                    	je	short b15		; then end of digits.
 39381 000042DF 3C09                    	cmp	al, tab ; 9		; tab
 39382 000042E1 7417                    	je	short b15
 39383 000042E3 2E3A06[AE02]            	cmp	al,[cs:sepchr]		; allow 0 or special separators
 39384 000042E8 7410                    	je	short b15
 39385 000042EA 3C2F                    	cmp	al,'/'			; see if another switch follows
 39386                                  	; 12/12/2022
 39387                                  	; 02/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS SYSINIT compatibility)
 39388                                  	;nop				; cas - remnant of old bad code
 39389                                  	;nop
 39390 000042EC 740C                    	je	short b15
 39391 000042EE 3C0A                    	cmp	al,lf			; line-feed?
 39392 000042F0 7408                    	je	short b15
 39393 000042F2 3C0D                    	cmp	al,cr			; carriage return?
 39394 000042F4 7404                    	je	short b15
 39395 000042F6 08C0                    	or	al,al			; end of line separator?
 39396 000042F8 75C4                    	jnz	short b2		; no, try as a valid char...
 39397                                  b15:
 39398 000042FA 2EFF06[5603]            	inc	word [cs:count]		; one more character to s...
 39399 000042FF 2EFF0E[5A03]            	dec	word [cs:chrptr]	; back up over separator
 39400                                  b1:
 39401 00004304 89D8                    	mov	ax,bx			; get proper count
 39402 00004306 09C0                    	or	ax,ax			; clears carry, sets zero accordingly
 39403 00004308 5B                      	pop	bx
 39404 00004309 C3                      	retn
 39405                                  badnum:
 39406                                  	; 02/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS SYSINIT compatibility)
 39407                                  	;mov	byte [cs:sepchr],0
 39408 0000430A 31C0                    	xor	ax,ax			; set zero flag, and ax = 0
 39409                                  	; 12 /12/2022
 39410 0000430C 2EA2[AE02]              	mov	[cs:sepchr],al ; 0
 39411 00004310 5B                      	pop	bx
 39412 00004311 F9                      	stc				; and carry set
 39413 00004312 C3                      	retn

 39753                                  
 39754                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 39755                                  ;move file pointer to cx:dx
 39756                                  ;read ax bytes into the control buffer. (should be less than 2 kb)
 39757                                  ;si will be set to 0 hence ds:si points to the control buffer.
 39758                                  ;
 39759                                  ;entry:  cx,dx offset from the start of the file where the read/write pointer
 39760                                  ;	 be moved.
 39761                                  ;	 ax - # of bytes to read
 39762                                  ;	 bx - file handle
 39763                                  ;	 ds - buffer seg.
 39764                                  ;return: the control data information is read into ds:0 - ds:0200.
 39765                                  ;	 cx,dx value destroyed.
 39766                                  ;	 carry set if error in reading file.
 39767                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 39768

 39770 00004464 B80042                  	mov	ax,4200h
 39771 00004467 F9                      	stc

 39773 0000446A 59                      	pop	cx			;# of bytes to read
 39774 0000446B 7209                    	jc	short ricb_exit
 39775

 39778 00004471 B43F                    	mov	ah,3Fh			;read into the buffer
 39779 00004473 F9                      	stc
 39780 00004474 CD21                    	int	21h			;should be less than 1024 bytes.
 39781                                  ricb_exit:
 39782 00004476 C3                      	retn
